data.abstractNote:
Summary
            
              The blue mould decay of apples is caused by
              Penicillium expansum
              and is associated with contamination by patulin, a worldwide regulated mycotoxin. Recently, a cluster of 15 genes (
              patA–patO
              ) involved in patulin biosynthesis was identified in
              P. expansum
              .
              blast
              analysis revealed that
              patL
              encodes a Cys
              6
              zinc finger regulatory factor. The deletion of
              patL
              caused a drastic decrease in the expression of all
              pat
              genes, leading to an absence of patulin production. Pathogenicity studies performed on 13 apple varieties indicated that the PeΔ
              patL
              strain could still infect apples, but the intensity of symptoms was weaker compared with the wild‐type strain. A lower growth rate was observed in the PeΔ
              patL
              strain when this strain was grown on nine of the 13 apple varieties tested. In the complemented PeΔ
              patL
              :
              patL
              strain, the ability to grow normally in apple and the production of patulin were restored. Our results clearly demonstrate that patulin is not indispensable in the initiation of the disease, but acts as a cultivar‐dependent aggressiveness factor for
              P. expansum
              . This conclusion was strengthened by the fact that the addition of patulin to apple infected by the PeΔ
              patL
              mutant restored the normal fungal colonization in apple.

data.note:
这篇文章研究了苹果青霉病中，patulin作为一种与苹果品种相关的侵袭性因子，如何促进Penicillium expansum对苹果的侵染。

研究背景

  1. ​**背景介绍:**​
    这篇文章的研究背景是苹果青霉病，由Penicillium expansum引起，与patulin污染有关。Patulin是一种全球范围内受到监管的真菌毒素，对苹果产品的质量有显著影响。尽管patulin的毒性已得到广泛研究，但其作为病原菌侵袭性因子的作用尚不明确。
  2. ​**研究内容:**​
    该问题的研究内容包括：通过基因敲除技术研究patulin在Penicillium expansum对苹果侵染中的作用，探讨其在不同苹果品种中的侵袭性影响。
  3. ​**文献综述:**​
    该问题的相关工作包括对其他真菌毒素如DON和T-toxin的研究，这些毒素在植物病原菌的致病性和侵袭性中起重要作用。已有研究表明，patulin可能在Penicillium expansum的致病性和侵袭性中发挥作用。

研究方法

这篇论文提出了通过基因敲除技术研究patulin在Penicillium expansum侵袭性中的作用。具体来说：

  • ​**基因敲除:**​
    通过转化基因替换盒ΔpatL，生成了patL基因缺失突变体Pe△patL1，并通过PCR和Southern blot验证其基因敲除效果。
  • ​**互补实验:**​
    通过将野生型patL基因转入Pe△patL1突变体，生成互补株Pe△patL:patL，以验证patL基因的功能。
  • ​**病原性研究:**​
    在13种苹果品种上进行病原性研究，比较野生型和突变体的侵染能力和症状严重程度。

实验设计

  • ​**基因敲除:**​
    使用S. cerevisiae进行同源重组，生成ΔpatL基因敲除盒，并将其转入Penicillium expansum。
  • ​**病原性研究:**​
    在13种苹果品种上进行病原性研究，包括直接消费用的甜苹果和用于生产苹果酒的苹果品种。通过测量腐烂斑点的直径、生长速率和腐烂体积来评估病原体的侵袭性。
  • ​**patulin生产:**​
    在苹果果肉中提取并定量patulin，使用HPLC-DAD进行分析。

结果与分析

  • ​**基因敲除效果:**​
    ΔpatL突变体Pe△patL1不能产生patulin，且pat基因簇的表达显著降低。
  • ​**病原性研究:**​
    Pe△patL1突变体仍能感染苹果，但症状严重程度较野生型低。在某些苹果品种上，突变体的生长速率显著低于野生型。
  • ​**patulin的影响:**​
    在苹果感染Pe△patL1突变体后添加patulin，恢复了突变体的正常侵染能力，表明patulin作为侵袭性因子在大多数苹果品种中起作用。

结论

这篇论文的研究结果表明，patulin不是Penicillium expansum引起疾病的必需因素，但在大多数苹果品种中作为一种侵袭性因子发挥作用。这一结论通过在不同苹果品种上的实验得到了验证，并通过补充实验进一步支持了这一观点。研究表明，patulin在真菌对植物组织的侵染过程中具有重要的生物学功能。

这篇论文为理解patulin在Penicillium expansum侵袭性中的作用提供了新的见解，并强调了其在不同苹果品种中的影响差异。

data.title: Sequencing, physical organization and kinetic expression of the patulin biosynthetic gene cluster from Penicillium expansum
data.abstractNote: Patulin is a polyketide-derived mycotoxin produced by numerous ﬁlamentous fungi. Among them, Penicillium expansum is by far the most problematic species. This fungus is a destructive phytopathogen capable of growing on fruit, provoking the blue mold decay of apples and producing signiﬁcant amounts of patulin. The biosynthetic pathway of this mycotoxin is chemically well-characterized, but its genetic bases remain largely unknown with only few characterized genes in less economic relevant species. The present study consisted of the identiﬁcation and positional organization of the patulin gene cluster in P. expansum strain NRRL 35695. Several ampliﬁcation reactions were performed with degenerative primers that were designed based on sequences from the orthologous genes available in other species. An improved genome Walking approach was used in order to sequence the remaining adjacent genes of the cluster. RACE-PCR was also carried out from mRNAs to determine the start and stop codons of the coding sequences. The patulin gene cluster in P. expansum consists of 15 genes in the following order: patH, patG, patF, patE, patD, patC, patB, patA, patM, patN, patO, patL, patI, patJ, and patK. These genes share 60–70% of identity with orthologous genes grouped differently, within a putative patulin cluster described in a non-producing strain of Aspergillus clavatus. The kinetics of patulin cluster genes expression was studied under patulin-permissive conditions (natural apple-based medium) and patulin-restrictive conditions (Eagle's minimal essential medium), and demonstrated a signiﬁcant association between gene expression and patulin production. In conclusion, the sequence of the patulin cluster in P. expansum constitutes a key step for a better understanding of the mechanisms leading to patulin production in this fungus. It will allow the role of each gene to be elucidated, and help to deﬁne strategies to reduce patulin production in apple-based products.

这篇文章研究了Penicillium expansum中patulin生物合成基因簇的测序、物理组织和动力学表达。

研究背景

  1. ​**背景介绍:**​
    这篇文章的研究背景是patulin是一种由多种丝状真菌产生的多酮类毒素，其中Penicillium expansum是最具问题的物种之一。这种真菌能够生长在水果上，引发苹果的蓝霉腐烂，并产生大量的patulin。尽管patulin的生物合成途径在化学上已经得到了很好的表征，但其遗传基础仍然大部分未知。
  2. ​**研究内容:**​
    该研究旨在识别和定位Penicillium expansum菌株NRRL 35695中的patulin基因簇，并研究其在不同条件下的基因表达动力学。
  3. ​**文献综述:**​
    该问题的相关工作包括对其他物种中patulin生物合成基因簇的研究，如Aspergillus clavatus、Penicillium griseofulvum等。已有研究表明，patulin的生物合成途径涉及约10个酶促反应，并且在不同物种中存在基因簇的同源性。

研究方法

这篇论文提出了通过基因组学方法识别和分析Penicillium expansum中的patulin基因簇。具体来说，

  • ​**基因簇识别:**​
    通过使用基于其他物种中同源基因序列设计的退化引物进行PCR扩增，结合改进的基因组步行方法和RACE-PCR技术，识别和定位patulin基因簇。
  • ​**基因表达动力学分析:**​
    在patulin允许条件（天然苹果基培养基）和限制条件（Eagle's最小必需培养基）下，研究patulin基因簇的表达动力学。通过实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）分析基因表达水平，并通过HPLC分析patulin的产生量。

实验设计

  • ​**菌株培养:**​
    使用从法国朗格多克-鲁西永地区葡萄中分离的Penicillium expansum NRRL 35695菌株进行实验。菌株在PDA培养基上培养7天后，接种到含有酵母提取物-蔗糖（YES）培养基中进行液体培养。
  • ​**基因簇扩增:**​
    设计退化引物进行PCR扩增，使用基因组步行方法扩增相邻基因区域，并通过RACE-PCR确定编码序列的起始和终止密码子。
  • ​**基因表达分析:**​
    在苹果基培养基和Eagle's最小必需培养基中分别培养菌株，通过qRT-PCR分析patulin基因簇的表达水平，并通过HPLC分析patulin的产生量。

结果与分析

  • ​**基因簇结构:**​
    Penicillium expansum中的patulin基因簇包含15个基因，按顺序排列为patH, patG, patF, patE, patD, patC, patB, patA, patM, patN, patO, patL, patI, patJ, 和patK。这些基因与其他物种的同源基因具有60-70%的相似性。
  • ​**基因表达动力学:**​
    在patulin允许条件下，patulin基因簇的表达显著增加，并且patulin的产生量随着培养时间的延长而增加。在patulin限制条件下，patulin基因的表达受到抑制，patulin的产生量保持在较低水平。

结论

这篇论文通过对Penicillium expansum中patulin基因簇的测序和分析，揭示了其基因组织和表达动力学。研究结果表明，patulin基因簇的结构和表达模式在不同条件下有显著差异。这项研究为更好地理解patulin产生的机制提供了关键信息，并为减少苹果制品中patulin的产生提供了策略。

这篇论文为进一步研究patulin生物合成途径及其调控机制奠定了基础。

data.title: The gene PatG involved in the biosynthesis pathway of patulin, a food-borne mycotoxin, encodes a 6-methylsalicylic acid decarboxylase
data.abstractNote: Patulin is a mycotoxin produced by fungal genera such as Aspergillus, Penicillium and Byssochlamys. It induces neurological, gastrointestinal and immunological effects, which is why patulin belongs to a short list of mycotoxins whose level in food is regulated in many countries around the world. Recently, a cluster gathering 15 genes involved in the biosynthesis of patulin has been identiﬁed in Aspergillus clavatus, but so far, only 4 genes encoding 6-methylsalicylic acid synthase, m-cresol hydroxylase, m-hydroxybenzyl alcohol hydroxylase and isoepoxydon dehydrogenase have been characterized. Previous studies have shown the involvement of a decarboxylase in the transformation of 6-methylsalicylic acid, the ﬁrst stable patulin precursor, into m-cresol. In this study a putative decarboxylase gene, PatG, was identiﬁed in the genome sequence of A. clavatus. This gene is located near two P450 cytochrome genes PatH and PatI responsible respectively for the hydroxylation of m-cresol and m-hydroxybenzyl alcohol. This decarboxylase encoded by PatG (ACLA_093620) consists of 325 amino acids. The search for putative conserved domain revealed that the gene product belongs to the AminoCarboxyMuconate Semialdehyde Decarboxylase (ACMSD) related protein family. This family includes decarboxylases such as the γ-resorcylate decarboxylase or o-pyrocatechuate decarboxylase. The substrates of these enzymes display strong structural similarities with 6-methylsalicylic acid. PatG was strongly expressed during patulin production whereas it was very weakly expressed in non-patulin permissive conditions.

data.note:
研究背景

  1. ​研究问题：这篇文章研究了参与棒曲霉素（patulin）生物合成途径的基因PatG，特别是其在将6-甲基水杨酸转化为间甲酚（m-cresol）中的作用。
  2. ​研究难点：棒曲霉素是一种由多种真菌属（如曲霉属、青霉属和柱孢属）产生的有毒真菌化合物，对人体健康有严重的神经、胃肠道和免疫影响。尽管许多国家对其在食品中的含量进行了限制，但其生物合成途径尚未完全阐明。
  3. ​相关工作：之前的研究已经确定了棒曲霉素生物合成途径中的四个关键基因，分别编码6-甲基水杨酸合成酶、间甲酚羟化酶、间羟基苯甲醇羟化酶和异环氧丁烯脱氢酶。然而，涉及6-甲基水杨酸脱羧酶的基因尚未被识别。

研究方法

这篇论文提出了通过基因克隆和异源表达来鉴定和表征A. clavatus中6-甲基水杨酸脱羧酶（PatG）的方法。具体来说，

  1. ​基因克隆：首先，从A. clavatus NRRL 1980菌株中提取总RNA，并通过逆转录PCR（RT-PCR）和RACE-PCR技术获得PatG的cDNA序列。然后，将cDNA插入到pCR2.1-TOPO载体中，并在大肠杆菌TOP 10 F'菌株中进行扩增。
  2. ​基因表达分析：通过实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）分析PatG在不同生长条件下的表达情况，特别是在促进和抑制棒曲霉素生产的条件下。
  3. ​异源表达：将PatG基因插入到酵母表达载体pYES2.1/V5/His-Topo中，并在酿酒酵母S. cerevisiae InvSc1菌株中进行异源表达。通过Western blot确认蛋白质的表达，并通过高效液相色谱（HPLC）和液相色谱-质谱（LC-MS）分析转化产物。

实验设计

  1. ​菌株选择：选择了产生棒曲霉素的A. clavatus NRRL 1980菌株和非产生菌株NRRL 1，后者基因组已被测序。
  2. ​培养条件：在Czapek-葡萄糖琼脂平板上培养A. clavatus菌株，并在不同条件下（促进和抑制棒曲霉素生产）进行摇瓶培养。
  3. ​RNA提取和cDNA合成：从培养物中提取总RNA，并通过逆转录PCR获得cDNA。
  4. ​基因克隆和序列分析：使用特定引物进行PCR扩增，并通过RACE-PCR技术获得PatG的完整cDNA序列。
  5. ​异源表达和检测：将PatG基因插入到酵母表达载体中，并在酿酒酵母中进行异源表达。通过Western blot和HPLC分析转化产物。

结果与分析

  1. ​序列分析：PatG基因编码一个325个氨基酸的蛋白质，属于AminoCarboxyMuconate Semialdehyde Decarboxylase（ACMSD）相关蛋白家族。与已知的其他脱羧酶相比，PatG具有高度保守的结构特征。

  2. ​表达分析：在促进棒曲霉素生产的条件下（Czapek-葡萄糖培养基），PatG的表达显著增加，而在抑制条件下（Eagle's最小必需培养基），PatG的表达受到抑制。

  3. ​异源表达：在酵母中成功表达了PatG蛋白，并通过Western blot确认了其表达。转化后的酵母细胞能够将6-甲基水杨酸转化为间甲酚，且没有其他底物被转化。

  4. ​HPLC分析：通过HPLC分析，确认了转化产物的结构和保留时间，进一步验证了PatG的功能。

总体结论

这篇论文通过基因克隆和异源表达技术，首次鉴定并表征了棒曲霉素生物合成途径中的6-甲基水杨酸脱羧酶（PatG）。研究结果表明，PatG在将6-甲基水杨酸转化为间甲酚的过程中起关键作用，从而阐明了棒曲霉素生物合成途径的第二步。这一发现为进一步理解真菌产生毒素的机制提供了重要信息，并为减少苹果制品中的棒曲霉素含量提供了潜在策略。

论文评价

优点与创新

  1. ​基因克隆与表达：成功克隆并表达了A. clavatus中编码6-甲基水杨酸脱羧酶的PatG基因，并通过西方印迹法确认了其表达。
  2. ​功能验证：通过异源表达在酵母中验证了PatG蛋白的功能，确认其催化6-甲基水杨酸转化为间甲酚。
  3. ​生物转化实验：通过生物转化实验首次证实了6-甲基水杨酸是PatG酶的底物，进一步明确了Patulin生物合成途径的第二步。
  4. ​序列分析：对PatG基因进行了详细的序列分析，发现其属于AminoCarboxyMuconate Semialdehyde Decarboxylase（ACMSD）相关蛋白家族，并与已知的其他脱羧酶具有结构相似性。
  5. ​表达动态研究：研究了PatG在不同培养条件下的表达动态，发现其在促进Patulin生产的条件下强烈表达，而在非生产条件下表达较弱。

不足与反思

  1. ​途径不完整：尽管已明确了Patulin生物合成的前四步，但后六步的反应仍然不清楚，特别是gentiol转化为isoepoxydon以及phyllostin转化为neopatulin的过程。
  2. ​调控机制未知：论文提到需要继续研究真菌产生毒素的机制，以制定减少苹果制品中Patulin的策略。这表明对Patulin生物合成途径的调控机制了解还不够深入。

关键问题及回答

问题1：PatG基因在棒曲霉素生物合成途径中的具体作用是什么？

PatG基因编码的蛋白质是一个6-甲基水杨酸脱羧酶（6-methylsalicylic acid decarboxylase），在棒曲霉素生物合成途径中起到关键作用。具体来说，该酶将6-甲基水杨酸（6-MSAA）转化为间甲酚（m-cresol），这是棒曲霉素合成的第二个步骤。6-MSAA是棒曲霉素的前体之一，通过脱羧反应生成m-cresol，随后m-cresol进一步参与后续的生物合成步骤，最终形成成熟的棒曲霉素。

问题2：在实验中，如何验证PatG蛋白在酵母中的异源表达及其功能？

研究人员将PatG基因插入到酵母表达载体pYES2.1/V5/His-Topo中，并在酿酒酵母S. cerevisiae InvSc1菌株中进行异源表达。通过Western blot分析，确认了在酵母细胞中成功表达了PatG蛋白。为了验证PatG蛋白的功能，研究人员进行了转化后的酵母细胞的培养，并在培养基中添加6-甲基水杨酸作为底物。通过HPLC分析，发现转化后的酵母细胞能够将6-甲基水杨酸转化为间甲酚，且没有其他底物被转化，从而确认了PatG蛋白的功能。

问题3：PatG基因在不同生长条件下的表达情况如何？这对棒曲霉素的生产有何影响？

研究人员通过实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）分析了PatG基因在不同生长条件下的表达情况。在促进棒曲霉素生产的条件下（如Czapek-葡萄糖培养基），PatG的表达显著增加。相反，在抑制棒曲霉素生产的条件下（如Eagle's最小必需培养基），PatG的表达受到抑制。这表明PatG基因的表达与棒曲霉素的生产密切相关，其表达水平的提高可以促进棒曲霉素的合成。

data.title: Biosynthesis and Toxicological Effects of Patulin
data.abstractNote: Patulin is a toxic chemical contaminant produced by several species of mold, especially within Aspergillus, Penicillium and Byssochlamys. It is the most common mycotoxin found in apples and apple-derived products such as juice, cider, compotes and other food intended for young children. Exposure to this mycotoxin is associated with immunological, neurological and gastrointestinal outcomes. Assessment of the health risks due to patulin consumption by humans has led many countries to regulate the quantity in food. A full understanding of the molecular genetics of patulin biosynthesis is incomplete, unlike other regulated mycotoxins (aflatoxins, trichothecenes and fumonisins), although the chemical structures of patulin precursors are now known. The biosynthetic pathway consists of approximately 10 steps, as suggested by biochemical studies. Recently, a cluster of 15 genes involved in patulin biosynthesis was reported, containing characterized enzymes, a regulation factor and transporter genes. This review includes information on the current understanding of the mechanisms of patulin toxinogenesis and summarizes its toxicological effects.

data.note:
研究背景

  1. ​**背景介绍:**​
    这篇文章的研究背景是棒曲霉素是由几种霉菌（特别是青霉属、曲霉属和Byssochlamys属）产生的一种有毒化学污染物。它是苹果及其衍生产品中最常见的霉菌毒素之一，与免疫学、神经学和胃肠道效应有关。尽管许多国家已经对食品中的棒曲霉素含量进行了限制，但其分子遗传学的理解仍不完整。
  2. ​**研究内容:**​
    该问题的研究内容包括棒曲霉素的生物合成机制及其对宿主的毒理学效应。文章总结了棒曲霉素的生物合成途径、基因簇及其调控因素，并详细描述了其对动物和人体的毒性效应。
  3. ​**文献综述:**​
    该问题的相关工作包括对棒曲霉素生物合成途径的研究，特别是对其前体和酶活性的研究。已有研究表明，棒曲霉素的生物合成途径与其他霉菌毒素（如黄曲霉毒素、单端孢霉烯和伏马菌素）有所不同。近年来，研究人员在Aspergillus clavatus基因组中发现了与棒曲霉素生物合成相关的15个基因簇。

核心内容

  1. ​棒曲霉素的生物合成:

    • ​**前体和酶活性:**​ 棒曲霉素是一种聚酮代谢产物，其生物合成途径包括约10个步骤。第一步是由乙酰辅酶A和三个丙二酰辅酶A单元缩合形成6-甲基水杨酸（6MSA）。该过程由一个多功能酶催化，具有乙酰和丙二酰转移酶、酮酰合成酶、酮还原酶和脱水酶的活性。
    • ​**基因簇:**​ 最近在Aspergillus clavatus基因组中发现了一个包含15个基因的基因簇，这些基因涉及棒曲霉素的生物合成，包括酶、调节因子和转运蛋白基因。基因簇中还包括三个转运蛋白基因和一个ABC转运蛋白。

  2. ​棒曲霉素生物合成的调控:

    • ​**营养调控:**​ 培养基中的氮含量决定了棒曲霉素途径的表达。氮源的存在会抑制棒曲霉素的生物合成。锰对棒曲霉素的生物合成至关重要，影响转录和酶的协调出现。
    • ​**环境因素:**​ 培养基的pH值也会影响棒曲霉素的生物合成。温度和其他环境因素也可能对棒曲霉素的生物合成产生影响。

  3. ​棒曲霉素的毒性:

    • ​**急性毒性:**​ 在啮齿动物中，棒曲霉素的口服LD50介于29至55 mg/kg体重之间。家禽的敏感性较低，口服LD50为170 mg/kg体重。
    • ​**亚急性毒性:**​ 亚急性暴露会导致体重减轻、胃肠道变化和肾功能受损。重复剂量会导致神经毒性症状和酶抑制。
    • ​**遗传毒性:**​ 棒曲霉素在哺乳动物细胞中被认为是遗传毒性的，但在细菌中主要为阴性结果。研究表明，棒曲霉素能与巯基反应并诱导氧化损伤。
    • ​**致癌性:**​ 长期毒性研究表明，棒曲霉素在啮齿动物中未引起肿瘤。
    • ​**胚胎毒性和致畸性:**​ 棒曲霉素在高剂量下会引起胚胎吸收和畸形。在鸡胚中，棒曲霉素表现出胚胎毒性和致畸性。
    • ​**免疫毒性:**​ 棒曲霉素能改变宿主的免疫反应，抑制巨噬细胞功能和细胞因子分泌。

结论

这篇论文总结了棒曲霉素的生物合成机制及其对宿主的毒理学效应。尽管对棒曲霉素的生物合成途径有了更深入的理解，但其调控机制仍需进一步研究。棒曲霉素的毒性效应表明其在食品中的存在对人类健康构成威胁。未来的研究应集中在减少苹果产品在储存和处理过程中棒曲霉素的污染。

这篇论文为理解棒曲霉素的生物合成和毒性效应提供了重要的信息，有助于进一步研究和控制其在食品中的污染。

关键问题及回答

问题1：棒曲霉素的生物合成路径具体包括哪些步骤？

棒曲霉素的生物合成路径包括大约10个步骤，从6-甲基水杨酸（6MSA）开始，通过一系列酶促反应形成最终产物。具体步骤如下：

  1. ​6MSA的形成：通过一个多多功能酶将一个乙酰辅酶A和一个丙二酰辅酶A缩合，形成6-甲基水杨酸。
  2. ​脱羧反应：6-甲基水杨酸脱羧酶催化6MSA脱羧，生成m-cresol。
  3. ​羟基化反应：m-cresol被氧化成m-羟基苯甲醇。
  4. ​环氧化反应：m-羟基苯甲醇经过环氧化反应，生成isoepoxydon。
  5. ​进一步转化：isoepoxydon经过一系列转化，最终生成棒曲霉素。

这些步骤涉及多个酶的催化作用，包括乙酰和丙二酰转移酶、酮酰合成酶、酮还原酶和水解酶等。

问题2：棒曲霉素的生物合成基因簇是如何发现的？它包含了哪些关键基因？

棒曲霉素的生物合成基因簇是在A. clavatus基因组中发现的，包含15个基因。这些基因编码了参与棒曲霉素生物合成的酶、调控因子和转运蛋白。具体基因包括：

  1. ​6-甲基水杨酸合成酶（6MSAS）​：负责6-甲基水杨酸的合成。
  2. ​6-甲基水杨酸脱羧酶：催化6-甲基水杨酸脱羧，生成m-cresol。
  3. ​m-羟基苯甲醇脱氢酶：催化m-cresol的羟基化反应。
  4. ​其他酶：包括一些未知的功能基因，可能涉及后续的转化步骤。
  5. ​调控因子和转运蛋白：包括ABC转运蛋白、MFS转运蛋白和乙酸转运蛋白等，可能参与产物的转运和调控。

这个基因簇的发现为理解棒曲霉素的生物合成机制提供了重要线索。

问题3：棒曲霉素对哪些细胞和组织具有毒性，其毒性效应有哪些具体表现？

棒曲霉素对多种细胞和组织具有毒性，主要包括肠道、肾脏和免疫系统。其毒性效应具体表现如下：

  1. ​急性毒性：在啮齿类动物中，棒曲霉素的口服LD50在29到55 mg/kg之间。其毒性症状包括兴奋、抽搐、呼吸困难、肺充血、水肿、胃肠道溃疡和出血等。
  2. ​亚急性毒性：在鼠类中，反复给予棒曲霉素会导致体重减轻、胃肠道和肾脏变化、肾功能减退、神经毒性（如震颤、抽搐）以及肠道和脑组织中酶（如ATP酶）的抑制。
  3. ​遗传毒性：棒曲霉素在某些实验中显示出致突变性，尽管结果不一致。它在哺乳动物细胞中会引起染色体畸变和基因突变。
  4. ​致癌性：长期毒性研究表明，棒曲霉素未引起大鼠的肿瘤发生。
  5. ​胚胎毒性和致畸性：棒曲霉素对胚胎和胎儿具有毒性，可能导致胚胎吸收、发育迟缓、器官畸形等。
  6. ​免疫毒性：棒曲霉素能改变宿主的免疫响应，抑制巨噬细胞的蛋白质合成和功能，减少细胞因子的分泌，影响免疫细胞的活性和数量。

data.title: A gene having sequence homology to isoamyl alcohol oxidase is transcribed during patulin production in penicillium griseofulvum
data.abstractNote: The genes for the patulin biosynthetic pathway are most likely arranged in a cluster, as is often the case for other mycotoxins. With this in mind, GeneWalking has been performed to identify genes both upstream and downstream of the isoepoxydon dehydrogenase (idh) gene. A gene present in Penicillium griseofulvum NRRL 2159A had high sequence homology to the isoamyl alcohol oxidase (iao) gene and was detected downstream of the idh gene and in the same orientation. By virtue of the presence of a signal peptide sequence, the newly identified gene coded for a secreted protein with an FAD-binding domain and potential for N-glycosylation. An open reading frame consisted of 1946 nucleotides, containing four putative introns and encoding a 22 amino acid signal peptide. The 571 amino acid mature protein contained nine cysteine residues and had 11 potential N-linked glycosylation sites. Searches using GenBank indicated that Aspergillus terreus, A. oryzae, A. fumigatus, and Gibberella zeae contain genes coding for a putative isoamyl alcohol oxidase. When the translated query was compared with the translated database, the highest scores were seen with A. clavatus (E value of 0.00), A. fumigatus (E value of 8e−142), and A. oryzae and A. terreus (each having an E value of 2e−141). Reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction analysis confirmed that the iao gene was transcribed. The amplified products were sequenced for confirmation of their identities. This is the first report of an isoamyl alcohol oxidase gene in a species of the genus Penicillium.

data.title: Calbistrin E and two other new metabolites from an australian isolate of penicillium striatisporum
data.abstractNote: An Australian isolate of Penicillium striatisporum collected near Shalvey, New South Wales, exhibited selective antifungal activity against Candida albicans versus Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Bioassay-directed fractionation yielded members of the rare class of fungal metabolites known as the calbistrins. These included a new example of this structure class, calbistrin E (1), as well as the known polyenes calbistrin C (2) and deformylcalbistrin A (3). Also recovered from P. striatisporum were new triene and butenolide acids, striatisporin A (4) and striatisporolide A (5), together with the known fungal metabolites versiol (6) and (+)-hexylitaconic acid (7). Structures for all metabolites were determined by detailed spectroscopic analysis.

data.title: Molecular cloning and functional characterization of two CYP619 cytochrome P450s involved in biosynthesis of patulin in Aspergillus clavatus
data.abstractNote:
Patulin is an acetate-derived tetraketide mycotoxin produced by several fungal species, especially
              Aspergillus
              ,
              Penicillium
              and
              Byssochlamys
              species. The health risks due to patulin consumption by humans have led many countries to regulate it in human food. Previous studies have shown the involvement of cytochrome P450 monooxygenases in the hydroxylation of two precursors of patulin,
              m
              -cresol and
              m
              -hydroxybenzylalcohol. In the present study, two cytochrome P450 genes were identified in the genome sequence of
              Aspergillus clavatus
              , a patulin-producing species. Both mRNAs were strongly co-expressed during patulin production. CYP619C2, encoded by the first gene, consists of 529 aa, while the second cytochrome, CYP619C3, consists of 524 aa. The coding sequences were used to perform the heterologous expression of functional enzymes in
              Saccharomyces cerevisiae
              . The bioconversion assays showed that CYP619C3 catalysed the hydroxylation of
              m
              -cresol to yield
              m
              -hydroxybenzyl alcohol. CYP619C2 catalysed the hydroxylation of
              m
              -hydroxybenzyl alcohol and
              m
              -cresol to gentisyl alcohol and 2,5-dihydroxytoluene (toluquinol), respectively. Except for the last compound, all enzyme products are known precursors of patulin. Taken together, these data strongly suggest the involvement of CYP619C2 and CYP619C3 in the biosynthesis of patulin. CYP619C2 and CYP619C3 are located near to two other genes involved in patulin biosynthesis, namely the 6-methylsalicylic acid synthase (
              6msas
              ) and isoepoxydon dehydrogenase (
              idh
              ) genes. The current data associated with an analysis of the sequence of
              A. clavatus
              suggest the presence of a cluster of 15 genes involved in patulin biosynthesis.

data.note:
研究背景

  1. ​研究问题：这篇文章研究了在曲霉属（Aspergillus）中参与棒曲霉素（patulin）生物合成过程中的两种细胞色素P450酶（CYP619C2和CYP619C3）。棒曲霉素是一种由多种真菌物种产生的乙酸衍生的四酮类真菌毒素，对人体健康有潜在风险，因此许多国家对其在食品中的含量进行了规定。
  2. ​研究难点：该问题的研究难点包括：确定这两种CYP酶在棒曲霉素生物合成中的具体作用，以及通过异源表达验证这些酶的功能。
  3. ​相关工作：已有研究表明，细胞色素P450单加氧酶参与了棒曲霉素前体物质的羟基化反应。然而，棒曲霉素生物合成相关的基因簇尚未被描述。之前的研究仅鉴定了少数与棒曲霉素生物合成相关的基因，如6-甲基水杨酸合酶（6MSAS）和异环氧蒽醌脱氢酶（IDH）。

研究方法

这篇论文提出了通过克隆和异源表达两种CYP酶来研究其在棒曲霉素生物合成中的作用。具体来说，

  1. ​基因克隆：首先，从A. clavatus菌株中克隆了两个CYP酶的编码序列。使用RACE-PCR技术从RNA样本中扩增了这两个基因的5'和3'非翻译区（UTR），然后确定了完整的编码序列。

  2. ​异源表达：将这两个基因的编码序列插入到酵母表达载体pYES2.1/V5/His-Topo中，并在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中进行异源表达。通过添加半乳糖诱导表达，并使用抗V5抗体进行西方印迹分析确认蛋白质的表达。

  3. ​功能验证：通过HPLC和LC-MS/MS分析，验证了这两个CYP酶在转化实验中的活性。具体来说，测试了m-甲酚、m-羟基苯甲醇和m-羟基苯甲醛等底物，观察到了相应的转化产物。

实验设计

  1. ​数据收集：从A. clavatus菌株中提取RNA，并通过RACE-PCR技术扩增两个CYP酶的5'和3'UTR。

  2. ​实验设计：在允许棒曲霉素生产的条件下（Czapek-葡萄糖培养基），通过实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）分析CYP酶的表达动力学，并通过HPLC检测棒曲霉素的产量。

  3. ​样本选择：选择了A. clavatus菌株NRRL 1980进行实验，因为该菌株已被证明能够产生棒曲霉素。
  4. ​参数配置：在异源表达实验中，使用半乳糖作为诱导剂，通过SDS-PAGE和西方印迹分析确认蛋白质的表达。

结果与分析

  1. ​基因序列分析：通过RACE-PCR技术，确定了两个CYP酶的完整编码序列。CYP619C2由529个氨基酸组成，而CYP619C3由524个氨基酸组成。
  2. ​表达动力学：在允许棒曲霉素生产的条件下，CYP619C2和CYP619C3的表达水平随时间增加，与棒曲霉素的浓度变化模式相似。在限制性条件下，这两个基因的表达保持在基础水平，棒曲霉素的产量也极低。
  3. ​异源表达和功能验证：在酵母中成功表达了CYP619C2和CYP619C3，并通过HPLC和LC-MS/MS分析验证了其催化活性。CYP619C3催化m-甲酚转化为m-羟基苯甲醇，而CYP619C2催化m-羟基苯甲醇转化为龙胆醇和m-甲酚转化为2,5-二羟基甲苯（toluquinol）。

总体结论

这篇论文通过克隆和异源表达两个CYP酶，阐明了它们在棒曲霉素生物合成中的作用。研究结果表明，CYP619C3催化m-甲酚转化为m-羟基苯甲醇，而CYP619C2催化m-羟基苯甲醇转化为龙胆醇和m-甲酚转化为toluquinol。这些发现为理解棒曲霉素的生物合成途径提供了新的见解，并为减少苹果和其他食品/饲料产品中的棒曲霉素污染提供了潜在的分子策略。

论文评价

优点与创新

  1. ​基因克隆与表达：成功克隆并表达了两个CYP619家族成员（CYP619C2和CYP619C3）的基因，并在酿酒酵母中进行了异源表达。
  2. ​功能验证：通过生物转化实验验证了这两个酶在patulin生物合成中的作用，特别是CYP619C3催化m-cresol转化为m-羟基苯乙醇，而CYP619C2催化m-羟基苯乙醇和m-cresol转化为gentisyl alcohol和2,5-二羟基甲苯（toluquinol）。
  3. ​基因簇分析：发现了包含15个基因的patulin生物合成基因簇，这些基因在A. clavatus基因组中紧密排列，表明这些基因在生物合成过程中可能协同作用。
  4. ​序列比对与保守结构：通过序列比对和保守结构分析，确认了这两个CYP酶的保守结构特征，并预测了其膜锚定区域和血红素结合环。
  5. ​表达动态研究：通过实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）研究了这两个CYP酶在不同生长条件下的表达动态，发现它们在支持patulin生产的条件下表达水平较高。

不足与反思

  1. ​局限性：尽管论文中验证了CYP619C2和CYP619C3在patulin生物合成中的作用，但仍有部分代谢产物（如m-羟基苯甲醛）未能被这些酶转化，需要进一步研究其代谢途径。
  2. ​下一步工作：计划对PatE和PatG进行破坏分析，以验证它们在patulin生物合成中的具体作用。此外，还需要进一步研究其他未鉴定酶的功能，以完善patulin的生物合成途径。

关键问题及回答

问题1：CYP619C2和CYP619C3在A. clavatus中的具体表达模式是怎样的？

在允许棒曲霉素生产的条件下（Czapek-葡萄糖培养基），CYP619C2和CYP619C3的表达水平随时间增加，与棒曲霉素的浓度变化模式相似。具体来说，在培养的第3天，棒曲霉素开始出现在色谱图上，此时提取RNA并分析CYP酶的表达，发现这两个基因的表达水平显著上升。相反，在限制性条件下（MEM培养基+5%胎牛血清，且摇瓶培养），这两个基因的表达保持在基础水平，棒曲霉素的产量也极低。这表明CYP619C2和CYP619C3的表达与棒曲霉素的生物合成密切相关。

问题2：CYP619C2和CYP619C3在异源表达系统中是否成功表达，并且其催化活性如何验证？

是的，CYP619C2和CYP619C3在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中成功表达了。具体步骤包括将这两个基因的编码序列插入到酵母表达载体pYES2.1/V5/His-Topo中，并在半乳糖诱导下进行表达。通过SDS-PAGE和西方印迹分析确认了蛋白质的表达。进一步的HPLC和LC-MS/MS分析显示，CYP619C3能够催化m-甲酚转化为m-羟基苯甲醇，而CYP619C2能够催化m-羟基苯甲醇转化为龙胆醇和m-甲酚转化为2,5-二羟基甲苯（toluquinol）。这些结果验证了这两个CYP酶在棒曲霉素生物合成中的催化功能。

问题3：棒曲霉素的生物合成途径中，CYP619C2和CYP619C3分别催化哪些步骤？

在棒曲霉素的生物合成途径中，CYP619C3催化m-甲酚转化为m-羟基苯甲醇。随后，CYP619C2催化m-羟基苯甲醇转化为龙胆醇。此外，CYP619C2还能催化m-甲酚转化为2,5-二羟基甲苯（toluquinol）。这些步骤表明，CYP619C2和CYP619C3在棒曲霉素的生物合成过程中起到了关键的催化作用，推动了该毒素的合成。

    1. ​研究问题：这篇文章研究了从澳大利亚新南威尔士州沙利维附近采集的一种不寻常的青霉菌（Penicillium striatisporum）的代谢产物，特别是其对白色念珠菌（Candida albicans）的选择性抗真菌活性。
    2. ​研究难点：该研究的难点在于这种青霉菌的代谢产物种类繁多且结构复杂，特别是其中的calcistrins类代谢产物不稳定，分离和表征具有挑战性。
    3. ​相关工作：之前的研究表明，P. striatisporum在日本的专利中被报道产生两种肿瘤抑制剂，但其化学结构未分配。此外，P. restrictum被报道产生两类抗真菌多环化合物（calcitrins和restricticins）以及具有血管紧张素II抑制活性的azaphilone型抗生素。

    研究方法

    这篇论文提出了通过生物活性导向的分离方法来研究P. striatisporum的代谢产物。具体来说，

    1. ​真菌培养：从澳大利亚新南威尔士州沙利维附近采集土壤样本，分离出P. striatisporum菌株MST-F9530。该菌株在含有小麦的培养基上培养21天，温度为28°C。
    2. ​抗真菌活性测定：采用琼脂基微孔板法测定菌株对白色念珠菌和酿酒酵母的抗真菌活性。将发酵液稀释后应用于含有测试化合物的琼脂矩阵上，28°C孵育24小时后评估酵母生长情况。
    3. ​提取和分离：将发酵物用甲醇提取，浓缩后通过C18固相萃取柱和高效液相色谱（HPLC）进行分离。通过分析LC/MS和NMR数据，鉴定出多种代谢产物，包括新的calcistrin E(1)和其他已知代谢产物。

    实验设计

    1. ​数据收集：从澳大利亚新南威尔士州沙利维附近采集土壤样本，分离出P. striatisporum菌株MST-F9530。
    2. ​样本选择：选择P. striatisporum菌株MST-F9530进行详细化学分析，因为其在之前的研究中显示出对白色念珠菌的选择性抗真菌活性。
    3. ​参数配置：在HPLC分离过程中，使用0.01% TFA作为恒定水平的洗脱剂，通过梯度洗脱分离代谢产物。

    结果与分析

    1. ​抗真菌活性：P. striatisporum菌株MST-F9530对白色念珠菌表现出显著的抗真菌活性（MIC为128），而对酿酒酵母无活性（MIC为0）。
    2. ​代谢产物鉴定：通过HPLC和LC/MS分析，鉴定出多种代谢产物，包括calcistrin C(2)、deformylcalbistrin A(3)、calcistrin E(1)、striatisporin A(4)、striatisporolide A(5)、versiol和(+)-hexylitaconic acid。

    3. ​结构分析：通过高分辨率质谱（HRESI-MS）、一维和二维核磁共振（NMR）数据分析，确定了新化合物的结构。例如，calcistrin E(1)的分子式为C31H38O7，其结构为一个三环去氢的calcistrin A(8)类似物。

    总体结论

    这项研究揭示了一种来自澳大利亚的P. striatisporum菌株能够产生独特的次级代谢产物，这些代谢产物在结构上与已知的calcitrins类化合物有相似之处。特别是，calcistrin E(1)的发现扩展了calcitrin分子骨架的范围。研究表明，calcitrins的抗真菌活性可能仅与双环单元（即versiol）相关，而不是多环侧链。这一发现为进一步研究这些代谢产物的生物活性和潜在应用提供了基础。

    论文评价

    优点与创新

    1. ​新化合物的发现：论文从澳大利亚分离的Penicillium striatisporum中发现了三种新的代谢产物，包括calibistrin E(1)、striatisporin A(4)和striatisporolide A(5)。
    2. ​选择性抗真菌活性：该菌株对Candida albicans表现出选择性抗真菌活性，而对Saccharomyces cerevisiae无活性，这一特性与次级代谢产物的产生水平相关。
    3. ​详细的结构分析：通过高分辨率质谱和核磁共振数据，详细确定了所有代谢产物的结构。
    4. ​生物合成途径的推测：通过对新化合物的结构分析，提出了这些化合物可能的生物合成途径。
    5. ​与已知化合物的关联：新发现的化合物与已知的calcitrins结构类具有相似性，为进一步研究其生物活性和合成机制提供了基础。

    不足与反思

    1. ​光、碱和非质子溶剂的不稳定性：calcitrins已知对光、碱和非质子溶剂不稳定，这增加了分离和表征的难度。
    2. ​绝对立体化学的未确定：尽管对新化合物的相对立体化学进行了推测，但其绝对立体化学尚未确定，需要进一步的研究来验证。
    3. ​进一步的生物活性研究：虽然新发现的化合物显示出有前途的生物活性，但需要进一步的实验来确定其在体内的效果和应用潜力。

    关键问题及回答

    问题1：在分离和表征calcistrin E(1)时，使用了哪些具体的分析技术？

    1. ​高分辨率电喷雾正离子模式质谱（HRESI(+)MS）​：通过HRESI(+)MS分析，确定了calcistrin E(1)的分子公式为C31H38O7，并确认了其作为calcistrin A(8)的去氢类似物的结构。
    2. ​一维和二维核磁共振（NMR）​：通过CD3OD溶剂下的1H和13C NMR数据分析，详细确定了calcistrin E(1)的结构。特别是，COSY和gHMBC相关序列帮助明确了侧链和骨架碳原子的连接方式。
    3. ​其他光谱数据：包括UV和IR光谱数据，虽然未在摘要中详细提及，但这些数据也用于辅助确认化合物的结构。

    问题2：P. striatisporum菌株MST-F9530对哪些真菌表现出抗真菌活性？其活性如何？

    P. striatisporum菌株MST-F9530对白色念珠菌（Candida albicans）表现出显著的抗真菌活性，其最低抑菌浓度（MIC）为128。然而，该菌株对酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）无活性，MIC为0。这表明P. striatisporum对这两种真菌具有选择性抗真菌活性。

    问题3：calcistrins类代谢产物的不稳定性是如何影响其分离和表征的？

    calcistrins类代谢产物具有不稳定性，容易受到光、碱和无质子溶剂的影响而降解。这种不稳定性在分离和表征过程中带来了多重挑战：

    1. ​分离难度：由于calcistrins在提取和分离过程中容易降解，研究者需要采用温和的提取和分离条件，如使用甲醇提取并在真空中浓缩，以尽量减少降解。
    2. ​表征复杂性：不稳定性使得通过NMR和MS等光谱技术进行结构表征变得更加复杂。例如，calcistrin A(8)在碱性条件下会经历底物介导的逆醛醇降解生成deformylcalbistrin A(3)。
    3. ​保存和操作要求：在实验过程中，calcistrins需要在避光、低温和无质子溶剂的环境中保存和操作，以确保其稳定性和完整性。

    这些挑战增加了calcistrins类代谢产物分离和表征的难度，但也为研究者提供了更多的技术和方法来探索和优化其分离和表征过程。

data.title: Ecology and genomics of actinobacteria: New concepts for natural product discovery
data.abstractNote: Actinobacteria constitute a highly diverse bacterial phylum with an unrivalled metabolic versatility. They produce most of the clinically used antibiotics and a plethora of other natural products with medical or agricultural applications. Modern ‘omics’-based technologies have revealed that the genomic potential of Actinobacteria greatly outmatches the known chemical space. In this Review, we argue that combining insights into actinobacterial ecology with state-of-the-art computational approaches holds great promise to unlock this unexplored reservoir of actinobacterial metabolism. This enables the identification of small molecules and other stimuli that elicit the induction of poorly expressed biosynthetic gene clusters, which should help reinvigorate screening efforts for their precious bioactive natural products.

data.title: Discovery of fungal onoceroid triterpenoids through domainless enzyme-targeted global genome mining
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            Genomics-guided methodologies have revolutionized the discovery of natural products. However, a major challenge in the field of genome mining is determining how to selectively extract biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) for untapped natural products from numerous available genome sequences. In this study, we developed a fungal genome mining tool that extracts BGCs encoding enzymes that lack a detectable protein domain (i.e., domainless enzymes) and are not recognized as biosynthetic proteins by existing bioinformatic tools. We searched for BGCs encoding a homologue of Pyr4-family terpene cyclases, which are representative examples of apparently domainless enzymes, in approximately 2000 fungal genomes and discovered several BGCs with unique features. The subsequent characterization of selected BGCs led to the discovery of fungal onoceroid triterpenoids and unprecedented onoceroid synthases. Furthermore, in addition to the onoceroids, a previously unreported sesquiterpene hydroquinone, of which the biosynthesis involves a Pyr4-family terpene cyclase, was obtained. Our genome mining tool has broad applicability in fungal genome mining and can serve as a beneficial platform for accessing diverse, unexploited natural products.

data.title: De novo production of protoberberine and benzophenanthridine alkaloids through metabolic engineering of yeast
data.abstractNote: Protoberberine alkaloids and benzophenanthridine alkaloids (BZDAs) are subgroups of benzylisoquinoline alkaloids (BIAs), which represent a diverse class of plant-specialized natural metabolites with many pharmacological properties. Microbial biosynthesis has been allowed for accessibility and scalable production of high-value BIAs. Here, we engineer Saccharomyces cerevisiae to de novo produce a series of protoberberines and BZDAs, including palmatine, berberine, chelerythrine, sanguinarine and chelirubine. An ER compartmentalization strategy is developed to improve vacuole protein berberine bridge enzyme (BBE) activity, resulting in >200% increase on the production of the key intermediate (S)-scoulerine. Another promiscuous vacuole protein dihydrobenzophenanthridine oxidase (DBOX) has been identified to catalyze two-electron oxidation on various tetrahydroprotoberberines at N7-C8 position and dihydrobenzophenanthridine alkaloids. Furthermore, cytosolically expressed DBOX can alleviate the limitation on BBE. This study highlights the potential of microbial cell factories for the biosynthesis of a diverse group of BIAs through engineering of heterologous plant enzymes.

data.title: Discovery of Key Dioxygenases that Diverged the Paraherquonin and Acetoxydehydroaustin Pathways in Penicillium brasilianum
data.abstractNote: Paraherquonin (1), a fungal meroterpenoid produced by Penicillium brasilianum NBRC 6234, possesses a unique, highly congested hexacyclic molecular architecture. Here we identified the biosynthetic gene cluster of 1 (the prh cluster) and elucidated the pathway up to berkeleydione (2), which serves as the key intermediate for the biosynthesis of 1 as well as many other meroterpenoids. Interestingly, the nonheme iron and α-ketoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase PrhA constructs the cycloheptadiene moiety to afford 2 from preaustinoid A1 (6), probably via the homoallyl-homoallyl radical rearrangement. Additionally, another fungal strain, P. brasilianum MG11, which produces acetoxydehydroaustin instead of 1, was found to have a gene cluster nearly identical to the prh cluster. The dioxygenase encoded by the cluster shares 92% sequence identity with PrhA, and also accepts 6 but produces preaustinoid A3 (17) with a spiro-lactone system, generating a diverging point for the two different meroterpenoid pathways in the same species.

data.title: Genome-Based Discovery of an Unprecedented Cyclization Mode in Fungal Sesterterpenoid Biosynthesis
data.abstractNote: Sesterterpenoids are a group of terpenoid natural products that are primarily biosynthesized via cyclization of the C25 linear substrate geranylfarnesyl pyrophosphate (GFPP). Although the long carbon chain of GFPP in theory allows for many different cyclization patterns, sesterterpenoids are relatively rare species among terpenoids, suggesting that many intriguing sesterterpenoid scaffolds have been overlooked. Meanwhile, the recent identification of the first sesterterpene synthase has allowed the discovery of new sesterterpenoids by the genome mining approach. In this study, we characterized the unusual fungal sesterterpene synthase EvQS and successfully obtained the sesterterpene quiannulatene (1) with a novel and unique highly congested carbon skeleton, which is further oxidized to quiannulatic acid (2) by the cytochrome P450 Qnn-P450. A mechanistic study of its cyclization from GFPP indicated that the biosynthesis employs an unprecedented cyclization mode, which involves three rounds of hydride shifts and two successive C–C bond migrations to construct the 5-6-5-5-5 fused ring system of 1.

data.title: An unusual chimeric diterpene synthase from emericella variecolor and its functional conversion into a sesterterpene synthase by domain swapping
data.abstractNote: Di- and sesterterpene synthases produce C20 and C25 isoprenoid scaffolds from geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate (GGPP) and geranylfarnesyl pyrophosphate (GFPP), respectively. By genome mining of the fungus Emericella variecolor, we identified a multitasking chimeric terpene synthase, EvVS, which has terpene cyclase (TC) and prenyltransferase (PT) domains. Heterologous gene expression in Aspergillus oryzae led to the isolation of variediene (1), a novel tricyclic diterpene hydrocarbon. Intriguingly, in vitro reaction with the enzyme afforded the new macrocyclic sesterterpene 2 as a minor product from dimethylallyl pyrophosphate (DMAPP) and isopentenyl pyrophosphate (IPP). The TC domain thus produces the diterpene 1 and the sesterterpene 2 from GGPP and GFPP, respectively. Notably, a domain swap of the PT domain of EvVS with that of another chimeric sesterterpene synthase, EvSS, successfully resulted in the production of 2 in vivo as well. Cyclization mechanisms for the production of these two compounds are proposed.

data.title: Redox Out of the Box: Catalytic Versatility Across NAD(P)H-Dependent Oxidoreductases
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            The asymmetric reduction of double bonds using NAD(P)H‐dependent oxidoreductases has proven to be an efficient tool for the synthesis of important chiral molecules in research and on industrial scale. These enzymes are commercially available in screening kits for the reduction of C=O (ketones), C=C (activated alkenes), or C=N bonds (imines). Recent reports, however, indicate that the ability to accommodate multiple reductase activities on distinct C=X bonds occurs in different enzyme classes, either natively or after mutagenesis. This challenges the common perception of highly selective oxidoreductases for one type of electrophilic substrate. Consideration of this underexplored potential in enzyme screenings and protein engineering campaigns may contribute to the identification of complementary biocatalytic processes for the synthesis of chiral compounds. This review will contribute to a global understanding of the promiscuous behavior of NAD(P)H‐dependent oxidoreductases on C=X bond reduction and inspire future discoveries with respect to unconventional biocatalytic routes in asymmetric synthesis.

data.title: Uncovering the Unusual D-Ring Construction in Terretonin Biosynthesis by Collaboration of a Multifunctional Cytochrome P450 and a Unique Isomerase
data.abstractNote: Terretonin (1) is a fungal meroterpenoid isolated from Aspergillus terreus, and possesses a highly oxygenated and unique tetracyclic structure. Although the biosynthetic gene cluster for 1 has been identified and the biosynthesis has recently been studied by heterologous reconstitution and targeted-gene deletion experiments, the last few steps of the terretonin pathway after terrenoid (6) have yet to be elucidated. Notably, the mechanism for the D-ring expansion to afford the terretonin scaffold has been a long-standing mystery to solve. Here we report the characterization of three enzymes that convert 6 into 1, as well as the complete biosynthetic pathway of 1. In the proposed terretonin pathway, the cytochrome P450 Trt6 catalyzes three successive oxidations to transform 6 into an unstable intermediate, which then undergoes the D-ring expansion and unusual rearrangement of the methoxy group to afford the core skeleton of 1. This unprecedented rearrangement is catalyzed by a novel isomerase Trt14. Finally, the nonheme iron-dependent dioxygenase Trt7 accomplishes the last two oxidation reactions steps to complete the biosynthesis.

data.abstractNote: Andrastins (andrastin A-D), produced by several Penicillium species, exhibit inhibitory activity against ras farnesyltransferase, suggesting that these compounds could be promising leads for antitumor agents. Although the genome sequence of Penicillium chrysogenum, an andrastin-producing species, is available, the genetic and molecular bases for the biosynthesis of andrastins have not been elucidated. Here we report the identification and characterization of the gene cluster for andrastin biosynthesis. We reconstituted the biosynthetic pathway in Aspergillus oryzae, a fungal expression host, by the co-expression of five genes, including that of a terpene cyclase, and of four genes encoding the tailoring enzymes, required for the generation of andrastins. Remarkably, we successfully obtained andrastin A, the most complex andrastin molecule, as the metabolite of nine gene products, thus confirming the potential of the fungal expression system to synthesize useful natural products.

data.title: Complete Biosynthetic Pathway of Anditomin: Nature’s Sophisticated Synthetic Route to a Complex Fungal Meroterpenoid
data.abstractNote: Anditomin and its precursors, andilesins, are fungal meroterpenoids isolated from Aspergillus variecolor and have unique, highly oxygenated chemical structures with a complex bridged-ring system. Previous isotope-feeding studies revealed their origins as 3,5-dimethylorsellinic acid and farnesyl pyrophosphate and suggested the possible involvement of a Diels–Alder reaction to afford the congested bicyclo[2.2.2]octane core structure of andilesins. Here we report the first identification of the biosynthetic gene cluster of anditomin and the determination of the complete biosynthetic pathway by characterizing the functions of 12 dedicated enzymes. The anditomin pathway actually does not employ a Diels–Alder reaction, but involves the nonheme iron-dependent dioxygenase AndA to synthesize the bridged-ring by an unprecedented skeletal reconstruction. Another dioxygenase, AndF, is also responsible for the structural complexification, generating the end product anditomin by an oxidative rearrangement.

data.title: Unusual chemistries in fungal meroterpenoid biosynthesis
data.abstractNote: Meroterpenoids are polyketide and terpenoid hybrid natural products with remarkable biological activities. Recent progress in fungal meroterpenoid biosynthesis has revealed several unusual enzyme reactions and novel enzymes, including unique terpene cyclization reactions by a novel family of membrane-bound terpene cyclases and post-cyclization modification reactions by oxygenases, such as non-heme iron-dependent dioxygenases, flavin adenine dinucleotide-dependent monooxygenases, and cytochrome P450 monooxygenases. They contribute to the structural diversification and increase in complexity of fungal meroterpenoids. Structure-function studies of these enzymes provide strategies for engineering the biosynthetic machinery to create novel molecular scaffolds for drug discovery.

data.title: Spiro-Ring Formation is Catalyzed by a Multifunctional Dioxygenase in Austinol Biosynthesis
data.abstractNote: Austinol, a fungal meroterpenoid derived from 3,5-dimethylorsellinic acid, has a unique chemical structure with a remarkable spiro-lactone ring system. Despite the recent identification of its biosynthetic gene cluster and targeted gene-deletion experiments, the process for the conversion of protoaustinoid A (2), the first tetracyclic biosynthetic intermediate, to the spiro-lactone preaustinoid A3 (7) has remained enigmatic. Here we report the mechanistic details of the enzyme-catalyzed, stereospecific spiro-lactone ring-forming reaction, which is catalyzed by a non-heme iron-dependent dioxygenase, AusE, along with two flavin monooxygenases, the 5′-hydroxylase AusB and the Baeyer–Villiger monooxygenase AusC. Remarkably, AusE is a multifunctional dioxygenase that is responsible for the iterative oxidation steps, including the oxidative spiro-ring-forming reaction, to produce the austinol scaffold.

data.title: Two Separate Gene Clusters Encode the Biosynthetic Pathway for the Meroterpenoids Austinol and Dehydroaustinol in Aspergillus nidulans
data.abstractNote: Meroterpenoids are a class of fungal natural products that are produced from polyketide and terpenoid precursors. An understanding of meroterpenoid biosynthesis at the genetic level should facilitate engineering of secondgeneration molecules and increasing production of firstgeneration compounds. The filamentous fungus Aspergillus nidulans has previously been found to produce two meroterpenoids, austinol and dehydroaustinol. Using targeted deletions that we created, we have determined that, surprisingly, two separate gene clusters are required for meroterpenoid biosynthesis. One is a cluster of four genes including a polyketide synthase gene, ausA. The second is a cluster of 10 additional genes including a prenyltransferase gene, ausN, located on a separate chromosome. Chemical analysis of mutant extracts enabled us to isolate 3,5-dimethylorsellinic acid and 10 additional meroterpenoids that are either intermediates or shunt products from the biosynthetic pathway. Six of them were identified as novel meroterpenoids in this study. Our data, in aggregate, allow us to propose a complete biosynthetic pathway for the A. nidulans meroterpenoids.

data.title: Reconstitution of a fungal meroterpenoid biosynthesis reveals the involvement of a novel family of terpene cyclases
data.abstractNote: Meroterpenoids are hybrid natural products of both terpenoid and polyketide origin. We identified a biosynthetic gene cluster that is responsible for the production of the meroterpenoid pyripyropene in the fungus Aspergillus fumigatus through reconstituted biosynthesis of up to five steps in a heterologous fungal expression system. The cluster revealed a previously unknown terpene cyclase with an unusual sequence and protein primary structure. The wide occurrence of this sequence in other meroterpenoid and indole–diterpene biosynthetic gene clusters indicates the involvement of these enzymes in the biosynthesis of various terpenoid-bearing metabolites produced by fungi and bacteria. In addition, a novel polyketide synthase that incorporated nicotinyl-CoA as the starter unit and a prenyltransferase, similar to that in ubiquinone biosynthesis, was found to be involved in the pyripyropene biosynthesis. The successful production of a pyripyropene analogue illustrates the catalytic versatility of these enzymes for the production of novel analogues with useful biological activities.

data.title: Two Iron(II), α-Ketoglutarate-Dependent Enzymes Encoded by the PPZ Gene Cluster of Metarhizium majus Enable Production of 8-Hydroxyperamine
data.abstractNote: Entomopathogenic fungus Metarhizium majus contains the nine-gene PPZ cluster, with ppzA, encoding a peramine-producing nonribosomal peptide synthetase, as the central component. In this work, the roles of two α-ketoglutarate, iron-dependent oxygenases encoded by the PPZ genes ppzC and ppzD were elucidated. PpzD was found to produce both trans-4-hydroxy-l-proline and trans-3-hydroxy-l-proline in a 13.1:1 ratio, yielding a key precursor for peramine biosynthesis. PpzC was found to act directly on peramine, yielding the novel analogue 8-hydroxyperamine.

data.title: Discovery of a Fungal P450 with an Unusual Two-Step Mechanism for Constructing a Bicyclo[3.2.2]nonane Skeleton
data.abstractNote: The successful biomimetic or chemoenzymatic synthesis of target natural products (NPs) and their derivatives relies on enzyme discovery. Herein, we discover a fungal P450 BTG5 that can catalyze the formation of a bicyclo[3.2.2]nonane structure through an unusual two-step mechanism of dimerization and cyclization in the biosynthesis of beticolin 1, whose bicyclo[3.2.2]nonane skeleton connects an anthraquinone moiety and a xanthone moiety. Further investigation reveals that BTG5-T318 not only determines the substrate selectivity but also alters the catalytic reactions, which allows the separation of the reaction to two individual steps, thereby understanding its catalytic mechanism. It reveals that the first heterodimerization undergoes the common oxidation process for P450s, while the second uncommon formal redox-neutral cyclization step is proved as a redox-mediated reaction, which has never been reported. Therefore, this work advances our understanding of P450-catalyzed reactions and paves the way for expansion of the diversity of this class of NPs through synthetic biology.

data.title: Biosynthesis of the Unusual Epoxy Isonitrile-Containing Antibiotics Aerocyanidin and Amycomicin
data.abstractNote: Aerocyanidin and amycomicin are two antibiotics derived from long-chain acids with a rare epoxy isonitrile moiety, the complexity of which renders the total synthesis of these two natural products rather challenging. How this functionality is biosynthesized has also remained obscure. While the biosynthetic gene clusters for these compounds have been identified, both appear to be deficient in genes encoding enzymes seemingly necessary for the oxidative modifications observed in these antibiotics. Herein, the biosynthetic pathways of aerocyanidin and amycomicin are fully elucidated. They share a conserved pathway to isonitrile intermediates that involves a bifunctional thioesterase and a nonheme iron α-ketoglutarate-dependent enzyme. In both cases, the isonitrile intermediates are then loaded onto an acyl carrier protein (ACP) catalyzed by a ligase. The isonitrile-tethered ACP is subsequently processed by polyketide synthase(s) to undergo chain extension, thereby assembling a long-chain γ-hydroxy isonitrile acid skeleton. The epoxide is installed by the cupin domain-containing protein AecF to conclude the biosynthesis of aerocyanidin. In contrast, three P450 enzymes AmcB, AmcC, and AmcQ are involved in epoxidation and keto formation to finalize the biosynthesis of amycomicin. These results thus explain the sequence of oxidation events that result in the final structures of aerocyanidin and amycomicin as well as the biosynthesis of the key γ-hydroxy epoxy isonitrile functional group.

data.title: Biosynthesis of dothideomins reveals a fungal P450 that constructs the tricyclo[5.2.2.0.4,8]undecane-imbedded core skeleton
data.abstractNote: Dothideomins are antibacterial bis(anthraquinone) polyketides isolated from the endophytic fungus Dothideomycetes sp. BMC-101, featuring a unique 6/6/6/5/6/6/6 heptacyclic scaffold imbedded with a tricyclo[5.2.2.0.4,8]undecane core. Although the structures and antibacterial potential are attractive, the biosynthesis process and the formation of a heptacyclic scaffold, especially the tricyclo[5.2.2.0.4,8]undecane cage-like core, are unclear. Here, we elucidated the biosynthesis of dothideomins C and D encoded by a dot gene cluster through heterologous expression, in vivo feeding experiments, and in vitro biochemical assays. Our findings reveal an enzyme cascade involved in the conversion of the precursor emodin into dothideomins. Specifically, the cytochrome P450 monooxygenase DotG is shown to solely catalyze the unprecedented formation of triple C–C bonds and construct the tricyclo[5.2.2.0.4,8]undecane-embedded skeleton. This study enhances the comprehension of the P450 enzyme-controlled formation of complex natural products.

data.title: Predicting the chemical space of fungal polyketides by phylogeny-based bioinformatics analysis of polyketide synthase-nonribosomal peptide synthetase and its modification enzymes
data.abstractNote: Fungal polyketide synthase (PKS)–nonribosomal peptide synthetase (NRPS) hybrids are key enzymes for synthesizing structurally diverse hybrid natural products (NPs) with characteristic biological activities. Predicting their chemical space is of particular importance in the field of natural product chemistry. However, the unexplored programming rule of the PKS module has prevented prediction of its chemical structure based on amino acid sequences. Here, we conducted a phylogenetic analysis of 884 PKS–NRPS hybrids and a modification enzyme analysis of the corresponding biosynthetic gene cluster, revealing a hidden relationship between its genealogy and core structures. This unexpected result allowed us to predict 18 biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) groups producing known carbon skeletons (number of BGCs; 489) and 11 uncharacterized BGC groups (171). The limited number of carbon skeletons suggests that fungi tend to select PK skeletons for survival during their evolution. The possible involvement of a horizontal gene transfer event leading to the diverse distribution of PKS–NRPS genes among fungal species is also proposed. This study provides insight into the chemical space of fungal PKs and the distribution of their biosynthetic gene clusters.

data.title: Next‐generation AMA1 ‐based plasmids for enhanced heterologous expression in filamentous fungi
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            
              Episomal AMA1‐based plasmids are increasingly used for expressing biosynthetic pathways and CRISPR/Cas systems in filamentous fungi cell factories due to their high transformation efficiency and multicopy nature. However, the gene expression from AMA1 plasmids has been observed to be highly heterogeneous in growing mycelia. To overcome this limitation, here we developed next‐generation AMA1‐based plasmids that ensure homogeneous and strong expression. We achieved this by evaluating various degradation tags fused to the auxotrophic marker gene on the AMA1 plasmid, which introduces a more stringent selection pressure throughout multicellular fungal growth. With these improved plasmids, we observed in
              Aspergillus nidulans
              a 5‐fold increase in the expression of a fluorescent reporter, a doubling in the efficiency of a CRISPRa system for genome mining, and a up to a 10‐fold increase in the production of heterologous natural product metabolites. This strategy has the potential to be applied to diverse filamentous fungi.

data.title: Novofumigatonin biosynthesis involves a non-heme iron-dependent endoperoxide isomerase for orthoester formation
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            
              Novofumigatonin (
              1
              ), isolated from the fungus
              Aspergillus novofumigatus
              , is a heavily oxygenated meroterpenoid containing a unique orthoester moiety. Despite the wide distribution of orthoesters in nature and their biological importance, little is known about the biogenesis of orthoesters. Here we show the elucidation of the biosynthetic pathway of
              1
              and the identification of key enzymes for the orthoester formation by a series of CRISPR-Cas9-based gene-deletion experiments and in vivo and in vitro reconstitutions of the biosynthesis. The novofumigatonin pathway involves endoperoxy compounds as key precursors for the orthoester synthesis, in which the Fe(II)/α-ketoglutarate-dependent enzyme NvfI performs the endoperoxidation. NvfE, the enzyme catalyzing the orthoester synthesis, is an Fe(II)-dependent, but cosubstrate-free, endoperoxide isomerase, despite the fact that NvfE shares sequence homology with the known Fe(II)/α-ketoglutarate-dependent dioxygenases. NvfE thus belongs to a class of enzymes that gained an isomerase activity by losing the α-ketoglutarate-binding ability.

data.title: Discovery of Pyranoviolin A and Its Biosynthetic Gene Cluster in Aspergillus violaceofuscus
data.abstractNote: A new polyketide-non-ribosomal peptide hybrid molecule, pyranoviolin A (1), was discovered from the genome-sequenced fungus Aspergillus violaceofuscus CBS 115571 and was characterized to be the first pyranonigrin analog harboring the C-3 methoxy group. Examination of the genome sequence of the fungus identified a putative biosynthetic gene cluster of 1, which was designated as the pyv cluster. The gene deletion experiment of the polyketide synthase (PKS)-non-ribosomal peptide synthetase (NRPS) hybrid gene in the cluster confirmed the involvement of the pyv cluster in the pyranoviolin A biosynthesis. Finally, a plausible biosynthetic route leading to 1 has been proposed based on the bioinformatic analysis. Our study indicates that metabolite analysis of genome-sequenced microorganisms whose metabolites have been largely unexplored facilitates the discovery of new secondary metabolites along with their biosynthetic gene clusters.

data.title: 小荚孢腔真菌中sporormielone类化合物生源途径及其生物合成基因簇的确定
data.abstractNote: 本课题组前期从一株来源于地衣Cladonia subulata(L.)Wigg.的内生真菌小荚孢腔菌Sporormiella minima(No.40-1-4-1)的大米固体发酵提取物中分离得到一个2,3,3b,4-tetramethylcyclopenta[a]indene-1,6,8(3a H,3b H,8a H)-trione新骨架化合物sporormielone A。通过文献检索,发现目前与sporormielone A结构相似的化合物仅报道了3个,它们都具有三环体系且含有二甲基环戊烯酮结构单元。有文献报道通过基因敲除方法或化学沟通方法推测这类化合物可能为苔色酸衍生物来源的聚酮,但其具体的生物合成研究尚未明确。另外本课题组前期同时从该菌(S.minima 40-1-4-1)的大米发酵提取物中还分离得到了一个与sporormielone A结构相似的倍半萜生物碱(S)-6-hydroxy-3,4a,5-trimethyl-4,4adihydro-1H-benzo[f]indole-2,7-dione,因而sporormielone A来源于聚酮还是萜途径尚不清楚。为了明确这类化合物的生源途径,揭示该类化合物的生物合成机制,本论文利用[1-13C]acetate、[2-13C]acetate为原料进行同位素底物喂养实验,通过多种现代色谱学技术分离获得被标记的目标化合物,并根据目标化合物中碳原子被标记的规律确定了sporormielone A为聚酮来源的化合物。在此基础上,本文通过全基因组序列分析和差异转录组分析锁定与sporormielone A生物合成相关的候选聚酮合酶基因,进而利用CRISPR/Cas9系统进行基因敲除实验确定了与sporormielone A生物合成相关的聚酮合酶基因为g7393,再结合差异转录组分析的结果推断了sporormielone A的生物合成基因簇。结合同位素标记的规律以及对sporormielone A生合成基因簇中部分基因功能的分析,最终推测出了sporormielone A可能的生物合成途径,为这类化合物的生物合成机制的阐明奠定了基础。

data.title: 呋喃甾体去甲氧绿胶霉素的生物合成机制研究
data.abstractNote: 呋喃甾体类化合物是一类结构特殊的五环甾体,其在甾体骨架的C-4和C-6位骈合一个额外的呋喃环,代表性的化合物包括渥曼青霉素（Wortmannin）,绿胶霉素（Viridin）,去甲氧绿胶霉素（Demethoxyviridin）。自1945年绿胶霉素被发现以来,大量研究表明这类化合物具有广谱的抗真菌活性,显著的抗炎活性以及抗细菌活性。尤其它们还是纳摩尔级别的磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶Phosphoinositide3-kinase（PI3K）抑制剂,渥曼青霉素更是作为工具药物被广泛使用,以其为原型开发的抗肿瘤药PX-866已经进入临床二期治疗。由于呋喃甾体类化合物的重要活性,吸引了化学家们不断对它们进行全合成研究,并且直到2017年才实现了渥曼青霉素和绿胶霉素的光学选择性全合成。但是,它们的生物合成机制至今却不清楚。目前仅仅通过同位素标记实验,证明呋喃甾体类化合物的生物合成前体和麦角甾醇一样都是羊毛甾醇,提示呋喃甾体类化合物很可能是从麦角甾醇生物合成途径分支而来。然而,人们一直未能在基因和酶水平揭示其生物合成机制。我们课题组前期发现了一株高产去甲氧绿胶霉素的真菌Nodulisporium sp.（65-12-7-1）,这为我们揭示呋喃甾体类化合物的生物合成途径提供了物质保障。基于去甲氧绿胶霉素高度氧化的特点,我们推测其生物合成过程中可能有多个细胞色素P450氧化酶参与。因此,我们对去甲氧绿胶霉素高产真菌Nodulisporium sp.（65-12-7-1）进行了全基因组测序,从中寻找P450酶成簇区域。然后利用差异表达分析和CRISPR-Cas9基因敲除法,我们首次鉴定了去甲氧绿胶霉素的生物合成基因簇,共包含19个基因。通过对其中的15个功能基因进行敲除,获得14个中间体,并以此阐明了去甲氧绿胶霉素完整的生物合成途径。如Figure 1所示:我们推测去甲氧绿胶霉素在麦角甾醇途径的分支点很可能发生在脱去第一个C4甲基之后,在3个P450氧化酶（Vid E,Vid G,Vid R）,一个短链脱氢还原酶（Vid O）,一个未知蛋白（Vid N）共同作用下,生成化合物14或15;乙二醛酶（Vid Q）氧化C-7α羟基生成7位为羰基的化合物13或19;未知蛋白（Vid S）能够发生1,4脱水反应,使半缩醛羟基脱去生成呋喃环;随后Baeyer-Villiger单氧化酶（Vid F）,酯酶（Vid P）和脱氢酶（Vid H）使C17-...

data.title: 极地真菌芳香族聚酮类化合物基因挖掘和生物合成途径研究
data.abstractNote: 青霉属真菌可以产生结构多样、生物学活性丰富的次级代谢产物,是临床重要的药源微生物。本课题前期从一株来自于极地植物Dryas octopetala的内生真菌Penicillium sp.MYA5中分离鉴定了7个芳香族聚酮类化合物（1～7）,分别具有铁载体、抗菌以及酶抑制的活性,从多方面提高Dryas octopetala抵抗极地恶劣环境的能力。这些芳香族聚酮类化合物是如何被合成的以及菌株是否有产生其他结构类型的芳香族聚酮类化合物的潜力,是本研究想探究的两个问题。主要的研究方法及结果如下: 1.Penicillium sp.MYA5的全基因组测序与次级代谢产物生物合成基因簇挖掘 方法:对Penicillium sp.MYA5进行全基因组测序、转录组测序以及生物信息学分析。结果:全基因组测序结果表明,Penicillium sp.MYA5的基因组大小约为32.8Mb,与次级代谢产物的生物合成、运输和分解代谢有关的蛋白质有302个,有64个功能未知的蛋白质。通过多个在线工具对次级代谢相关合成簇进行注释与分析,发现菌株有46个次级代谢基因簇,包含7个聚酮合酶（polyketide synthase,PKS）基因簇、20个非核糖体肽类合成（non-ribosomal peptide synthase,NRPS）基因簇、12个PKS-NRPS杂合基因簇、5个萜类基因簇以及2个吲哚类基因簇,其中cluster3.1、cluster5.2和cluster6.2是3个含有非还原聚酮合酶（non-reducing polyketide synthase,NR-PKS）的基因簇。进一步分析显示,cluster3.1有11个基因,长度为42 793 bp,与编码clavatol类化合物的基因簇Cla同一性为97%,可以认为,本研究前期获得的clavatol类化合物是由该基因簇负责合成的;Cluster5.2中有9个基因,长度为46 660 bp,其特点是同时含有NR-PKS、硫酯酶和后修饰酶,关键NR-PKS基因与P.expansum的mel A基因同一性为85%,但其余基因的同一性较低;Cluster6.2中有7个基因,长度为41732 bp,其特点是不含有后修饰酶,功能未知。转录组分析结果显示cluster3.1在PDB10中高表达,cluster5.2在目前所测试的几个培养条件下均不表达,cluster6.2在PDB10中表达,但表达量不高。 2.Penicillium sp.MYA5遗传转化体系的建立 方法:测试Penicillium sp.MYA5对潮霉素B和G418的抗性;摸索制备Penicillium sp.MYA5原生质体所需的孢子萌发时间、裂解酶配方、裂解时间和温度。采用PEG-Ca Cl2法,用质粒PBARGPE1验证该原生质体的有效性。结果:Penicillium sp.MYA5对G418和潮霉素B均敏感,G418的作用浓度为10μg/m L,潮霉素B的作用浓度为20μg/m L。Penicillium sp.MYA5原生质体制备的最佳条件为:菌丝体萌发14 h,裂解酶（Lysing enzyme from Aspergillus sp.）:溶壁酶（Yatalase）=3:2,28℃酶解14 h。抗性平板生长及PCR均验证了质粒PBARGPE1成功转入,说明菌株遗传转化体系建立成功。 3.Penicillium sp.MYA5芳香族聚酮类化合物生物合成关键基因的异源表达 方法:构建p YTU-6419和p YTU-6417重组质粒,通过菌落PCR、双酶切及测序进行验证;将重组质粒导入构巢曲霉,构建重组菌株A.LO8030::P.MYA5 6419和A.LO8030::P.MYA5 6419+6417重组菌株,通过菌落PCR、双酶切及测序进行验证;用色谱法和质谱法对重组菌株进行代谢产物的分离鉴定。结果:菌落PCR、双酶切及测序的结果均证实p YTU-6419和p YTP-6417重组质粒构建成功,导入构巢曲霉后,分别获得重组菌株A.LO8030::P.MYA5 6419和A.LO8030::P.MYA5 6419+6417。两株重组菌株的菌落颜色与空白构巢曲霉均明显不同,证明外源基因已成功地整合到宿主基因组中并实现了表达。A.LO8030::P.MYA5 6419发酵粗提物HPLC显示,色谱图上出现了3个新峰,分离得到2个单体化合物。HRESIMS显示,化合物8的分子量为161,分子式为C10H11NO,不饱和度为6,推测为7-methoxy-6-methyl-1H-isoindole;化合物9的分子量为176,分子式为C11H12O2,不饱和度为6,推测为5-methoxy-6-methyl-1H-isochromene。对A.LO8030::P.MYA5 6419+6417发酵粗提物进行HPLC分析发现,与A.LO8030::P.MYA5 6419相比,在保留时间30.1 min、36.9 min和24.0min三处的峰消失了,分别在保留时间23.0 min、24.5 min和25.6 min又出现了三处新的峰,提示gene06417的转入,产生了新的化合物。通过系统的分离手段,获得了1个单体化合物,通过对HRESIMS和核磁共振波谱的解析,确定为cichorine（化合物10）。 综上,本课题从极地植物Dryas octopetala内生真菌Penicillium sp.MYA5的基因组测序出发,不仅找到了3个与芳香族聚酮合成相关的NR-PKS基因簇,而且实现了gene06419在构巢曲霉中的异源表达以及gene06419和gene06417在构巢曲霉中的异源共表达并鉴定了3个代谢产物,还成功建立了Penicillium sp.MYA5遗传转化体系。以上结果为解析不同骨架结构的芳香族聚酮类化合物的生物合成途径奠定基础,为进一步挖掘极地青霉属真菌芳香族聚酮类化合物的合成潜力提供了实验依据,并有助于理解芳香族聚酮类化合物的产生与极地生物抵御恶劣自然环境的内在联系。 更多 还原 AbstractFilter('ChDivSummary', 'ChDivSummaryMore', data.title: 基于双硫酯化结构域策略的真菌非核糖体多肽合成酶拆分表达
data.abstractNote: 真菌非核糖体多肽天然产物是临床和农用药物的重要来源,然而,通过异源表达真菌多结构域巨型非核糖体多肽合成酶（NRPS）提高非核糖体肽产量或合成新型多肽面临着巨大的困难。为应对这个挑战,本论文基于双硫酯化结构域策略,设计开发了一种在异源表达宿主中拆分表达真菌巨型NRPS的方法,不仅提高了白僵菌素等多肽的产量,而且还合成了新颖多肽产物。具体研究结果如下: 1.发现双硫酯化结构域的拆分表达对白僵菌素的产量影响较小。以球孢白僵菌中的白僵菌素合成酶Bb BEAS为研究对象,其结构域的组织形式为C1-A1-T1-C2-A2-M-T2a-T2b-CT。在各个结构域的链接区域进行拆分,构成上下游拆分单元对（Splitting Unit Pair,SUP）,在酿酒酵母BJ5464-Npg A中异源表达后,计算白僵菌素产量。发现在双硫酯化结构域T2a-T2b中间拆分后对白僵菌素的产量影响最小,为野生型的88.13%。 2.构建Bb BEAS T1的人工双硫酯化结构域拆分单元对,提高了产物合成效率。将双硫酯化结构域拆分策略应用到对Bb BEAS的T1两侧的拆分,拆分单元对SUP-8(上游拆分单元为Bb BEAS-C1-A1-T1,下游拆分单元为T1-C2-A2-M-T2a-T2b-CT)在酿酒酵母BJ5464-Npg A中异源表达后,白僵菌素产率为野生型的86.26%,而单T1拆分单元对SUP-1-LNC(C1-A1,T1-C2-A2-M-T2a-T2b-CT)和SUP-2-LNC(C1-A1-T1,C2-A2-M-T2a-T2b-CT)的产量分别为野生型的66.18%和18.58%。 3.优化双硫酯化结构域拆分位点,提高了白僵菌素产量。对Bb BEAS拆分单元对SUP-8的下游拆分单元的起始位点进行改造,提高Bb BEAS拆分单元的产物合成效率。根据Alphafold2对Bb BEAS的三维结构预测,选择在Bb BEAS A1-T1之间的链接区α5及其附近选择氨基酸位点作为Bb BEAS SUP-8作为下游拆分单元起始位点。在酿酒酵母BJ5464-Npg A中异源表达系列相应拆分单元对,发现以α5螺旋上的R1009作为下游拆分单元的起始位点的拆分单元对Bb BEAS SUP-8-3,白僵菌素的产量最高,为野生型的147.45%。 4.双硫酯化结构域策略应用于其他非核糖体多肽合成酶,拆分表达效果明显。类白僵菌素合成酶Bb BSLS和蒽镰孢菌素合成酶ESYN与白僵菌素合成酶Bb BEAS具有相同的结构域组织形式,为C1-A1-T1-C2-A2-M-T2a-T2b-CT,在生物合成中,A1识别的底物均为α-D-羟基异戊酸。为评估双硫酯化表达策略的适用范围,首先基于优化的双硫酯化结构域拆分表达策略,将Bb BSLS与ESYN分别拆分为拆分单元对Bb BSLS SUP和ESYN SUP,在酿酒酵母BJ5464-Npg A中拆分表达后,产物产量分别为野生型的101.90%和143.31%。双硫酯化结构域拆分表达策略也适用于其他类型的非核糖体多肽合成酶,多肽cyclopeptin的合成酶Ps Vdo B结构域组成为A1-T1-C2-A2-T2-M-T2-CT,通过拆分并在构巢曲霉异源表达后,cyclopeptin产量为野生型的133.56%。 5.利用双硫酯化结构域拆分单元组合合成了新颖的多肽产物。PF1022A非核糖体多肽合成酶与白僵菌素合成酶Bb BEAS的结构域组织形式相同,PFSYN的A1结构域识别D-苯基乳酸,而Bb BEAS的A1结构域识别α-D-羟基异戊酸,将PFSYN上游拆分单元（PFSYN-C1-A1-T1）和Bb BEAS下游拆分单元(T1-C2-A2-M-T2a-T2b-CT)组合,在酿酒酵母BJ5464-Npg A中能够合成化合物5（D-Ph Lac-N-Me-L-Phe）和化合物6（D-Ph Lac-L-Phe）。将Bb BEAS识别α-D-羟基异戊酸的A1结构域替换为识别L-羟基异己酸、D-苯基乳酸和Ant的结构域,与Bb BEAS下游拆分单元组合表达后,可以合成二肽产物非核糖体肽产物7（L-HICA-L-Phe）、化合物5（D-Ph Lac-N-Me-L-Phe）和化合物6（D-Ph Lac-L-Phe）。 综上所述,本文开发了一种非核糖体多肽合成酶异源拆分表达策略,巨型非核糖体多肽合成酶在酿酒酵母或构巢曲霉中拆分表达后,产物合成水平高于或等于野生型酶,为巨型真菌非核糖体多肽合成酶的异源生物合成,以及组合重编程非核糖体多肽合成酶装配线合成新颖多肽提供了简便的选择。 更多 还原 AbstractFilter('ChDivSummary', 'ChDivSummaryMore', data.title: 大型真菌中含苔色酸核心骨架杂萜类化合物的生物合成研究
data.abstractNote: 大型真菌不仅是重要的食用资源,而且还是药用资源宝库,许多大型真菌是药食两用真菌,在传统中医界有着广泛而悠久的使用历史。它们的次级代谢产物具有神经营养、降血糖、抗肿瘤及提高免疫力等多种生物活性。其中以苔色酸为核心结构衍生出的杂萜类化合物,广泛存在于大型真菌中。例如,来源于猴头菇（Hericium erinaceus）子实体的猴头菌酮具有促进神经生长因子合成的作用,来源于毛韧革菌（Stereum hirsutum）菌丝的Sterenin E对α-葡萄糖苷酶具有抑制作用。上述杂萜类化合物均以苔色酸为基本核心骨架,通过不同修饰酶的作用形成复杂的结构,然而参与其生物合成的功能基因及其生物合成途径仍然未知。本研究通过基因组挖掘,在猴头菇和毛韧革菌中鉴定了这两种化合物的生物合成相关基因;通过米曲霉异源表达、底物喂养、定点突变等手段对关键基因进行功能解析并阐明其酶学合成机制;通过不同来源的基因组合和发酵条件的优化,构建了异源高效合成苔色酸的米曲霉菌株。主要研究结果如下: 第一部分猴头菇中猴头菌酮的生物合成研究。首先通过基因组挖掘和SSN分析,从H.erinaceus CS-4基因组中找到一个苔色酸合成酶... 更多 还原 AbstractFilter('ChDivSummary', 'ChDivSummaryMore', 'ChDivSummaryReset');

data.title: Biosynthetic Pathways of Dimeric Natural Products Containing Bisanthraquinone and Related Xanthones
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            Many dimeric natural products containing bisanthraquinone and related xanthones with diverse structures and versatile bioactivities have been isolated over the years. However, the complicated biosynthetic pathways of such natural products, which have remained elusive until recently, negatively impact their mass bioproduction and biosynthetic structural modification for drug discovery. In this concept, we summarize the recent progress in gene cluster mining and biosynthetic pathway elucidation of natural products containing bisanthraquinone and related xanthones. These pioneering works may pave the way for further biosynthetic pathway elucidation and structure modification of dimeric natural products through gene and protein engineering.

data.title: Agrobacterium-mediated transformation of Brassica napus and Brassica oleracea
data.abstractNote: Agrobacterium-mediated transformation is widely used for gene delivery in plants. However, commercial cultivars of crop plants are often recalcitrant to transformation because the protocols established for model varieties are not directly applicable to them. The genus Brassica includes the oil seed crop, canola (B. napus), and vegetable crop varieties of Brassica oleracea, including cauliflower, broccoli and cabbage. Here, we describe an efficient protocol for Agrobacterium-mediated transformation using seedling explants that is applicable to various Brassica varieties; this protocol has been used to genetically engineer commercial cultivars of canola and cauliflower in our laboratory. Young seedling explants are inoculated with Agrobacterium on the day of explant preparation. Explants are grown for 1 week in the absence of a selective agent before being transferred to a selective medium to recover transgenic shoots. Transgenic shoots are subjected to an additional round of selection on medium containing higher levels of the selective agent and a low-carbohydrate source; this helps to eliminate false-positive plants. Use of seedling explants offers flexible experiment planning and a convenient explant source. Using this protocol, transgenic plants can be obtained in 2.5 to 3.5 months.

data.title: Fast, efficient and reproducible genetic transformation of Phaseolus spp. by Agrobacterium rhizogenes
data.abstractNote: This transformation procedure generates, with high efficiency (70–90%), hairy roots in cultivars, landraces and accessions of Phaseolus vulgaris (common bean) and other Phaseolus spp. Hairy roots rapidly develop after wounding young plantlets with Agrobacterium rhizogenes, at the cotyledon node, and keeping the plants in high-humidity conditions. Callogenesis always precedes hairy-root formation, and after 15 days, when roots develop at wounded sites, the stem with the normal root is cleaved below the hairy root zone. Transgenic roots and nodules co-transformed with a binary vector can be easily identified using a reporter gene. This procedure, in addition to inducing robust transgenic hairy roots that are susceptible to being nodulated by rhizobia and to fixing nitrogen efficiently, sets the foundation for a high-throughput functional genomics approach on the study of root biology and root–microbe interactions. This protocol can be completed within 30 days.

data.title: Fusion PCR and gene targeting in Aspergillus nidulans
data.abstractNote: We describe a rapid method for the production of fusion PCR products that can be used, generally without band purification, to transform Aspergillus nidulans. This technique can be used to replace genes; tag genes with fluorescent moeties or epitope tags; or replace endogenous promoters with regulatable promoters, by introducing an appropriate selective cassette (e.g., fluorescent protein + selectable marker). The relevant genomic fragments and cassette are first amplified separately by PCR using primers that produce overlapping ends. A second PCR using 'nested' primers fuses the fragments into a single molecule with all sequences in the desired order. This procedure allows a cassette to be amplified once, frozen and used subsequently in many fusion PCRs. Transformation of nonhomologous recombination deficient (nkuAΔ) strains of A. nidulans with fusion PCR products results in high frequencies of accurate gene targeting. Fusion PCR takes less than 2 d. Protoplast formation and transformation takes less than 1 d.

data.title: Genetic manipulation of Aspergillus nidulans: meiotic progeny for genetic analysis and strain construction
data.abstractNote: The multicellular microbial eukaryote Aspergillus nidulans is an excellent model for the study of a wide array of biological processes. Studies in this system contribute significantly to understanding fundamental biological principles and are relevant for biotechnology and industrial applications, as well as human, animal and plant fungal pathogenesis. A. nidulans is easily manipulated using classical and molecular genetics. Here, we describe the storage and handling of A. nidulans and procedures for genetic crossing, progeny analysis and growth testing. These procedures are used for Mendelian analysis of segregation of alleles to show whether a mutant phenotype segregates as a single gene and independent assortment of genes to determine the linkage relationship between genes. Meiotic crossing is used for construction of multiple mutant strains for genetic analysis. Genetic crossing and analysis of progeny can be undertaken in 2–3 weeks and growth testing takes 2–3 days.

data.title: Methods for isolation of marine-derived endophytic fungi and their bioactive secondary products
data.abstractNote: Marine-derived fungi have been shown in recent years to produce a plethora of new bioactive secondary metabolites, some of them featuring new carbon frameworks hitherto unprecedented in nature. These compounds are of interest as new lead structures for medicine as well as for plant protection. The aim of this protocol is to give a detailed description of methods useful for the isolation and cultivation of fungi associated with various marine organisms (sponges, algae and mangrove plants) for the extraction, characterization and structure elucidation of biologically active secondary metabolites produced by these marine-derived endophytic fungi, and for the preliminary evaluation of their pharmacological properties based on rapid 'in house' screening systems. Some results exemplifying the positive outcomes of the protocol are given at the end. From sampling in marine environment to completion of the structure elucidation and bioactivity screening, a period of at least 3 months has to be scheduled.

data.title: Discovery of non-squalene triterpenes
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            
              All known triterpenes are generated by triterpene synthases (TrTSs) from squalene or oxidosqualene
              1
              . This approach is fundamentally different from the biosynthesis of short-chain (C
              10
              –C
              25
              ) terpenes that are formed from polyisoprenyl diphosphates
              2–4
              . In this study, two fungal chimeric class I TrTSs,
              Talaromyces verruculosus
              talaropentaene synthase (TvTS) and
              Macrophomina phaseolina
              macrophomene synthase (MpMS), were characterized. Both enzymes use dimethylallyl diphosphate and isopentenyl diphosphate or hexaprenyl diphosphate as substrates, representing the first examples, to our knowledge, of non-squalene-dependent triterpene biosynthesis. The cyclization mechanisms of TvTS and MpMS and the absolute configurations of their products were investigated in isotopic labelling experiments. Structural analyses of the terpene cyclase domain of TvTS and full-length MpMS provide detailed insights into their catalytic mechanisms. An AlphaFold2-based screening platform was developed to mine a third TrTS,
              Colletotrichum gloeosporioides
              colleterpenol synthase (CgCS). Our findings identify a new enzymatic mechanism for the biosynthesis of triterpenes and enhance understanding of terpene biosynthesis in nature.

data.title: Complete biosynthesis of QS-21 in engineered yeast
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            
              QS-21 is a potent vaccine adjuvant and remains the only saponin-based adjuvant that has been clinically approved for use in humans
              1,2
              . However, owing to the complex structure of QS-21, its availability is limited. Today, the supply depends on laborious extraction from the Chilean soapbark tree or on low-yielding total chemical synthesis
              3,4
              . Here we demonstrate the complete biosynthesis of QS-21 and its precursors, as well as structural derivatives, in engineered yeast strains. The successful biosynthesis in yeast requires fine-tuning of the host’s native pathway fluxes, as well as the functional and balanced expression of 38 heterologous enzymes. The required biosynthetic pathway spans seven enzyme families—a terpene synthase, P450s, nucleotide sugar synthases, glycosyltransferases, a coenzyme A ligase, acyl transferases and polyketide synthases—from six organisms, and mimics in yeast the subcellular compartmentalization of plants from the endoplasmic reticulum membrane to the cytosol. Finally, by taking advantage of the promiscuity of certain pathway enzymes, we produced structural analogues of QS-21 using this biosynthetic platform. This microbial production scheme will allow for the future establishment of a structure–activity relationship, and will thus enable the rational design of potent vaccine adjuvants.

data.title: Copper-dependent halogenase catalyses unactivated C−H bond functionalization
data.abstractNote: Carbon–hydrogen (C–H) bonds are the foundation of essentially every organic molecule, making them an ideal place to do chemical synthesis. The key challenge is achieving selectivity for one particular C(sp3)−H bond1–3. In recent years, metalloenzymes have been found to perform C(sp3)−H bond functionalization4,5. Despite substantial progresses in the past two decades6,7, enzymatic halogenation and pseudohalogenation of unactivated C(sp3)−H—providing a functional handle for further modification—have been achieved with only non-haem iron/α-ketoglutarate-dependent halogenases, and are therefore limited by the chemistry possible with these enzymes8. Here we report the discovery and characterization of a previously unknown halogenase ApnU, part of a protein family containing domain of unknown function 3328 (DUF3328). ApnU uses copper in its active site to catalyse iterative chlorinations on multiple unactivated C(sp3)−H bonds. By taking advantage of the softer copper centre, we demonstrate that ApnU can catalyse unprecedented enzymatic C(sp3)−H bond functionalization such as iodination and thiocyanation. Using biochemical characterization and proteomics analysis, we identified the functional oligomeric state of ApnU as a covalently linked homodimer, which contains three essential pairs—one interchain and two intrachain—of disulfide bonds. The metal-coordination active site in ApnU consists of binuclear type II copper centres, as revealed by electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy. This discovery expands the enzymatic capability of C(sp3)−H halogenases and provides a foundational understanding of this family of binuclear copper-dependent oxidative enzymes.

data.title: 古墓土壤微生物分离鉴定和篮状菌属f34天然产物挖掘及生物合成研究
data.abstractNote: 天然产物在人类发展史上扮演着举足轻重的角色,其化学结构新颖,具有多样的生物活性。然而,由于抗生素的长期使用和不规范滥用,耐药细菌已经对公共卫生安全产生了严重的影响。微生物作为天然产物的主要生产者,是开发新药物以及新的药物先导分子的重要来源。微生物的来源广泛,从极地到沙漠到深海,皆分布着数量巨大的微生物种群。本论文对尚未获得广泛研究的古墓“远古”微生物为研究对象,开展了湖北随州枣树林曾侯宝墓葬土壤样品的微生物系统分离和鉴定,以及基因组挖掘(genome mining)、天然产物分离和生物合成等不同角度,对古墓微生物多样性和天然产物的多样性进行了较为系统的研究。本论文主要包含3个部分的研究内容,第一部分为微生物的分离纯化:通过平板划线法和稀释涂布平板法相结合的策略,共分离得到30株真菌,ITS序列测序分析后鉴定发现,共分离获得青霉属真菌11株,篮状菌属真菌6株,曲霉属真菌8株,蜡蚧菌属真菌2株,枝孢菌属真菌2株和木霉属真菌1株。通过蔗糖密度梯度离心法分离得到2株放线菌,经16S rDNA鉴定分别为诺卡氏菌属放线菌和假诺卡氏菌属放线菌。第二部分为次级代谢产物分离和鉴定:对分离得到的30株真菌和2株放线菌分别进行小规模发酵筛选,选择代谢产物丰富的篮状菌属Talaromyces variabilis.F34以大米为主要基质进行大规模发酵(32 L固体发酵),培养物经乙酸乙酯萃取后减压浓缩,采用正向硅胶柱层析、羟丙基葡聚糖凝胶Sephadex LH-20、高压液相色谱等色谱技术对发酵产物进行分离纯化,分离鉴定了 5个次级代谢产物,经NMR和高分辨质谱鉴定为kasanosin C,comazaphilone C,montagnuphilone A,skyrin,orsellinic acid。第三部分对F34的进行了基因组扫描和次级代谢产物生物合成基因簇的系统分析鉴定。菌株F34的全基因组草图由生工生物工程(上海)股份有限公司测序完成,将基因组序列通过antiSMASH对生物合成基因簇进行预测,发现该菌株次级代谢产物的生物合成基因簇丰富,潜在基因簇高达99个。针对本论文中分离得到的azaphilones类化合物的生物合成途径进行推导后,锁定可能合成该类化合物的两个核心PKS基因,并将其从F34基因组中克隆出来构建异源表达载体。获得了蒽醌类化合物skyrin合成过程中负责二聚化的细胞色素P450单加氧酶RugG,并以酵母为异源宿主开展了 RugG异源表达及微粒体功能验证。本论文的研究和探索,首先揭示了湖北随州枣树林曾侯宝墓葬“远古土壤”特殊生境中微生物的群落组成,发现该特境中真菌为潜在的优势微生物群体;其次,特境微生物菌株的获取,为寻找和发现新的生物活性化合物提供了重要的菌株和基因资源;第三,为真菌azaphilone类化合物生物合成途径解析和化合物skyrin的异源生物合成途径构建研究提供了数据基础。 更多 还原 AbstractFilter('ChDivSummary', 'ChDivSummaryMore', 'ChDivSummaryReset');

data.title: 罗伯茨绿僵菌中不同黑色素合成途径的研究
data.abstractNote: 生物防治技术因安全、高效、害虫不易产生抗药性的优势具有巨大的应用前景,其中绿僵菌是应用最广泛的生防真菌之一。沉积在细胞壁的黑色素在绿僵菌抵抗环境胁迫和侵染害虫过程中均发挥了重要作用。在真菌中,DHN(1,8-二羟基萘)黑色素是重要的毒力因子,它的生物合成通常由多结构域的非还原型聚酮合酶催化合成1,3,6,8-四羟基萘(THN),进一步修饰生成前体DHN,最终聚合成高分子多聚物。通过分析罗伯茨绿僵菌基因组,发现两个源于复制和分化的聚酮合酶基因pks1和pks2,与参与DHN黑色素合成的聚酮合酶高度同源。基因敲除实验表明罗伯茨绿僵菌聚酮合酶Mr PKS1和Mr PKS2均具有重要的生物学功能:Mr PKS1与孢子色素有关,Mr PKS2影响孢子侵染能力。然而Mr PKS1与Mr PKS2参与的绿僵菌内源DHN黑色素合成途径一直未能阐明,研究绿僵菌黑色素的差异合成途径有助于理解真菌适应环境的机制,对研发高效的真菌杀虫剂、创制绿色环保的生物化学农药具有重要价值。本研究利用酿酒酵母(Saccharomyces cerevisiae)BJ5464-Npg A和构巢曲霉(Aspergillus nidulans)A1145异源表达平台,通过组合生物合成和产物结构鉴定,证明了罗伯茨绿僵菌中两个聚酮合酶基因簇对不同DHN黑色素的差异生物合成机制。通过测试酿酒酵母转化子对高温、氧化和紫外胁迫的抗性,证明了两种黑色素在抗逆中的功能。具体内容如下:1.通过在酿酒酵母和构巢曲霉中的异源表达,证明了绿僵菌两条色素合成途径的聚酮合酶合成产物不同:Mr PKS1合成八聚酮的蒽醌类产物,Mr PKS2合成DHN黑色素的中间产物THN。2.通过将Mr PKS1基因簇中的氧化还原酶Mr Eth D和漆酶Mr Lac,以及Mr PKS2基因簇中的修饰酶1,3,6,8-四羟基萘还原酶(Mr THNR)和小柱孢酮脱水酶(Mr SCD)与两个聚酮合酶在酿酒酵母BJ5464-Npg A中分别以不同的组合进行表达,验证了两条黑色素合成途径的后修饰过程不同:Mr PKS2、Mr THNR、Mr SCD的组合合成了DHN,证明了罗伯茨绿僵菌具有完整的DHN黑色素合成途径,且该途径仅在侵染过程中表达;Mr PKS1的产物可被Mr Eth D进一步修饰。3.通过测试含有不同基因组合的酵母转化子的抗逆能力,证明了两种色素合成途径的中间产物可不同程度地增强酵母对紫外辐射、氧化损伤和高温损伤的抵抗能力。4.通过研究Mr PKS1与Mr PKS2的差异生物合成机制,发现硫酯酶结构域是控制产物结构的关键结构域,Mr PKS2的硫酯酶结构域具有碳-碳环化和脱酰基化双功能。本研究有助于了解黑色素复杂多样的生物合成机制,帮助提高生防真菌在农业中的应用效率。此外,聚酮类化合物是临床和农用药物的重要来源,本研究拓展了对于真菌聚酮合酶生物合成机制的认知,认识了真菌DHN黑色素复杂多样的生物合成机制,为利用合成生物学手段设计和改造聚酮合酶产物结构奠定基础。 更多 还原 AbstractFilter('ChDivSummary', 'ChDivSummaryMore', 'ChDivSummaryReset');

data.title: 土曲霉工业菌株hz01使能工具开发及细胞工厂构建
data.abstractNote: 丝状真菌作为一类重要的微生物,其工业发酵性能已经得到了广泛的生产实践验证,并形成了成熟的工业生产体系。土曲霉(Aspergillus terreus)作为代表性工业丝状真菌,具有发酵周期短、产孢能力强和发酵鲁棒性强等良好的工业性能,是一类非常具有应用潜力的合成生物学底盘。但目前土曲霉工业底盘开发仍存在一些问题:比如工业菌株缺乏高效的遗传改造手段,多点编辑难度大;核心元件短缺,元件库有待开发;研究不系统且相对滞后等。 本论文聚焦于土曲霉工业菌株的使能工具开发和细胞工厂构建。选择土曲霉工业菌株HZ01作为研究对象,通过开发优化元件库和基因编辑系统建立高效的遗传操作平台,为后续构建活性天然产物微生物细胞工厂提供优良的工业底盘细胞。随后选择了两个合成路径较短的活性天然产物赛洛西宾和查尔酮作为目标分子,在土曲霉HZ01中重新构建其生物合成途径,进一步验证所构建的底盘细胞效率。具体研究内容和主要结果如下: (1)构建启动子文库从而实现基因转录水平调控。选择HZ01菌株的主产物洛伐他汀基因簇作为研究对象,通过报告基因GFP可视化定性结合LUC荧光素酶活性定量共同表征启动子,构建启动子强度梯度文库,开发丰富的遗传元件库。 (2)开发CRISPR/Cas9高效多点基因编辑系统。在土曲霉HZ01中转入Cas9和Cpf1基因并进行RT-PCR和发酵验证,成功构建含有CRISPR编辑系统的底盘细胞。进一步评估改造后菌株的多点基因编辑效率并进行优化,实现多点编辑,为后续细胞工厂的构建提供高效的基因编辑工具。 (3)在前两项工作的基础上,构建活性分子赛洛西宾和查尔酮的细胞工厂。在两种使能工具开发完成的底盘细胞上,转入相关基因异源表达以验证底盘细胞性能,实现赛洛西宾和查尔酮细胞工厂的定制化合成。 综上,本论文构建了土曲霉工业菌株HZ01的启动子强度梯度文库,为后续从启动子水平进行基因表达调控提供了更多有效的选择;同时在土曲霉工业菌株中开发了CRISPR/Cas9多点基因编辑系统,大大提高了基因编辑的效率和广度,两个表型改变的敲除位点可后续开发成为可视化中性位点辅助直观表征。在此基础之上,在土曲霉HZ01中重构了赛洛西宾和查尔酮生物合成途径,并成功获得了查尔酮细胞工厂。本论文的研究内容不仅为土曲霉工业菌株的代谢工程改造提供了高效的使能工具,更为后续开发其他活性天然产物的土曲霉细胞工厂奠定了重要基础。 更多 还原 AbstractFilter('ChDivSummary', 'ChDivSummaryMore', 'ChDivSummaryReset');

data.title: 球孢白僵菌非核糖体多肽合成酶组的功能分析
data.abstractNote: 球孢白僵菌（Beauveria bassiana）是一种虫生真菌,可以侵入6个目15个科的200多种昆虫,并在虫体内大量繁殖,同时产生白僵菌素和卵孢菌素等次生代谢产物,这些物质可引起昆虫中毒,使其新陈代谢紊乱,最终导致昆虫死亡。对于球孢白僵菌侵染昆虫的作用机制,国内外的研究主要集中于研究其侵染的机理,但对其次生代谢产物的生物合成和生物学功能研究还不够深入。非核糖体多肽（nonribosomal peptide,NRP）类化合物是真菌的主要次生代谢产物。基因组分析表明,球孢白僵菌ARSEF 2860中含有21个非核糖体多肽的合成基因,但目前只报道了4个基因的合成产物和生物学功能,如白僵菌素等,而大部分的非核糖体多肽的生物合成基因功能未知。为了研究这些未知基因的功能,本论文利用生物信息学的方法,系统地分析了球孢白僵菌ARSEF 2860的21个非核糖体多肽合成酶（nonribosomal peptide synthase,NRPS）,并按功能将其分为3类,通过基因敲除和感染小菜蛾实验,确定了3个参与侵染小菜蛾过程的非核糖体多肽合成酶基因,具体结果如下:1、antiSMASH和hmmsearch等次级代谢产物分析工具对球孢白僵菌ARSEF 2860基因组进行检索,获得21个NRPS基因,和3个聚酮合酶-非核糖体多肽合成酶（polyketide synthase-nonribosomal peptide synthase,PKS-NRPS）杂合基因。提取非核糖体多肽合成酶的腺苷酰化结构域（Adenylation domain,A domain）构建系统发育树,根据聚类分析的结果,将球孢白僵菌的NRPS按功能分成3类:基础代谢类（7个）、致病相关类（12个）和功能未知类（2个）。2、在实验室培养条件和侵染小菜蛾条件下,球孢白僵菌ARSEF 2860的NRPS表达差异非常明显,通过反转录PCR发现,BBA<sub>0</sub>8222（致病相关类）和BBA<sub>0</sub>3671（致病相关类）在侵染宿主过程中被激活,BBA<sub>0</sub>6727（致病相关类）和BBA<sub>0</sub>4028（基础代谢类）表达量增加。通过实时荧光定量PCR发现,包括基础代谢类BBA<sub>0</sub>4028与致病相关类BBA<sub>0</sub>8222、BBA<sub>0</sub>3671和BBA<sub...

data.title: 以多样性为导向的真菌聚酮化合物的挖掘和组合生物合成
data.abstractNote: 真菌聚酮类化合物是由聚酮合酶(PKS)催化合成的一类重要次级代谢产物,在医药、农业和食品加工领域具有广泛的用途。多数真菌聚酮类化合物由单一聚酮合酶催化产生,而苯二酚内酯等聚酮化合物的生物合成需要还原型聚酮合酶(hr PKS)和非还原型聚酮合酶(nr PKS)协同合作。这种双聚酮合酶协作的生物合成策略,适宜作为模式系统研究真菌聚酮合酶程序化的生物合成机制和真菌聚酮类化合物的组合生物合成。本研究通过基因组挖掘,在真菌中发现了29对双聚酮合酶编码基因,并通过组合不同基因异源合成了一系列“非天然”的聚酮类化合物。另外,本研究还初步探索了绿僵菌中一对双聚酮合酶的合成产物及其合成后修饰过程,具体进展如下: 1.通过基因组挖掘,从已测序的真菌中,发现了具有较高同源关系的18对未知功能的Ⅰ型双聚酮合酶基因,将其和11对已知功能的双聚酮合酶聚类分析发现,它们可以分为3个亚型,亚型Ⅰ主要合成苯二酚内酯类化合物,亚型Ⅱ主要合成嗜氮酮类化合物,亚型Ⅲ的合成产物结构未知。其中,亚型Ⅲ的nr PKS结构域组成与亚型Ⅰ和Ⅱ不同,其羧基端缺少催化终产物释放的硫脂酶(TE)或还原酶(R)结构域。但是,其合成基因簇中含有一... 更多 还原 AbstractFilter('ChDivSummary', 'ChDivSummaryMore', 'ChDivSummaryReset');

data.title: 质谱和基因组指导的新型非核糖体肽挖掘

data.abstractNote: 由线虫侵袭和寄生引起的植物病害是导致农产品减产和森林危害的主要原因之一,每年在全球造成的经济损失达1500亿美元。随着化学杀虫剂长期使用带来的环境污染和耐药性问题日益突出,开发环境友好且活性高效的抗线虫天然药物,已成为生物防控线虫的广泛共识和重大需求。来源于嗜热真菌Talaromyces thermophilus的thermolide家族化合物因具有独特的13元聚酮-非核糖体肽杂合大环内酯骨架和显著的杀线虫活性（与一线杀虫药物阿维菌素相当）,展现出作为新型生物农药的巨大开发价值。然而,由于（1）原始菌株T.thermophilus培养条件苛刻（45°C-55°C）;（2）thermolide活性组分产量低（0.05 mg/L）;（3）大环内酯骨架手性中心复杂（含有12个手性中心）难以全合成等瓶颈因素的制约,基于thermolide的生物农药开发一直停滞不前。因此,基于途径解析的异源生物合成研究成为开发thermolide类抗线虫生物农药的有效策略。该策略可以克服原始菌株的培养条件限制,厘清thermolide合成机制的分子基础,为利用代谢工程或合成生物学手段进行结构改造奠定基础。基于此,本课题从T.thermophilus NRRL 2155基因组中重新鉴定了thermolide生物合成基因簇thm,采用生物信息学分析、异源生物合成、体外酶催化功能表征及定点突变等方法和手段,阐明了thermolide完整的生物合成途径。同时,采用基因组挖掘结合组合生物合成及代谢工程等方法和策略对thermolide结构进行系统改造,建立了结构多样的thermolide衍生物库。具体工作如下:（1）Tal基因簇的分析和表征。前期,thermolide的假想生物合成tal基因簇已在T.thermophilus NRRL 2155基因组中被报道。但是,进一步的生物信息学分析显示,tal基因簇的基因功能与thermolide的结构特征存在诸多矛盾之处,且tal基因簇与fusarin C的生物合成基因簇（fus）高度同源。异源表达tal基因簇于构巢曲霉中并未检测到thermolide相关产物,而是产生了分子量为359,紫外吸收类似于fusarin C的化合物。以上结果说明,tal基因簇不负责thermolide的生物合成,该基因簇的实际产物为fusarin C家族化合物。因此,T.thermophilus中thermolide的生物合成基...
