data.title: Discrete Acyltransferases and Thioesterases in Iso-Migrastatin and Lactimidomycin Biosynthesis
data.abstractNote: Iso-Migrastatin (iso-MGS) and lactimidomycin (LTM) are glutarimide-containing polyketide natural products (NPs) that are biosynthesized by homologous acyltransferase (AT)-less type I polyketide synthase (PKS) assembly lines. The biological activities of iso-MGS and LTM have inspired numerous efforts to generate analogues via genetic manipulation of their biosynthetic machinery in both native producers and model heterologous hosts. A detailed understanding of the MGS and LTM AT-less type I PKSs would serve to inspire future engineering efforts while advancing the fundamental knowledge of AT-less type I PKS enzymology. The mgs and ltm biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) encode for two discrete ATs of the architecture AT-enoylreductase (AT-ER) and AT-type II thioesterase (AT-TE). Herein, we report the functional characterization of the mgsB and ltmB and the mgsH and ltmH gene products, revealing that MgsB and LtmB function as type II thioesterases (TEs) and MgsH and LtmH are the dedicated trans-ATs for the MGS and LTM AT-less type I PKSs. In vivo and in vitro experiments demonstrated that MgsB was devoid of any AT activity, despite the presence of the conserved catalytic triad of canonical ATs. Cross-complementation experiments demonstrated that MgsH and LtmH are functionally interchangeable between the MGS and LTM AT-less type I PKSs. This work sets the stage for future mechanistic studies of AT-less type I PKSs and efforts to engineer the MGS and LTM AT-less type I PKS assembly lines for novel glutarimide-containing polyketides.

data.title: Diverse Combinatorial Biosynthesis Strategies for C–H Functionalization of Anthracyclinones
data.abstractNote: Streptomyces spp. are “nature’s antibiotic factories” that produce valuable bioactive metabolites, such as the cytotoxic anthracycline polyketides. While the anthracyclines have hundreds of natural and chemically synthesized analogues, much of the chemical diversity stems from enzymatic modifications to the saccharide chains and, to a lesser extent, from alterations to the core scaffold. Previous work has resulted in the generation of a BioBricks synthetic biology toolbox in Streptomyces coelicolor M1152ΔmatAB that could produce aklavinone, 9-epi-aklavinone, auramycinone, and nogalamycinone. In this work, we extended the platform to generate oxidatively modified analogues via two crucial strategies. (i) We swapped the ketoreductase and first-ring cyclase enzymes for the aromatase cyclase from the mithramycin biosynthetic pathway in our polyketide synthase (PKS) cassettes to generate 2-hydroxylated analogues. (ii) Next, we engineered several multioxygenase cassettes to catalyze 11-hydroxylation, 1-hydroxylation, 10-hydroxylation, 10-decarboxylation, and 4-hydroxyl regioisomerization. We also developed improved plasmid vectors and S. coelicolor M1152ΔmatAB expression hosts to produce anthracyclinones. This work sets the stage for the combinatorial biosynthesis of bespoke anthracyclines using recombinant Streptomyces spp. hosts.

data.title: Engineered Biosynthesis and Anticancer Studies of Ring-Expanded Antimycin-Type Depsipeptides
data.abstractNote: Respirantins are 18-membered antimycin-type depsipeptides produced by Streptomyces sp. and Kitasatospora sp. These compounds have shown extraordinary anticancer activities against a panel of cancer cell lines with nanomolar levels of IC50 values. However, further investigation has been impeded by the low titers of the natural producers and the challenging chemical synthesis due to their structural complexity. The biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) of respirantin was previously proposed based on a bioinformatic comparison of the four members of antimycin-type depsipeptides. In this study, we report the first successful reconstitution of respirantin in Streptomyces albus using a synthetic BGC. This heterologous system serves as an accessible platform for the production and diversification of respirantins. Through polyketide synthase pathway engineering, biocatalysis, and chemical derivatization, we generated nine respirantin compounds, including six new derivatives. Cytotoxicity screening against human MCF-7 and Hela cancer cell lines revealed a unique biphasic dose–response profile of respirantin. Furthermore, a structure–activity relationship study has elucidated the essential functional groups that contribute to its remarkable cytotoxicity. This work paves the way for respirantin-based anticancer drug discovery and development.

data.title: Engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae as a Biosynthetic Platform of Nucleotide Sugars
data.abstractNote: Glycosylation of biomolecules can greatly alter their physicochemical properties, cellular recognition, subcellular localization, and immunogenicity. Glycosylation reactions rely on the stepwise addition of sugars using nucleotide diphosphate (NDP)-sugars. Making these substrates readily available will greatly accelerate the characterization of new glycosylation reactions, elucidation of their underlying regulation mechanisms, and production of glycosylated molecules. In this work, we engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae to heterologously express nucleotide sugar synthases to access a wide variety of uridine diphosphate (UDP)-sugars from simple starting materials (i.e., glucose and galactose). Specifically, activated glucose, uridine diphosphate d-glucose (UDP-d-Glc), can be converted to UDP-d-glucuronic acid (UDP-d-GlcA), UDP-d-xylose (UDP-d-Xyl), UDP-d-apiose (UDP-d-Api), UDP-d-fucose (UDP-d-Fuc), UDP-l-rhamnose (UDP-l-Rha), UDP-l-arabinopyranose (UDP-l-Arap), and UDP-l-arabinofuranose (UDP-l-Araf) using the corresponding nucleotide sugar synthases of plant and microbial origins. We also expressed genes encoding the salvage pathway to directly activate free sugars to achieve the biosynthesis of UDP-l-Arap and UDP-l-Araf. We observed strong inhibition of UDP-d-Glc 6-dehydrogenase (UGD) by the downstream product UDP-d-Xyl, which we circumvented using an induction system (Tet-On) to delay the production of UDP-d-Xyl to maintain the upstream UDP-sugar pool. Finally, we performed a time-course study using strains containing the biosynthetic pathways to produce five non-native UDP-sugars to elucidate their time-dependent interconversion and the role of UDP-d-Xyl in regulating UDP-sugar metabolism. These engineered yeast strains are a robust platform to (i) functionally characterize sugar synthases in vivo, (ii) biosynthesize a diverse selection of UDP-sugars, (iii) examine the regulation of intracellular UDP-sugar interconversions, and (iv) produce glycosylated secondary metabolites and proteins.

data.title: Streptomyces sungeiensis SD3 as a Microbial Chassis for the Heterologous Production of Secondary Metabolites
data.abstractNote: We present the newly isolated Streptomyces sungeiensis SD3 strain as a promising microbial chassis for heterologous production of secondary metabolites. S. sungeiensis SD3 exhibits several advantageous traits as a microbial chassis, including genetic tractability, rapid growth, susceptibility to antibiotics, and metabolic capability supporting secondary metabolism. Genomic and transcriptomic sequencing unveiled the primary metabolic capabilities and secondary biosynthetic pathways of S. sungeiensis SD3, including a previously unknown pathway responsible for the biosynthesis of streptazone B1. The unique placement of S. sungeiensis SD3 in the phylogenetic tree designates it as a type strain, setting it apart from other frequently employed Streptomyces chassis. This distinction makes it the preferred chassis for expressing biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) derived from strains within the same phylogenetic or neighboring phylogenetic clade. The successful expression of secondary biosynthetic pathways from a closely related yet slow-growing strain underscores the utility of S. sungeiensis SD3 as a heterologous expression chassis. Validation of CRISPR/Cas9-assisted genetic tools for chromosomal deletion and insertion paved the way for further strain improvement and BGC refactoring through rational genome editing. The addition of S. sungeiensis SD3 to the heterologous chassis toolkit will facilitate the discovery and production of secondary metabolites.

data.title: Efficient Mutasynthesis of “Non-Natural” Antitubercular Ilamycins with Low Cytotoxicity
data.abstractNote: Ilamycins are a type of cyclopeptide exhibiting potent antitubercular and cytotoxic activities, which make them promising leads for antitubercular and antitumor drugs with unique mechanisms. Mutasynthesis, a strategy utilized to generate natural product analogues by intercepting the biosynthesis of natural products with analogues of biosynthetic precursors, offers a distinct advantage in the eco-friendly and powerful synthesis of “non-natural” natural products. This study developed the mutasynthesis of “non-natural” ilamycins by constructing three genetically engineered strains. Feeding four types of tyrosine-derived mutasynthons to two biosynthetically simplified mutants resulted in the production of 18 new ilamycin analogues (7–24), including 16 halogenated and dinitro-containing ilamycin variants (7–22), along with two previously unreported ilamycin congeners (23 and 24). Most of the generated compounds, particularly the halogenated ilamycins (13, 16–18), exhibited potent antitubercular activity (MICs ca. 0.30 μM) while showing minimal or no cytotoxicity (IC50 > 50 μM). Furthermore, the bromine-containing ilamycin derivatives (16–18) demonstrated enhanced antitubercular activity and lower cytotoxicity compared to those with chlorine, fluorine, or nitro groups, making them promising candidates for further investigation in antitubercular drug development.

data.title: Equipping Saccharomyces cerevisiae with an Additional Redox Cofactor Allows F420-Dependent Bioconversions in Yeast
data.abstractNote: Industrial application of the natural deazaflavin cofactor F420 has high potential for the enzymatic synthesis of high value compounds. It can offer an additional range of chemistry to the use of well-explored redox cofactors such as FAD and their respective enzymes. Its limited access through organisms that are rather difficult to grow has urged research on the heterologous production of F420 using more industrially relevant microorganisms such as Escherichia coli. In this study, we demonstrate the possibility of producing this cofactor in a robust and widely used industrial organism, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, by the heterologous expression of the F420 pathway. Through careful selection of involved enzymes and some optimization, we achieved an F420 yield of ∼1.3 μmol/L, which is comparable to the yield of natural F420 producers. Furthermore, we showed the potential use of F420-producing S. cerevisiae for F420-dependent bioconversions by carrying out the whole-cell conversion of tetracycline. As the first demonstration of F420 synthesis and use for bioconversion in a eukaryotic organism, this study contributes to the development of versatile bioconversion platforms.

data.title: Structural and Computational Insights into the Noncanonical Aromatization in Fungal Polyketide Biosynthesis
data.abstractNote: Aromatic polyketides, with their diverse structures and biological activities, have attracted significant scientific interest. Aromatization reactions are typically performed by aromatases and cyclases associated with bacterial type II polyketide synthases (PKSs) or product template and Claisen cyclase domains found in fungal type I nonreducing PKSs. Intriguingly, our recent study discovered a noncanonical aromatization mechanism involving a cupin domain-containing enzyme, StrC, in fungal alkyl salicylaldehyde derivative biosynthesis. Nevertheless, the catalytic function of StrC largely remained enigmatic. In this study, an in-depth in vitro characterization of StrC was performed to gain a better understanding of the reaction mechanism for aromatization. In addition, the X-ray crystal structure of StrC in the complex with a substrate analogue was obtained to elucidate the unique active site. Subsequent mutational experiments identified important amino acid residues for aromatase activity. Furthermore, a quantum mechanics study provided a plausible reaction mechanism for aromatization and highlighted the vital role of StrC in the biosynthetic process. Thus, our study unveils an unknown paradigm for aromatization in polyketide biosynthesis.

data.title: Total Synthesis Facilitates In Vitro Reconstitution of the C–S Bond-Forming P450 in Griseoviridin Biosynthesis
data.abstractNote: Griseoviridin is a group A streptogramin natural product from Streptomyces with broad-spectrum antibacterial activity. A hybrid polyketide-nonribosomal peptide, it comprises a 23-membered macrocycle, an embedded oxazole motif, and a macrolactone with a unique ene-thiol linkage. Recent analysis of the griseoviridin biosynthetic gene cluster implicated SgvP, a cytochrome P450 monooxygenase, in late-stage installation of the critical C–S bond. While genetic and crystallographic experiments provided indirect evidence to support this hypothesis, the exact function of SgvP has never been confirmed biochemically. Herein, we report a convergent total synthesis of pre-griseoviridin, the putative substrate of P450 SgvP and precursor to griseoviridin. Our strategy features concise and rapid assembly of two fragments joined via sequential peptide coupling and Stille macrocyclization. Access to pre-griseoviridin then enabled in vitro validation of SgvP as the C–S bond-forming P450 during griseoviridin biosynthesis, culminating in a nine-step chemoenzymatic synthesis of griseoviridin.

data.title: Enzymatic Synthesis of Unprotected α,β-Diamino Acids via Direct Asymmetric Mannich Reactions
data.abstractNote: α,β-Diamino acids are important structural motifs and building blocks for numerous bioactive natural products, peptidomimetics, and pharmaceuticals, yet efficient asymmetric synthesis to access these stereoarrays remains a challenge. Herein, we report the development of a pyridoxal 5′-phosphate (PLP)-dependent enzyme that is engineered to catalyze stereoselective Mannich-type reactions between free α-amino acids and enolizable cyclic imines. This biocatalyst enabled one-step asymmetric enzymatic synthesis of the unusual pyrrolidine-containing amino acid L-tambroline at gram-scale with high enantio- and diastereocontrol. Furthermore, this enzymatic platform is capable of utilizing a diverse range of α-amino acids as the Mannich donor and various cyclic imines as the acceptor. By coupling with different imine-generating enzymes, we established versatile biocatalytic cascades and demonstrated a general, concise, versatile, and atom-economic approach to access unprotected α,β-diamino acids, including structurally complex α,α-disubstituted α,β-diamino acids with contiguous stereocenters.

data.title: Detection of a Kinetically Competent Compound-I Intermediate in the Vancomycin Biosynthetic Enzyme OxyB
data.abstractNote: Cytochrome P450 enzymes are abundantly encoded in microbial genomes. Their reactions have two general outcomes, one involving oxygen insertion via a canonical “oxygen rebound” mechanism and a second that diverts from this pathway and leads to a wide array of products, notably intramolecular oxidative cross-links. The antibiotic of-last-resort, vancomycin, contains three such cross-links, which are crucial for biological activity and are installed by the P450 enzymes OxyB, OxyA, and OxyC. The mechanisms of these enzymes have remained elusive in part because of the difficulty in spectroscopically capturing transient intermediates. Using stopped-flow UV/visible absorption and rapid freeze-quench electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopies, we show that OxyB generates the highly reactive compound-I intermediate, which can react with a model vancomycin peptide substrate in a kinetically competent fashion to generate product. Our results have implications for the mechanism of OxyB and are in line with the notion that oxygen rebound and oxidative cross-links share early steps in their catalytic cycles.

data.title: Investigation of the Odilorhabdin Biosynthetic Gene Cluster Using NRPS Engineering
data.abstractNote: The recently identified natural product NOSO-95A from entomopathogenic Xenorhabdus bacteria, derived from a biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) encoding a non-ribosomal peptide synthetase (NRPS), was the first member of the odilorhabdin class of antibiotics. This class exhibits broad-spectrum antibiotic activity and inspired the development of the synthetic derivative NOSO-502, which holds potential as a new clinical drug by breaking antibiotic resistance. While the mode of action of odilorhabdins was broadly investigated, their biosynthesis pathway remained poorly understood. Here we describe the heterologous production of NOSO-95A in Escherichia coli after refactoring the complete BGC. Since the production titer was low, NRPS engineering was applied to uncover the underlying biosynthetic principles. For this, modules of the odilorhabdin NRPS fused to other synthetases were co-expressed with candidate hydroxylases encoded in the BGC allowing the characterization of the biosynthesis of three unusual amino acids and leading to the identification of a prodrug-activation mechanism by deacylation. Our work demonstrates the application of NRPS engineering as a blueprint to mechanistically elucidate large or toxic NRPS and provides the basis to generate novel odilorhabdin analogues with improved properties in the future.

data.title: Phosphonoalamides Reveal the Biosynthetic Origin of Phosphonoalanine Natural Products and a Convergent Pathway for Their Diversification
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            
              Phosphonate natural products, with their potent inhibitory activity, have found widespread use across multiple industries. Their success has inspired development of genome mining approaches that continue to reveal previously unknown bioactive scaffolds and biosynthetic insights. However, a greater understanding of phosphonate metabolism is required to enable prediction of compounds and their bioactivities from sequence information alone. Here, we expand our knowledge of this natural product class by reporting the complete biosynthesis of the phosphonoalamides, antimicrobial tripeptides with a conserved
              N
              ‐terminal
              l
              ‐phosphonoalanine (PnAla) residue produced by
              Streptomyces
              . The phosphonoalamides result from the convergence of PnAla biosynthesis and peptide ligation pathways. We elucidate the biochemistry underlying the transamination of phosphonopyruvate to PnAla, a new early branchpoint in phosphonate biosynthesis catalyzed by an aminotransferase with evolved specificity for phosphonate metabolism. Peptide formation is catalyzed by two ATP‐grasp ligases, the first of which produces dipeptides, and a second which ligates dipeptides to PnAla to produce phosphonoalamides. Substrate specificity profiling revealed a dramatic expansion of dipeptide and tripeptide products, while finding PnaC to be the most promiscuous dipeptide ligase reported thus far. Our findings highlight previously unknown transformations in natural product biosynthesis, promising enzyme biocatalysts, and unveil insights into the diversity of phosphonopeptide natural products.

Abstract

data.title: An Enzymatic Prodrug-like Route to Thio and Selenoamides
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            
              6‐Thioguanine (6TG) is a clinically used antitumor agent that was rationally designed as a DNA‐targeting antimetabolite, but it also occurs naturally. 6TG is a critical virulence factor produced by
              Erwinia amylovorans
              , a notorious plant pathogen that causes fire blight of pome fruit trees. The biosynthesis of the rare thioamide metabolite involves an adenylating enzyme (YcfA) and a sulfur‐mobilizing enzyme (YcfC), but the mechanism of sulfur transfer and putative intermediates have remained elusive. Through dissection and in vitro reconstitution of the thionation process using diverse substrates, we uncover an intermediate, prodrug‐like thio‐conjugate and elucidate the precise enzyme functions. YcfA not only adenylates GMP but also transfers the mercapto group of
              l
              ‐cysteine to the activated carbonyl. A designated C−S lyase (YcfC) then cleaves the resulting
              S
              ‐adduct to yield the thioamide. This pathway is distinct from canonical tRNA sulfur modifications and known enzymatic peptide thionations. By exploring a wide range of substrate surrogates, we exploited the tolerance of the enzyme pair to produce even a seleno analog. This study provides valuable insight into a previously unexplored area of bacterial thioamide formation and lays the groundwork for synthetic biology approaches to produce thioamide antimetabolites.

data.title: Direct α-Hydroxy Acid Loading onto a Bacterial Thiotemplate Assembly Line via a Multienzyme Gateway
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            
              Various nonribosomal peptide synthetases (NRPSs) create structural and functional diversity by incorporating α‐hydroxy acids into peptide backbones. Trigonic acid, an unusual cyclopropanol‐substituted hydroxy acid, is the source of the molecular warhead of malleicyprol, a critical virulence factor of human and animal pathogens of the
              Burkholderia pseudomallei
              (BP) group. The process of selecting and loading this building block remained enigmatic as the NRPS module designated for this task is incomplete. Using a combination of bioinformatics, mutational analyses, targeted metabolomics, and in vitro biochemical assays, we show that two
              trans
              ‐acting enzymes are required to load this central building block onto the modular assembly line. An adenylation‐thiolation didomain enzyme (BurJ) activates trigonic acid, followed by the translocation of the enzyme‐bound α‐hydroxy acid thioester by an FkbH‐like protein with a mutated phosphatase domain (BurH). This specialized gateway is the first reported direct loading of an α‐hydroxy acid onto a
              bona fide
              NRPS module in bacteria and expands the synthetic biology toolbox for the site‐specific incorporation of non‐canonical building blocks. Moreover, insight into the biochemical basis of virulence factor biosynthesis can provide a foundation for developing enzyme inhibitors as anti‐virulence therapeutics against BP pathogen infections.

data.title: Construct Phenylethanoid Glycosides Harnessing Biosynthetic Networks, Protein Engineering and One-Pot Multienzyme Cascades
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            Phenylethanoid glycosides (PhGs) exhibit a multitude of structural variations linked to diverse pharmacological activities. Assembling various PhGs via multienzyme cascades represents a concise strategy over traditional synthetic methods. However, the challenge lies in identifying a comprehensive set of catalytic enzymes. This study explores biosynthetic PhG reconstruction from natural precursors, aiming to replicate and amplify their structural diversity. We discovered 12 catalytic enzymes, including four novel 6′‐OH glycosyltransferases and three new polyphenol oxidases, revealing the intricate network in PhG biosynthesis. Subsequently, the crystal structure of CmGT3 (2.62 Å) was obtained, guiding the identification of conserved residue 144# as a critical determinant for sugar donor specificity. Engineering this residue in PhG glycosyltransferases (FsGT61, CmGT3, and FsGT6) altered their sugar donor recognition. Finally, a one‐pot multienzyme cascade was established, where the combined action of glycosyltransferases and acyltransferases boosted conversion rates by up to 12.6‐fold. This cascade facilitated the reconstruction of 26 PhGs with conversion rates ranging from 5–100 %, and 20 additional PhGs detectable by mass spectrometry. PhGs with extra glycosyl and hydroxyl modules demonstrated notable liver cell protection. This work not only provides catalytic tools for PhG biosynthesis, but also serves as a proof‐of‐concept for cell‐free enzymatic construction of diverse natural products.

data.title: A Cytochrome P450 Catalyzes Oxidative Coupling Formation of Insecticidal Dimeric Indole Piperazine Alkaloids
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            
              Cytochrome P450 (CYP450)‐catalyzed oxidative coupling is an efficient strategy for using simple building blocks to construct complex structural scaffolds of natural products. Among them, heterodimeric coupling between two different monomers is relatively scarce, and the corresponding CYP450s are largely undiscovered. In this study, we discovered a fungal CYP450 (CpsD) and its associated
              cps
              cluster from 37208 CYP450s of Pfam PF00067 family member database and subsequently identified a group of new skeleton indole piperazine alkaloids (campesines A−G) by combination of genome mining and heterologous synthesis. Importantly, CYP450 CpsD mainly catalyzes intermolecular oxidative heterocoupling of two different indole piperazine monomers to generate an unexpected 6/5/6/6/6/6/5/6 eight‐ring scaffold through the formation of one C−C bond and two C−N bonds, illuminating its first dimerase role in this family of natural products. The proposed catalytic mechanism of CpsD was deeply investigated by diversified substrate derivatization. Moreover, dimeric campesine G shows good insecticidal activity against the global honeybee pest
              Galleria mellonella
              . Our study shows a representative example of discovering new skeleton monomeric and dimeric indole piperazine alkaloids from microbial resources, expands our knowledge of bond formation by CYP450s and supports further development of the newly discovered and engineered campesine family compounds as potential biopesticides.

data.title: An Enzymatic Carbon-Carbon Bond Cleavage and Aldol Reaction Cascade Converts an Angular Scaffold into the Linear Tetracyclic Core of Ochraceopones
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            Meroterpenoids of the ochraceopones family featuring a linear tetracyclic scaffold exhibit exceptional antiviral and anti‐inflammatory activities. The biosynthetic pathway and chemical logic to generate this linear tetracycle, however, remain unknown. In this study, we identified and characterized all biosynthetic enzymes to afford ochraceopones and elucidated the complete biosynthetic pathway. We demonstrated that the linear tetracyclic scaffold of ochraceopones was derived from an angular tetracyclic precursor. A multifunctional cytochrome P450 OchH was validated to catalyze the free‐radical‐initiated carbon‐carbon bond cleavage of the angular tetracycle. Then, a new carbon‐carbon bond was verified to be constructed using a new aldolase OchL, which catalyzes an intramolecular aldol reaction to form the linear tetracycle. This carbon‐carbon bond fragmentation and aldol reaction cascade features an unprecedented strategy for converting a common angular tetracycle to a distinctive linear tetracyclic scaffold in meroterpenoid biosynthesis.

data.title: Biosynthesis and recruitment of reactive amino acids in nonribosomal peptide assembly lines
data.abstractNote: Reactive amino acid side chains play important roles in the binding of peptides to specific targets. In addition, their reactivity enables selective peptide conjugation and functionalization for pharmaceutical purposes. Diverse reactive amino acids are incorporated into nonribosomal peptides, which serve as a source for drug candidates. Notable examples include (poly)unsaturated (enamine, alkyne, and furyl) and halogenated residues, strained carbacycles (cyclopropyl and cyclopropanol), small heterocycles (oxirane and aziridine), and reactive N–N functionalities (hydrazones, diazo compounds, and diazeniumdiolates). Their biosynthesis requires diverse biocatalysts for sophisticated reaction mechanisms. Several avenues have been identified for their incorporation into peptides, the recruitment by adenylation domains or ligases, on-line modifications, and enzymatic tailoring reactions. Combined with protein engineering approaches, this knowledge provides new opportunities in synthetic biology and bioorthogonal chemistry.

data.title: Natural products and their semi-synthetic derivatives against antimicrobial-resistant human pathogenic bacteria and fungi
data.abstractNote: Human infectious diseases caused by various microbial pathogens, in general, impact a large population of individuals every year. These microbial diseases that spread quickly remain to be a big issue in various health-related domains and to withstand the negative drug impacts, the antimicrobial-resistant pathogenic microbial organisms (pathogenic bacteria and pathogenic fungi) have developed a variety of resistance processes against many antimicrobial drug classes. During the COVID-19 outbreak, there seems to be an upsurge in drug and multidrug resistant-associated pathogenic microbial species. The preponderance of existing antimicrobials isn’t completely effective, which limits their application in clinical settings. Several naturally occurring chemicals produced from bacteria, plants, animals, marine species, and other sources are now being studied for antimicrobial characteristics. These natural antimicrobial compounds extracted from different sources have been demonstrated to be effective against a variety of diseases, although plants remain the most abundant source. These compounds have shown promise in reducing the microbial diseases linked to the development of drug tolerance and resistance. This paper offers a detailed review of some of the most vital and promising natural compounds and their derivatives against various human infectious microbial organisms. The inhibitory action of different natural antimicrobial compounds, and their possible mechanism of antimicrobial action against a range of pathogenic fungal and bacterial organisms, is provided. The review will be useful in refining current antimicrobial (antifungal and antibacterial) medicines as well as establishing new treatment strategies to tackle the rising number of human bacterial and fungal-associated infections.

data.title: Antibacterial drug discovery in the resistance era
data.abstractNote: The looming antibiotic-resistance crisis has penetrated the consciousness of clinicians, researchers, policymakers, politicians and the public at large. The evolution and widespread distribution of antibiotic-resistance elements in bacterial pathogens has made diseases that were once easily treatable deadly again. Unfortunately, accompanying the rise in global resistance is a failure in antibacterial drug discovery. Lessons from the history of antibiotic discovery and fresh understanding of antibiotic action and the cell biology of microorganisms have the potential to deliver twenty-first century medicines that are able to control infection in the resistance era.

data.title: Biosynthesis of Fungal Natural Products Involving Two Separate Pathway Crosstalk
data.abstractNote: Fungal natural products (NPs) usually possess complicated structures, exhibit satisfactory bioactivities, and are an outstanding source of drug leads, such as the cholesterol-lowering drug lovastatin and the immunosuppressive drug mycophenolic acid. The fungal NPs biosynthetic genes are always arranged within one single biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC). However, a rare but fascinating phenomenon that a crosstalk between two separate BGCs is indispensable to some fungal dimeric NPs biosynthesis has attracted increasing attention. The hybridization of two separate BGCs not only increases the structural complexity and chemical diversity of fungal NPs, but also expands the scope of bioactivities. More importantly, the underlying mechanism for this hybridization process is poorly understood and needs further exploration, especially the determination of BGCs for each building block construction and the identification of enzyme(s) catalyzing the two biosynthetic precursors coupling processes such as Diels–Alder cycloaddition and Michael addition. In this review, we summarized the fungal NPs produced by functional crosstalk of two discrete BGCs, and highlighted their biosynthetic processes, which might shed new light on genome mining for fungal NPs with unprecedented frameworks, and provide valuable insights into the investigation of mysterious biosynthetic mechanisms of fungal dimeric NPs which are constructed by collaboration of two separate BGCs.

data.title: 中国南海海洋真菌资源及其活性次级代谢产物研究评述
data.abstractNote: 南海海域广阔,生物资源丰富多样,其中微生物资源尚未得到全面系统的研究和挖掘。本文回顾了中山大学25年来在南海微生物资源及其活性代谢产物方面的研究成果,着重介绍了近10年来本校团队研究红树林真菌资源并对其次生代谢产物开展靶向抗结核、抗炎、抗Ⅱ型糖尿病和抗肿瘤筛选的进展。最后介绍近年来我们利用中山大学海洋科考计划在西沙群岛及其海域初步开展的微生物资源的研究。

data.title: 深海真菌次级代谢产物及其生物活性研究进展
data.abstractNote: 深海环境复杂苛刻,其中生息的微生物因其所处低温、低氧、避光、高压等深海特殊的生存环境而进化具备了独特的代谢途径,从而具有产生新颖结构生物活性物质的巨大潜力。深海真菌作为深海微生物类群的重要组成部分,因其次级代谢产物类型丰富、出新率高、生物活性显著而倍受研究者关注。本文对近年来深海真菌次级代谢产物的化学结构及其生物活性研究进行综述,按聚酮类、生物碱类、萜类、肽类等化合物类别,着重介绍具有新颖结构和重要生物活性的深海真菌次级代谢产物,为挖掘利用深海真菌资源、研发创新药物提供参考。

data.title: 海洋真菌次级代谢产物及其活性研究进展
data.abstractNote: 海洋微生物独特的生存环境造就了其次级代谢产物有极大的药用价值。因此,近年来许多专家学者将研究方向锁定在海洋微生物次级代谢产物的发掘上,而海洋真菌由于其生命力强,代谢旺盛等原因更成为筛选药用先导化合物的研究热点。本文对近年来海洋真菌次级代谢产物的化学结构及生物活性研究进展进行综述总结,为后续研究提供借鉴和指导。

data.abstractNote: 深海环境复杂多样,微生物为了适应这种极端环境往往会形成独特的代谢途径,进而产生一些具有某种生理活性的结构新颖的次级代谢产物。真菌作为深海环境中的重要微生物类群之一,因其次级代谢产物出新率高、生物活性显著,近年来成为海洋天然产物研究的焦点,倍受研究者关注。本文综述了2004-2017年间发表的217个深海(>50 m)真菌来源的新颖次级代谢产物,其来源菌株广泛分布在真菌18个属,主要集中在Penicillium属(30%)、Aspergillus属(24%)、Spiromastix属(13%)和Acremonium属(7%);其结构类型包括聚酮类(99个)、生物碱类(54个)、萜类(50个)、肽类(11个)、其他类(3个);活性研究主要集中在细胞毒性、抗菌、抗病毒、抗污损等方面。

data.title: Interferences and contaminants encountered in modern mass spectrometry
data.abstractNote: With the invention of electrospray ionization and matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization, scientists employing modern mass spectrometry naturally face new challenges with respect to background interferences and contaminants that might not play a signiﬁcant role in traditional or other analytical techniques. Efforts to continuously minimize sample volumes and measurable concentrations increase the need to understand where these interferences come from, how they can be identiﬁed, and if they can be eliminated. Knowledge of identity enables their use as internal calibrants for accurate mass measurements. This review/tutorial summarizes current literature on reported contaminants and introduces a number of novel interferences that have been observed and identiﬁed in our laboratories over the past decade. These include both compounds of proteinaceous and non-proteinaceous nature. In the supplemental data a spreadsheet is provided that contains a searchable ion list of all compounds identiﬁed to date.

data.title: Expanding the Landscape of Noncanonical Amino Acids in RiPP Biosynthesis
data.abstractNote: Advancements in DNA sequencing technologies and bioinformatics have enabled the discovery of new metabolic reactions from overlooked microbial species and metagenomic sequences. Using a bioinformatic co-occurrence strategy, we previously generated a network of ∼600 uncharacterized quorum-sensing-regulated biosynthetic gene clusters that code for ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptide (RiPP) natural products and are tailored by radical S-adenosylmethionine (RaS) enzymes in streptococci. The most complex of these is the GRC subfamily, named after a conserved motif in the precursor peptide and found exclusively in Streptococcus pneumoniae, the causative agent of bacterial pneumonia. In this study, using both in vivo and in vitro approaches, we have elucidated the modifications installed by the grc biosynthetic enzymes, including a ThiF-like adenylyltransferase/cyclase that generates a C-terminal Glu-to-Cys thiolactone macrocycle, and two RaS enzymes, which selectively epimerize the β-carbon of threonine and desaturate histidine to generate the first instances of l-allo-Thr and didehydrohistidine in RiPP biosynthesis. RaS-RiPPs that have been discovered thus far have stood out for their exotic macrocycles. The product of the grc cluster breaks this trend by generating two noncanonical residues rather than an unusual macrocycle in the peptide substrate. These modifications expand the landscape of nonproteinogenic amino acids in RiPP natural product biosynthesis and motivate downstream biocatalytic applications of the corresponding enzymes.

data.title: 2,3-Dimethoxycinnamic Acid from a Marine Actinomycete, a Promising Quorum Sensing Inhibitor in Chromobacterium violaceum
data.abstractNote: An ethyl acetate extract of a marine actinomycete strain, Nocardiopsis mentallicus SCSIO 53858, isolated from a deep-sea sediment sample in the South China Sea, exhibited anti-quorum-sensing (QS) activity against Chromobacterium violaceum CV026. Guided by the anti-QS activity, a novel active compound was isolated and purified from the extract and was identified as 2,3-dimethoxycinnamic acid (2,3-DCA) through spectral data analysis. At a concentration of 150 μg/mL, 2,3-DCA exhibited robust inhibitory effects on three QS-regulated traits of C. violaceum CV026: violacein production, swarming motility, and biofilm formation, with inhibition rates of 73.9%, 65.9%, and 37.8%, respectively. The quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction results indicated that 2,3-DCA can disrupt the QS system in C. violaceum CV026 by effectively suppressing the expression of QS-related genes, including cviR, vioA, vioB, and vioE. Molecular docking analysis revealed that 2,3-DCA hinders the QS system by competitively binding to the same binding pocket on the CviR receptor as the natural signal molecule N-hexanoyl-L-homoserine lactone. Collectively, these findings suggest that 2,3-DCA exhibits promising potential as an inhibitor of QS systems, providing a potential solution to the emerging problem of bacterial resistance.

data.abstractNote: A new prenylated indole diketopiperazine alkaloid, rubrumline P (1), was isolated along with six more analogues and characterized from the fermentation culture of a marine sediment-derived fungus, Aspergillus chevalieri, collected at a depth of 15 m near the lighthouse in Dahab, Red Sea, Egypt. In the current study, a bioassay-guided fractionation allowed for the identification of an active fraction displaying significant cytotoxic activity against the human pancreatic adenocarcinoma cell line PANC-1 from the EtOAc extract of the investigated fungus compared to the standard paclitaxel. The structures of the isolated compounds from the active fraction were established using 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy and mass spectrometry, together with comparisons with the literature. The absolute configuration of the obtained indole diketopiperazines was established based on single-crystal X-ray diffraction analyses of rubrumline I (2) and comparisons of optical rotations and NMR data, as well as on biogenetic considerations. Genome sequencing indicated the formation of prenyltransferases, which was subsequently confirmed by the isolation of mono-, di-, tri-, and tetraprenylated compounds. Compounds rubrumline P (1) and neoechinulin D (4) confirmed preferential cytotoxic activity against PANC-1 cancer cells with IC50 values of 25.8 and 23.4 µM, respectively. Although the underlying mechanism-of-action remains elusive in this study, cell cycle analysis indicated a slight increase in the sub-G1 peak after treatment with compounds 1 and 4.

data.title: Post-translational Modification of Therapeutic Peptides By NisB, the Dehydratase of the Lantibiotic Nisin
data.abstractNote: Post-translationally introduced dehydroamino acids often play an important role in the activity and receptor specificity of biologically active peptides. In addition, a dehydroamino acid can be coupled to a cysteine to yield a cyclized peptide with increased biostability and resistance against proteolytic degradation and/or modified specificity. The lantibiotic nisin is an antimicrobial peptide produced by Lactococcus lactis. Its post-translational enzymatic modification involves NisB-mediated dehydration of serines and threonines and NisC-catalyzed coupling of cysteines to dehydroresidues, followed by NisT-mediated secretion. Here, we demonstrate that a L. lactis strain containing the nisBTC genes effectively dehydrates and secretes a wide range of medically relevant nonlantibiotic peptides among which variants of adrenocorticotropic hormone, vasopressin, an inhibitor of tripeptidyl peptidase II, enkephalin, luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone, angiotensin, and erythropoietin. For most of these peptides, ring formation was demonstrated. These data show that lantibiotic enzymes can be applied for the modification of peptides, thereby enabling the biotechnological production of dehydroresidue-containing and/or thioether-bridged therapeutic peptides with enhanced stability and/or modulated activities.

data.title: Introducing EzTaxon-e: a prokaryotic 16S rRNA gene sequence database with phylotypes that represent uncultured species
data.abstractNote:
Despite recent advances in commercially optimized identification systems, bacterial identification remains a challenging task in many routine microbiological laboratories, especially in situations where taxonomically novel isolates are involved. The 16S rRNA gene has been used extensively for this task when coupled with a well-curated database, such as EzTaxon, containing sequences of type strains of prokaryotic species with validly published names. Although the EzTaxon database has been widely used for routine identification of prokaryotic isolates, sequences from uncultured prokaryotes have not been considered. Here, the next generation database, named EzTaxon-e, is formally introduced. This new database covers not only species within the formal nomenclatural system but also phylotypes that may represent species in nature. In addition to an identification function based on Basic Local Alignment Search Tool (
              blast
              ) searches and pairwise global sequence alignments, a new objective method of assessing the degree of completeness in sequencing is proposed. All sequences that are held in the EzTaxon-e database have been subjected to phylogenetic analysis and this has resulted in a complete hierarchical classification system. It is concluded that the EzTaxon-e database provides a useful taxonomic backbone for the identification of cultured and uncultured prokaryotes and offers a valuable means of communication among microbiologists who routinely encounter taxonomically novel isolates. The database and its analytical functions can be found at
              http://eztaxon-e.ezbiocloud.net/
              .

data.title: 现代海洋药物研发进展与浅析
data.abstractNote: 海洋药物历史悠久但发展缓慢,在90年代开始正式进入到热点研究领域。随着海洋药物研究的深入,国际范围内逐渐有数个药物获得上市批准,并有大量的海洋药物或衍生物进入不同阶段的临床试验;但海洋药物的发展速度仍远慢于其他类型的药物。海洋来源的物质具有区别于其他药物的特点,结构新颖、活性独特,是优良的药物宝库。但海洋药物发展受到多方面因素的限制,需要综合社会与技术资源并依托优良的政策以从根本上解决相关问题。本文概述了海洋药物的研发进展并对相关问题进行了浅析。

data.title: Antimicrobial activity of natural products against MDR bacteria: A scientometric visualization analysis
data.abstractNote:
Objective:
              A growing number of studies have demonstrated the antimicrobial activity of natural products against multidrug-resistant bacteria. This study aimed to apply scientometric method to explore the current status and future trends in this field.
            
            
              Methods:
              All relevant original articles and reviews for the period 1997–2021 were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection database. VOSviewer, a scientometric software, and an online bibliometric analysis platform were used to conduct visualization study.
            
            
              Results:
              A total of 1,267 papers were included, including 1,005 original articles and 262 reviews. The United States and India made the largest contribution in this field. The University of Dschang from Cameroon produced the most publications. Coutinho HDM, Kuete V, and Gibbons S were key researchers, as they published a great many articles and were co-cited in numerous publications. Frontiers in Microbiology and Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy were the most influential journals with the highest number of publications and co-citations, respectively. “Medicinal plants”, “methicillin-resistant
              Staphylococcus aureus
              ”, “biofilm”, “minimum inhibitory concentration”, and “efflux pumps” were the most frequently used keywords, so these terms are presumed to be the current hot topics. All the included keywords could be roughly divided into four major themes, of which the theme of “natural product development approach” had attracted much attention in recent years. Furthermore, “
              Pseudomonas aeruginosa
              ”, “nanoparticles”, “green synthesis”, “antimicrobial peptides”, “antibiofilm”, “biosynthetic gene clusters”, and “molecular dynamics simulation” had the latest average appearance year, indicating that these topics may become the research hot spots in the coming years.
            
            
              Conclusion:
              This study performed a scientometric analysis of the antibacterial activity of natural products against multidrug-resistant bacteria from a holistic perspective. It is hoped to provide novel and useful data for scientific research, and help researchers to explore this field more intuitively and effectively.

data.note:
**核心主题**:

本综述深入探讨了从1981年至2019年近四十年间，天然产物作为新药来源的重要性和演变，以及它们在现代药物发现中的作用。

#### 1. 综述背景与目的

Newman和Cragg的综述是对先前在1997年至2016年间发表的五篇综述的更新和扩展。这些综述记录了天然产物在药物开发中的贡献。本篇综述的目的在于评估天然产物及其衍生物在新药批准中的比例和趋势，以及它们在不同治疗领域中的应用。

#### 2. 研究方法与数据范围

研究涵盖了1981年1月至2019年9月期间全球批准的所有治疗剂，特别关注了抗肿瘤药物。作者采用了严格的计数方法，只计算了每种药物的首次批准，不考虑后续的生物仿制药或额外批准。

#### 3. 天然产物的分类

文章中将药物分为几个主要类别：

- **N**: 未改变的天然产物

- **ND**: 天然产物衍生物

- **S**: 完全合成药物

- **S***: 虽然完全合成，但药效团来自天然产物

- **NB**: 植物药（定义混合物），现在被FDA等机构认可为药物实体

#### 4. 天然产物药物的批准情况

从1981年到2019年，共有1881种新药被批准。其中，天然产物及其衍生物在新药批准中占有显著比例。特别是在癌症治疗领域，这些药物的贡献尤为突出。

#### 5. 天然产物在不同治疗领域的作用

- **抗肿瘤药物**: 从1946年到1980年，75种小分子药物中有40种（53.3%）是天然产物或其衍生物。1981年至今，185种小分子药物中有62种（33.5%）属于天然产物或其衍生物，如果包括S*和S*/NM，这一比例上升到64.9%。

- **抗感染药物**: 这一领域对天然产物及其结构的依赖性很高。

#### 6. 组合化学技术的角色

尽管组合化学技术在药物结构优化方面取得了成功，但在39年的时间跨度内，只有少数几种de novo组合化合物被批准为药物。

#### 7. 临床试验中的药物候选实体

文章讨论了作为“弹头”的候选药物实体，这些实体目前正处于临床试验阶段，显示出天然产物在新药开发中的持续潜力。

#### 8. 微生物和宿主相互作用的重要性

许多天然产物药物/前体实际上是由微生物和/或微生物与宿主的相互作用产生的。这一发现强调了扩展天然产物研究领域的重要性。

#### 9. 结论与未来展望

综述得出结论，天然产物在新药发现和开发过程中继续发挥着重要作用。尽管面临诸多挑战，但天然产物的潜力依然巨大，尤其是在抗药性问题日益严重的背景下。

#### 深入解读

- **天然产物的持续贡献**: 尽管大型制药公司对天然产物药物研发的投资有所减少，但天然产物在新药批准中的比例并未下降，显示出其不可替代的价值。

- **抗药性挑战**: 抗药性是全球健康的重大威胁，天然产物提供了开发新抗生素的潜在资源，有助于应对这一挑战。

- **跨学科合作的必要性**: 天然产物的研究需要化学家、生物学家、药理学家等多学科专家的合作，以推动新药的发现和开发。

- **政策和资金支持的重要性**: 政府和基金会的支持对于维持天然产物研究的活力至关重要，尤其是在当前药物研发成本高昂的背景下。

- **对现有药物的再利用**: 许多已批准的药物可能具有未被充分利用的治疗潜力，对这些药物的进一步研究可能揭示新的治疗应用。

### 结论

Newman和Cragg的综述提供了对天然产物在药物发现中作用的全面回顾。尽管面临挑战，但天然产物依然是新药发现的重要源泉。文章强调了跨学科合作的重要性，并指出了政策和资金支持在推动该领域发展中的关键作用。同时，作者也对未来天然产物在药物发现中的潜力持乐观态度。

data.note:
这篇综述文章由Kim Lewis等人撰写，发表在2024年8月1日的《自然》杂志上，题为《精制天然产物作为抗生素》（Sophisticated natural products as antibiotics）。文章深入探讨了一类特殊的天然产物抗生素，它们的作用机制超越了简单抑制必需酶的活性位点。这些化合物为设计新的抗菌剂提供了灵感，并且研究了它们复杂的机制，这些机制有效针对细菌，包括共价结合剂、抗耐药性抑制剂、利用自我促进进入的化合物、逃避耐药性、前药、目标腐败剂、针对“不可药化”目标的抑制剂、形成超分子复合物的化合物，以及选择性作用于膜的药剂等。

### 文章概述

文章首先指出，抗生素是自然界最古老的毒素，这些小分子作为细菌战争的武器进化而来，执行多重且经常相互对立的任务。它们需要击中不同微生物的同源目标，具有亲水性以到达邻近细胞并穿透革兰氏阴性菌的外膜，同时具有疏水性以穿过细胞质膜，逃避耐药机制，并在恶劣的外部环境中存活。成为药物的化合物还必须具备良好的药代动力学特性（能够在组织中移动而不会被迅速破坏或隔离）以及对宿主无毒性。满足所有这些标准的天然产物很少，制造合成抗生素是药物化学中最具有挑战性的任务之一。

“Gram-negative bacteria have an additional outer membrane that restricts penetration of large and hydrophobic compounds, and compounds that do enter these bacteria are extruded by multidrug efflux pumps
🔤革兰氏阴性细菌有一层额外的外膜，限制大分子和疏水性化合物的渗透，进入这些细菌的化合物会被多药外排泵排出体外🔤” (Lewis 等, 2024, p. 39)

“Compounds that become drugs must possess two additional properties: good pharmacokinetics (an ability to move through tissues without being rapidly destroyed or sequestered), and a lack of toxicity to the host” (Lewis 等, 2024, p. 39)

### 抗生素的挑战与机遇

文章讨论了抗生素发现的历史，特别是自1960年代以来，新的抗生素的发现变得稀少，导致了当前的抗菌素耐药性危机。这是一个缓慢发展的全球大流行病，耐药菌株的传播与每年全球约有五百万人死亡有关。文章强调了对新型化合物的迫切需求，特别是针对多重耐药的革兰氏阴性细菌，如肺炎克雷伯菌、大肠杆菌、鲍曼不动杆菌和铜绿假单胞菌。

“Since then, the introduction of novel compounds has been infrequent, resulting in the current antimicrobial resistance crisis.
🔤从那时起，新型化合物的引入就不再频繁，导致了当前的抗菌药耐药性危机。🔤” (Lewis 等, 2024, p. 39)

“Currently, there is a pressing need for novel compounds that act against multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria
🔤目前，亟需能对付耐多药革兰氏阴性菌的新型化合物🔤” (Lewis 等, 2024, p. 39)

### 天然产物的多样性与新作用机制

文章重点介绍了一些具有新颖作用机制的天然产物，例如β-内酰胺类抗生素，它们通过共价结合抑制转肽酶和β-内酰胺酶；侧链菌素嵌合体利用进口机制将抗生素偷运进细胞；以及氨基糖苷类抗生素，它们破坏目标而非仅仅抑制。一些机制非常复杂，例如darobactins的预形成的β-链，针对不可药化的β-桶蛋白BamA，或者teixobactin，它与肽聚糖的前体结合，然后形成超分子结构损害膜，阻碍耐药性的发展。

### 新型抗生素的发现与开发

文章还讨论了新型抗生素的发现和开发，包括从非放线菌细菌中寻找新化合物、利用环境DNA直接克隆到异源宿主中的“沉默”生物合成基因簇，以及合成抗生素的发现。文章强调了从天然产物中汲取灵感的重要性，这些天然产物为我们提供了如何制造抗生素的配方，虽然这个配方不容易遵循，但它指引了正确的方向。

### 深入解读

这篇文章提供了对抗生素耐药性危机的深刻见解，并探讨了一系列新型抗生素的发现和作用机制。作者强调了从天然产物中学习的重要性，这些天然产物展示了抗生素可能具有的几乎所有理想特性，从低耐药性发展倾向到根除休眠细胞或针对特定病原体的选择性活性。

文章中提到的抗生素，如teixobactin、darobactin和dynobactin，都是最近从少量生产者中发现的，这表明有用的天然产物抗生素的发现将会继续，并且计算基因组学和化学信息学的进步可能会有助于通过识别有吸引力的生物合成基因簇来促进这一努力。

“This suggests that useful natural product antibiotics will continue to be discovered, and advances in computational genomics and cheminformatics are likely to contribute to this effort by identifying attractive BGCs1
🔤这表明，有用的天然产物抗生素将继续被发现，而计算基因组学和化学信息学的进步很可能会通过识别有吸引力的 BGCs 来促进这一努力1。🔤” (Lewis 等, 2024, p. 47)

此外，文章还讨论了抗生素的多重特性，许多抗生素具有多个值得关注的属性，这些属性并不必然源于化学复杂性。例如，最简单的前药azoxanthin及其衍生物甲硝唑展示了多种特性，包括通过多种硝基还原酶激活前药、与DNA和其他靶标的结合，以及对DNA的共价修饰，有助于化合物在细胞内的积累。

最后，文章展望了抗生素需求的演变，以及如何通过新的方法来应对不断变化的医疗需求，包括治疗免疫受损患者中的慢性感染、开发针对特定病原体的选择性化合物，以及应对新兴的病原体。作者指出，尽管疫苗和小分子抗生素目前是我们对抗细菌病原体的最佳防线，但自然产品向我们展示了开发新型抗生素的广阔前景，并可能指导我们发现新的抗菌策略。

综上所述，这篇综述文章深入探讨了天然产物在抗生素发现中的作用，强调了从这些复杂分子中学习的重要性，并展望了未来抗生素开发的方向。

data.note:
这篇综述文章由Atanas G. Atanasov等人撰写，题为《Natural products in drug discovery: advances and opportunities》，发表在《Nature Reviews Drug Discovery》上。文章深入探讨了天然产物（Natural Products, NPs）在药物发现中的重要角色，尤其是在抗癌和传染病治疗领域。同时，文章也指出了天然产物在药物发现过程中所面临的技术障碍和挑战，并总结了近年来在这一领域的技术与科学进展，以及它们为天然产物基药物发现带来的新机遇。

### 天然产物在药物发现中的重要性

天然产物，包括植物、微生物和海洋生物的次级代谢产物，历史上一直是新药发现的重要来源。文章指出，与合成分子相比，天然产物具有独特的结构多样性和复杂性，通常具有更高的分子量、更多的氧和sp3碳原子、较低的辛醇-水分配系数（cLogP值，表明更高的亲水性）以及更大的分子刚性。这些特性使得天然产物在药物发现中具有独特的优势，尤其是在针对蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的药物开发中。

“Natural products and their structural analogues have historically made a major contribution to pharmacotherapy, especially for cancer and infectious diseases.” (the International Natural Product Sciences Taskforce 等, 2021, p. 200)

### 天然产物面临的挑战

尽管天然产物具有诸多优势，但它们在药物发现中的应用也面临一些挑战。例如，天然产物的筛选通常涉及从自然来源提取的提取物库，这可能与传统的基于靶点的分析不兼容。此外，从这些提取物中识别出活性化合物可能具有挑战性，需要应用去重工具以避免重新发现已知化合物。获取足够的生物材料以分离和表征活性天然产物也可能具有挑战性。此外，获取展示相关生物活性的未修饰天然产物的知识产权（IP）权利可能是一个障碍，因为以原始形式存在的天然产物可能无法获得专利保护。

### 技术与科学进展

文章强调了近年来在天然产物基药物发现中的几项关键技术与科学进展，包括改进的分析工具、基因组挖掘和工程策略、微生物培养技术的进步等。这些进展正在解决天然产物发现过程中的挑战，并为新药发现开辟了新的机会。

- **分析技术**：文章讨论了如何使用代谢组学和其他分析技术来加速天然产物的鉴定和去重过程，以及如何利用这些技术来理解天然产物的作用机制。

 

- **基因组挖掘和工程**：通过基因组挖掘，研究人员可以在生物体的基因组中识别出可能控制生物合成途径的基因。此外，通过基因工程，可以在更易于培养和遗传操作的宿主中异源表达这些基因，以提高天然产物的产量和可获得性。

- **培养系统**：为了更好地模拟天然环境并促进“未培养”微生物的生长，研究人员开发了多种培养策略，包括改变培养条件、共培养、模拟自然环境的培养平台等。

### 未来方向

文章最后强调了天然产物药物发现的未来方向，包括针对抗微生物耐药性、癌症治疗、免疫调节和肠道微生物组等领域的研究。此外，文章还讨论了如何通过化学合成、半合成策略和生物合成工程来优化天然产物的药理学特性，以及如何通过计算工具和数据库来支持天然产物的发现和开发。

### 结论

Atanasov等人的综述提供了对天然产物在药物发现中作用的全面概述，并强调了技术创新如何帮助克服传统障碍，为未来药物发现开辟新道路。尽管存在挑战，但天然产物仍然是一个充满希望的领域，可以为人类健康和长寿做出重大贡献。

data.note:
这篇综述文章由Edward F. DeLong和David M. Karl撰写，发表于2005年9月15日的《自然》杂志，题为《微生物海洋学的基因组视角》（Genomic perspectives in microbial oceanography）。文章深入探讨了基因组学如何显著扩展我们对海洋微生物进化、代谢和生态学的理解，并强调了将这些新的基因组学见解整合到海洋科学更广泛框架中的重要性。

### 文章概述

文章首先指出，尽管对海洋物理和化学基础已有深入理解，但对海洋微生物多样性和过程的全面描述和解释才刚刚起步。海洋生态系统复杂且动态，要理解其对全球环境变化和由温室气体驱动的气候变化的敏感性，需要全面描述包括物理、化学和生物相互作用在内的多个因素。

### 海洋微生物的重要性

文章强调了海洋微生物在海洋中的核心作用，它们在溶解有机物转化为更高营养级的过程中扮演关键角色，这一点通过“微生物循环”假说得到体现。然而，对微生物循环假说的全面和综合性测试尚未实现，且微生物活动在维持地球氧化状态和其他生物地球化学循环中的核心作用也未得到充分体现。

### 微生物海洋学面临的挑战

作者提出，微生物海洋学家面临的一个主要挑战是将微生物的多样性、生理学和生态学细节更准确地纳入海洋学和生物地球化学模型中。例如，早期的海洋学模型常常将浮游细菌群落过程建模为纯粹的异养性，忽视了它们实际的多样生理学和代谢过程。

### 基因组学的应用

文章讨论了基因组学在理解海洋微生物适应性、生理学和生态学方面的应用。通过基因组序列，研究人员可以探索海洋微生物的遗传型、表型和环境之间的关系。例如，通过研究硅藻的基因组，科学家们可以了解这些海洋初级生产力的主要贡献者的进化成功。

### 环境基因组学的发展

文章还介绍了环境基因组学的发展，这是一种不依赖于培养的方法，可以直接从自然环境中获取微生物群落的基因组信息。这种方法为研究自然微生物世界提供了新的视角，并有助于揭示微生物群落的复杂性和功能。

### 当代微生物海洋学的挑战

作者指出，当前微生物海洋学面临的一个共同批评是数据积累虽多，但知识增长有限。信息学挑战虽然显著，但并非不可克服。研究社区需要认识到环境基因组数据集与其他现有数据库有本质的不同，因为它们并非来源于单一的菌株、物种或遗传位点，而是来自单一微生物群落的集体基因。

### 结论

文章最后总结，海洋微生物在海水中以数十亿个细胞每升的数量存在，它们通过病毒寄生和原生动物捕食者以大致相同的速率进行繁殖和消耗，这些活动捕获和处理能量，驱动主要的元素循环。这些动态的群落和多样的基因组结构中隐藏着关于环境感知、响应和适应、基因调控、物种和群落相互作用以及基因组的可塑性和进化的基本但目前不完整的课程。

### 深入解读

这篇文章提供了对海洋微生物研究的全面回顾，并强调了基因组学在理解海洋微生物生态系统中的关键作用。作者不仅讨论了海洋微生物的生物地球化学重要性，还强调了它们在气候变化和全球环境变化中的潜在影响。

文章中提到的一个关键概念是微生物循环假说，这一假说认为微生物在海洋中的物质和能量流动中起着中心作用。然而，作者指出，尽管这一假说已被广泛接受，但其全面测试尚未实现，且微生物在地球氧化状态和其他生物地球化学循环中的作用也未得到充分认识。

此外，文章还强调了环境基因组学的重要性，这是一种允许科学家直接从环境中获取微生物群落基因组信息的方法。这种方法的发展为研究微生物群落的复杂性和功能提供了新的工具，有助于揭示微生物如何响应和适应环境变化。

作者还讨论了微生物海洋学中的一些挑战，包括如何将微生物的多样性和生态学细节整合到海洋学模型中，以及如何克服环境基因组学中的信息学挑战。这些挑战的解决对于提高我们对海洋生态系统的理解至关重要。

最后，文章呼吁微生物学家、海洋学家和生态学家共同努力，通过整合观察、方法和理论，更好地描述生命海洋系统。这种跨学科的合作将有助于我们更深入地理解海洋微生物如何在全球范围内影响能量和物质的流动、生物地球化学循环以及地球的大气组成和气候变化趋势。

海洋环境对微生物的影响：

根据文章内容，海洋环境中的微生物面临的环境压力主要包括：

1. **高盐度**：海洋环境中的盐度较高，微生物必须适应这种高渗透压环境。

2. **温度变化**：海洋温度随深度和地理位置变化，从表层的温暖水域到深海的寒冷环境，微生物需要适应不同的温度条件。

3. **光照变化**：从表层的光照充足到深海的完全黑暗，微生物必须适应不同的光照条件，这对光合作用微生物尤其重要。

4. **压力变化**：随着深度的增加，海洋环境中的压力也会增加，深海微生物需要适应高压环境。

5. **营养物质的可用性**：海洋中营养物质的分布和浓度变化很大，微生物需要适应不同的营养条件，有时可能面临营养限制。

6. **溶解氧的可用性**：在某些海洋区域，如深海或缺氧区，溶解氧的浓度可能很低，微生物需要适应这些低氧或无氧条件。

7. **pH变化**：海洋环境的pH值可能因地点和深度而异，微生物需要适应不同的pH条件。

8. **重金属浓度**：某些海洋环境，如酸性矿山排水区域，可能含有高浓度的重金属，微生物需要具备应对这些毒性物质的能力。

9. **病毒压力**：海洋病毒可以显著影响微生物群落的结构和功能，微生物需要应对病毒的捕食压力。

10. **人类活动的影响**：包括气候变化、污染和海洋酸化等，这些因素都可能对海洋微生物产生压力。

这些环境压力塑造了海洋微生物的多样性和适应性，促使它们演化出一系列独特的生存策略。

“Adaptation to the unique characteristics of their environment defines the essence of marine microbial species. High salinity, low and variable nutrient concentrations and steep gradients of temperature, light, pressure and nutrients with increasing depth are some of the environmental variables that influence the evolution of form and function in microbial plankton.
🔤适应环境的独特特征决定了海洋微生物物种的本质。高盐度、低而多变的营养浓度以及随深度增加而陡峭的温度、光照、压力和营养梯度是影响微生物浮游生物形态和功能演变的一些环境变量。🔤” (DeLong 和 Karl, 2005, p. 337)

这篇综述文章由Wen-Sheng Shu和Li-Nan Huang撰写，发表在《自然综述微生物学》杂志上，标题为《极端环境中的微生物多样性》（Microbial diversity in extreme environments）。文章全面探讨了在地球极端环境中生存的微生物类群，这些环境包括陆地热泉、深海热液喷口、冰川和多年冻土、高盐环境、酸性矿山排水（AMD）以及地下环境等。尽管这些环境在物理化学条件上极为严酷，但它们为各类微生物提供了多样的生态位。

### 文章概述

文章首先介绍了极端环境的分布和特点，强调了这些环境中微生物的适应策略，并指出这些微生物定义了生命的物理和地球化学极限。作者回顾了历史上依赖培养方法的微生物学研究，以及如何通过16S rRNA基因克隆库分析等非培养独立方法揭示了大量未被培养的微生物多样性。

### 微生物多样性和新谱系

文章重点讨论了极端环境中的微生物多样性，尤其是美国黄石国家公园的陆地热泉，这些地区在早期16S rRNA基因库分析中具有显著地位。通过广泛的基因调查，科学家们获得了对各种极端栖息地微生物群落的组成和多样性的全面了解。这些调查结果通常由更近期的宏基因组分析所支持。

“Extreme environments, such as terrestrial hot springs and deep sea hydrothermal vents, glaciers and permafrost, hypersaline habitats, acid mine drainage (AMD) and the subsurface, are widely distributed around the globe” (Shu 和 Huang, 2022, p. 219)

### 宏基因组分析

宏基因组分析允许直接从环境中恢复总社区DNA的测序和基因组分析，为研究微生物群落的组成、多样性和生态功能提供了新的视角。通过宏基因组学，科学家们能够重建接近完整或甚至封闭的微生物基因组，并为难以培养的极端微生物提供了初步的代谢潜力和进化历史的见解。

### 微生物生态和进化

文章还讨论了极端环境中微生物的生态和进化，包括它们如何适应极端环境的压力，例如通过改变细胞膜成分、产生热休克蛋白、维持DNA稳定性等机制。此外，文章探讨了微生物如何在低温、高盐、酸性和金属适应等方面发展出独特的生存策略。

### 极端环境的微生物群落功能和动态

作者强调了宏基因组学在揭示微生物群落功能和动态方面的潜力，尤其是在不需要培养的情况下。通过元组学分析，研究人员能够直接从环境中恢复基因组和转录组信息，揭示了微生物群落对环境变化的响应。

### 结论

文章最后总结了几十年来对极端环境微生物多样性的调查，这些调查显著地揭示了微生物的系统发育广度。文章指出，尽管研究强度在不同类型的极端环境之间存在高度不平衡，但继续对未培养的微生物类群进行基因组探索将是一个主要的研究主题。此外，文章强调了对极端环境中的真核生物和病毒进行生态和进化分析的重要性，这些微生物在自然微生物群落中扮演着关键角色。

### 深入解读

这篇综述提供了对极端环境微生物多样性的全面认识，强调了这些微生物在适应极端条件方面的独特机制，以及它们在地球生命极限中的作用。文章突出了非培养方法在微生物学研究中的重要性，这些方法允许科学家探索那些难以通过传统培养技术研究的微生物类群。

此外，文章还讨论了微生物如何在极端环境中发展出多样的生存策略，这些策略不仅对理解微生物的适应性至关重要，也为生物技术和医学研究提供了潜在的应用前景。例如，一些极端环境中的微生物能够产生独特的生物活性化合物，这些化合物可能具有新的药用价值。

文章还强调了对极端环境微生物群落进行元组学分析的重要性，这些分析揭示了微生物群落如何响应环境变化，并对全球生物地球化学循环产生影响。通过这些研究，科学家们能够更好地理解微生物在自然界中的角色，以及它们如何塑造地球生态系统的功能。

最后，文章提出了未来研究的方向，包括对未培养微生物类群的基因组探索、对极端环境中真核生物和病毒的生态和进化研究，以及利用元组学数据预测自然群落的组成和功能。这些研究将有助于我们更深入地理解微生物在更复杂自然生态系统中的作用，以及它们如何响应和影响全球环境变化。

data.note:
这篇文章是由Lucas Paoli等人撰写的，发表在《自然》（Nature）杂志2022年7月7日的一期上，题为《全球海洋微生物组的生物合成潜力》（Biosynthetic potential of the global ocean microbiome）。这篇文章是一项开创性的研究，它通过整合大约10,000个来自培养和单细胞的微生物基因组，以及从1000多个海水样本中新重建的超过25,000个草图基因组，探索了海洋微生物的生物合成基因簇（BGCs）的多样性和新颖性。

### 文章概述

文章首先强调了自然微生物群落的系统发育和代谢多样性，并指出这些多样性中蕴含着大量未被充分探索的生态和生物技术相关酶和生化化合物的发现潜力。然而，由于全球规模上基因组解析数据的分析限制，开放海洋中微生物的生物合成潜力大部分还未被探索。

“However, despite recent attempts to establish genome-resolved explorations of various microbiomes16,19, for the ocean—the largest ecosystem on Earth—over two-thirds of global metagenomic data still remain unaccounted for16,20
🔤然而，尽管最近尝试对各种微生物组进行基因组分辨探索16,19 ，但对于海洋--地球上最大的生态系统--超过三分之二的全球元基因组数据仍未统计16,20。🔤” (Paoli 等, 2022, p. 112)

### 研究方法

研究者们采用了环境基因组学和单细胞基因组学的技术进步，直接对整个微生物群落（宏基因组）或单细胞中的微生物DNA片段进行测序。通过将这些片段组装成更大的基因组片段，并重建多个宏基因组组装基因组（MAGs）或单放大基因组（SAGs），研究者们能够绕过传统的基于分类群的研究方法，直接探索微生物群落及其遗传物质。

### 研究发现

研究揭示了约40,000个推定的新型生物合成基因簇，其中许多发现于以前未被怀疑的系统发育群组中。特别地，研究者们识别了一个富含生物合成基因簇的谱系（'Candidatus Eudoremicrobiaceae'），它属于一个未被培养的细菌门，并且包含了这个环境中生物合成多样性最丰富的一些微生物。

### 科学意义

这项研究展示了微生物组学驱动的策略如何能够使研究者们得以调查以前未被描述的酶和天然产物，尤其是在未被充分探索的微生物群落和环境中。这对于发现新的生物合成途径和化合物具有重要意义，这些新发现可能在生物技术和治疗应用中具有潜在价值。

### 研究细节

文章详细描述了研究者们如何通过整合海洋微生物基因组，建立一个全面的系统发育和基因功能数据库。通过使用antiSMASH软件对所有MAGs、SAGs和REFs进行分析，预测了总共39,055个生物合成基因簇，并进一步将它们聚类为6,907个非冗余的基因簇家族（GCFs）和151个基因簇族（GCCs）。

### 结论

文章最后得出结论，通过重建MAGs和SAGs，尤其是对未被充分探索的微生物群落的研究，可以访问到大部分的系统发育和功能新颖性。研究者们特别关注了'Candidatus Eudoremicrobiaceae'作为一个特别具有生物合成潜力的谱系，但同时指出，其他未被发现的微生物群落中预测的BGCs也可能编码以前未被描述的酶学，这些酶学产生的化合物可能具有生态和/或生物技术相关的活性。

### 深入解读

这篇文章的研究不仅在科学上具有创新性，而且在方法论上也提供了新的视角。通过宏基因组学和单细胞基因组学的结合，研究者们能够绕过传统的培养依赖性方法，直接从自然环境中获取微生物的遗传信息。这种方法的运用，不仅极大地扩展了我们对海洋微生物多样性的认识，也为发现新的生物活性化合物提供了新的途径。

此外，文章中对'Candidatus Eudoremicrobiaceae'的发现，特别引人注目。这一谱系的微生物在海洋中具有丰富的生物合成潜力，但其在自然环境中的作用和生态意义尚不清楚。这为未来的研究提供了新的方向，即探索这些微生物如何与海洋环境中的其他生物相互作用，以及它们产生的化合物如何影响海洋生态系统的功能。

最后，这项研究还强调了开放科学的重要性。通过将生成的资源提供给科学界，研究者们鼓励更广泛的合作和知识共享，这将有助于加速新发现的转化和应用。

综上所述，这篇文章提供了一个全面而深入的视角，展示了全球海洋微生物组的生物合成潜力，以及如何通过现代基因组学方法来探索和利用这一潜力。随着对海洋微生物群落更深入的理解，我们有望在未来发现更多具有生态和商业价值的生物活性化合物。

这篇文章《A wealth of new biosynthetic pathways from the global ocean microbiome》并非一篇传统意义上的综述文章，而是一篇研究报告的概述，发表在《Nature》杂志上。该研究由Lucas Paoli和Serina Robinson等人完成，旨在探索全球海洋微生物组中的生物合成潜力，并建立一个更好的基因组资源，以代表世界各地的海洋微生物，并探索这些微生物产生的生化化合物的多样性和细胞功能。

### 详细介绍

**研究背景：**

海洋覆盖了地球表面的71%，包含了地球水资源的97%。每一滴水都包含了成千上万的微生物细胞，主要是细菌和古菌，它们共同构成了全球海洋微生物组。然而，由于大多数海洋微生物目前无法在实验室中培养，因此我们对海洋微生物的遗传多样性和生物合成途径的了解还很有限。

**研究目的：**

研究团队的目标是建立一个基因组资源，更好地代表全球海洋中的微生物，并探索这些微生物的化学潜力，以开发有用的生物催化剂和治疗药物的先导化合物。

**研究发现：**

通过对全球215个海洋站点收集的1000多个水样进行元基因组分析，研究团队使用先进的计算方法重建了26,293个微生物基因组，并发现了超过2700个未描述的物种。这些基因组与公开可用的基因组结合，构建了海洋微生物组数据库（Ocean Microbiomics Database），该数据库捕获了40-60%的开放海洋元基因组数据。

**生物合成基因簇（BGCs）：**

通过挖掘这一资源，研究团队发现了约40,000个生物合成基因簇，这些基因簇预计编码约7000种生化化合物的合成途径，其中超过一半可能是新发现的化合物。这些化合物不仅在生态学上具有重要作用，而且许多可能具有药物样性质。

**新家族的发现：**

研究中还发现了一种具有异常高数量和多样性BGCs的细菌谱系，这一谱系属于尚未充分探索的“Candidatus Eremiobacterota”门。研究团队将这一新家族命名为“Candidatus Eudoremicrobiaceae”，以希腊神话中以精美礼物著称的海中仙女Eudore命名。

**实验验证：**

通过对细菌宿主中表达的两个BGCs进行实验验证，研究团队表征了新的生物合成酶和天然产物。其中，phospeptin途径产生的肽能够抑制蛋白酶，为开发治疗药物提供了化学模板；pythonamide途径编码了一个巨大的肽，它属于一个新的酶家族，能够催化向肽骨架添加甲基基团，这一反应可能在生物技术过程中得到应用。

### 深入解读

**生物合成活动的图景：**

这项研究为全球海洋微生物的生物合成活动提供了前所未有的图景，并为未来在海洋生态学、进化、生物技术和天然产物药物发现等领域的研究提供了指导。

**计算与分子方法的结合：**

研究展示了结合计算和分子方法来识别遗传序列的功能，即使是对于在实验室中尚未培养的微生物门，这种方法也是有效的。

**准确性的局限性：**

研究中对phospeptin和pythonamide生物合成途径的计算预测与生化表征之间存在一些差异，表明仅通过与已知基因序列比较来推断酶反应和天然产物结构的准确性存在限制。因此，实验验证在发现生物功能和化合物方面仍然是一个关键步骤。

**未探索的丰富资源：**

研究中仅对数千个预测途径中的两个进行了化学表征，意味着还有大量的生物合成酶和化学化合物有待研究。

**开放资源的提供：**

海洋微生物组数据库（Ocean Microbiomics Database）是一个免费资源，供研究社区使用，旨在邀请全球科学家共同探索海洋微生物多样性，以发现新的酶、途径和特殊代谢物，并阐明它们的生态功能和潜在用途。

### 结论

这项研究不仅为海洋微生物组的生物合成潜力提供了新的视角，也为未来的研究和应用开辟了新的道路。通过建立海洋微生物组数据库，研究团队为全球科学家提供了一个宝贵的资源，以促进对海洋微生物及其生物合成潜力的深入理解。这项工作强调了跨学科合作的重要性，并展示了如何利用现代计算方法和实验技术来探索和利用海洋微生物的化学多样性。

这篇评论文章《Making marine biotechnology work for people and nature》由Robert Blasiak等人撰写，发表在《Nature Ecology & Evolution》上。文章讨论了如何将快速发展的海洋经济转变为基于可持续性、公平性和包容性原则的“蓝色经济”，特别强调了海洋生物技术在这一转变中的关键作用。

**背景：**

海洋经济包括航运、旅游和水产养殖等多个经济部门，其全球规模和快速增长引发了担忧，因为其好处主要集中在少数国家和公司手中，而海洋生态系统的退化影响着全球。因此，越来越多的呼声要求将海洋经济转变为一个与可持续性、公平性和包容性原则一致的“蓝色经济”。

**海洋生物技术的角色：**

海洋生物技术是利用海洋生物来解决问题和制造有用产品，它对多个行业具有重要意义，并且有潜力成为蓝色经济的一部分。海洋生物技术的进步可以为低收入和中等收入国家带来巨大好处，因为这些国家拥有世界上最多样化的海洋生态系统。

**挑战：**

尽管海洋生物技术具有巨大潜力，但它几乎完全由高度工业化国家推动，并且与蓝色经济的公平性和包容性原则不一致。国际谈判努力消除这种不平等，但由于生物技术的快速发展，监管框架的发展跟不上，导致谈判结果复杂多变。

**海洋生物技术的复杂性和权衡：**

海洋生物技术经常导致可以有助于实现可持续性目标的创新，例如提高水产养殖产量的基因工程三文鱼。但这样的进步虽然提高了食物产量，也可能鼓励过度依赖单一作物和三文鱼养殖场向更多沿海地区的扩张，可能伤害依赖野生三文鱼种群的当地和土著社区。

**监管框架的挑战：**

为了解决可持续性和公平性问题，大量工作集中在监管工具上。例如，《名古屋议定书》的生效旨在消除不公平和不道德的做法，包括生物剽窃。然而，政策制定的步伐远远落后于科学和技术进步。

**海洋生物技术的未来路径：**

作者提出了四个相互关联的路径，以加速将海洋生物技术转变为蓝色经济的一部分：

1. **加强低收入国家的能力：** 需要在多个层面上发展能力和缩小资源差距，使低收入和中等收入国家能够充分受益于海洋生物技术。

2. **公平和包容的研究合作：** 学术机构作为数据库增长的驱动力，需要确保代表性的包容性，与广泛的利益相关者开放和透明地合作。

3. **承诺负责任的数据共享：** 需要解决环境和基因序列数据库的互操作性和访问问题，确保数据基础设施与利益相关者共同设计。

4. **将海洋生物技术与海洋保护联系起来：** 海洋生物技术可以通过生物修复和生态系统监测等多种方式支持本地到全球的保护工作。

**结论：**

海洋生物技术已经产生了多种好处，但需要更多的努力来确保这一领域不会通过在获取、能力和机会上的明显差异来延续系统性的不公正。文章强调的四个路径为在需要的地方建立持久的能力、利用现有的进步，并加速朝着确保海洋生物技术行业采纳蓝色经济核心原则的进展提供了机会。

### 文章详细介绍

**引言：**

文章开头提出了海洋经济的快速增长及其对生态系统的潜在影响，强调了向蓝色经济转型的紧迫性。

**海洋生物技术的双刃剑：**

讨论了海洋生物技术带来的创新如何同时带来积极和消极的影响，例如基因工程三文鱼和转基因油菜的例子。

**监管框架的滞后：**

**构建蓝色经济的路径：**

**结论：**

总结了海洋生物技术对实现蓝色经济目标的重要性，并强调了采取协调行动的必要性。

文章最后感谢了资助机构和参与研究的个人，并列出了作者的贡献。

### 结论

Blasiak等人的评论文章为海洋生物技术如何更好地服务于人类和自然提供了深刻的见解。文章不仅强调了海洋生物技术在推动蓝色经济中的潜力，也指出了当前的挑战和需要改进的地方。通过提出的路径，作者呼吁各方采取行动，确保海洋生物技术的发展既科学先进，又公平可持续。

本文是一篇关于海洋沉积物中生物合成潜力和特殊代谢物的生物地理模式的研究文章，由Alexander B. Chase等人撰写，发表在《The ISME Journal》上。文章通过对法属波利尼西亚摩尔岛长期生态研究（LTER）站点收集的海洋沉积物样本进行多组学方法研究，探讨了微生物群落结构与特殊代谢物之间的关系。

**研究背景与目的：**

微生物生物地理学主要关注非生物因素对群落模式的贡献，但生物间的相互作用，特别是通过特殊代谢物介导的相互作用，对微生物群落结构的影响尚不清楚。本研究旨在填补这一空白，通过分析微生物群落结构和特殊代谢物在局部空间尺度上的关系，以了解这些相互作用如何影响微生物群落。

**方法论：**

研究者采用了多组学方法，包括16S rRNA基因测序、宏基因组测序和非靶向液相色谱-高分辨率质谱（LC-HRMS）等技术，对176个海洋沉积物样本进行了全面的生物地理和代谢组学分析。

**主要发现：**

- **生物地理模式：** 研究发现，微生物群落的生物地理模式主要由局部尺度过程（如生物相互作用）驱动，而与扩散限制关系不大。

- **生物合成潜力：** 即使在1平方米的样地内，样本间的生物合成潜力（基于Bray-Curtis差异性）也表现出高度变异性，反映了与特定场地相关的未被充分描述的化学空间。

- **代谢物与群落结构的关联：** 通过将生物合成潜力与群落代谢组相联系，研究促进了自然产物的现场检测，并揭示了沉积物微生物群落复杂代谢动态的新见解。

**研究意义：**

这项研究展示了将生物合成基因和代谢物生产整合到微生物群落动态评估中的潜力，为理解微生物群落如何通过化学通讯进行相互作用提供了新的视角。

### 文章详细介绍

**引言部分：**

文章开头介绍了微生物生物地理学的基本概念，以及环境选择、扩散和物种相互作用等生物地理过程对微生物多样性的影响。特别指出了微生物特殊代谢物在小尺度空间上对群落组成的潜在影响。

**材料与方法：**

详细描述了样本的收集地点、样本处理、DNA提取、16S rRNA基因测序、宏基因组测序和代谢组学分析的方法。研究者特别强调了减少环境变异以聚焦于生物相互作用的策略。

**结果：**

- **群落模式：** 描述了在摩尔岛LTER站点收集的沉积物样本中观察到的微生物群落组成模式。

- **功能保守与生物合成变异：** 研究者发现，尽管所有沉积物样本在氮循环和产甲烷基因方面表现出功能上的保守性，但在特殊代谢物的生产上表现出显著的局部变异。

- **生物合成潜力与群落代谢组的关联：** 通过LC-HRMS分析，研究者识别了大量独特的分子特征，并探讨了这些代谢物与微生物群落结构之间的关系。

**讨论：**

文章讨论了微生物自然产物在微生物群落构建中的作用，以及如何通过多组学方法来揭示这些复杂相互作用。

**结论：**

研究者总结了微生物群落的代谢组学分析如何为理解微生物多样性和分布提供新的维度，并强调了未来研究的方向。

**方法和材料：**

提供了实验的具体细节，包括样本收集、DNA和代谢物的提取、测序平台、数据处理和统计分析方法。

**数据可用性：**

文章提供了数据存储库和访问信息，确保了研究的可重复性和透明度。

**致谢和资金支持：**

文章最后感谢了资助机构和参与研究的个人和团队。

**作者贡献和利益冲突声明：**

明确了每位作者的贡献，并声明了研究的中立性。

### 结论

Chase等人的研究为我们提供了一个深入了解海洋沉积物微生物群落的新视角。通过多组学方法，研究揭示了微生物群落结构与特殊代谢物之间的复杂关系，并强调了生物相互作用在微生物生物地理学中的重要作用。这项研究不仅增进了我们对海洋微生物群落如何响应环境变化的理解，也为未来的微生物生态学和生物技术应用提供了宝贵的信息。

这篇综述文章《The ocean genome and future prospects for conservation and equity》由Robert Blasiak等人撰写，发表在《Nature Sustainability》上，深入探讨了海洋基因组的多样性、其对生态系统和商业的重要性，以及当前面临的保护和公平利用的挑战。以下是对该综述的提纲和详细介绍：

1. **引言**

  文章开头介绍了海洋基因组的概念，即海洋中所有生物的遗传物质总和，包括它们编码的信息。强调了海洋生物多样性对地球生态系统的重要性，以及保护这些遗传资源的必要性。

2. **海洋基因组的生态效益**

  论文讨论了遗传多样性如何为物种提供适应环境压力的能力，以及在渔业管理和生态恢复项目中的具体应用案例，如阿拉斯加布里斯托尔湾的鲑鱼和北美及印尼的海草床恢复项目。

3. **海洋基因组的商业利益**

  文章强调了海洋生物产生的次级代谢产物在商业上的潜力，特别是在药物开发、化妆品和营养保健品行业中的应用。提到了海洋天然产物在药物开发中的成功案例，以及在寻找新的抗微生物剂和生物修复材料方面的研究。

4. **海洋基因组的侵蚀**

  讨论了人类活动，如渔业、沿海开发和污染，以及气候变化对海洋生物多样性和基因组构成的威胁。强调了这些活动导致的物种分布变化和遗传多样性的下降。

5. **海洋基因组的保护策略**

  提出了保护海洋基因组的多种策略，包括实施有效的渔业配额、建立海洋保护区、减少海洋污染，以及利用环境DNA和基因组编辑技术进行生物多样性的监测和保护。

6. **海洋基因资源的公平和可持续利用**

  文章讨论了海洋基因资源的利用中的公平性和可持续性问题，提出了国际合作、包容性创新和知识产权管理的重要性，并探讨了如何通过国际治理机制和研究合作来实现公平的利益分享。

7. **未来展望**

  最后，文章提出了对未来海洋基因组研究和保护的建议，包括加强国际政策和治理，推动海洋基因组的保护和可持续利用，并强调了科学研究和技术创新在实现这些目标中的关键作用。

### 结论

综述文章综合考虑了海洋基因组的生态和商业价值，以及保护和公平利用的挑战，提出了一系列前瞻性的建议和策略。作者呼吁国际社会共同努力，以确保海洋基因组的长期健康和多样性，支持生物圈、人类和其他生命形式的福祉。

5. **脂肪酸 (Fatty acids)**

  - 讨论了脂肪酸作为普遍存在的天然产物，以及它们在海洋细菌中的生物合成途径，特别是含有环丙烷基团的中链脂肪酸的生物合成。

6. **萜类化合物 (Terpenoids)**

  - 描述了萜类化合物的多样性和它们在海洋细菌中的生物合成途径，以及特定的萜类合酶如何将异戊二烯单元转化为线性和环状核心结构。

  - 讨论了聚酮合酶的多样性和它们在海洋细菌中合成结构多样的次级代谢产物的作用，特别是那些最近才阐明生物合成途径的化合物。

  - 讨论了NRPS在合成具有药理学和工业重要性的次级代谢产物中的作用，以及它们如何与PKS一起形成混合PKS-NRPS组装线。

Exploring Newer Biosynthetic Gene Clusters in Marine Microbial Prospecting

一、引言

（一）背景介绍

1：抗生素耐药性的全球挑战：

抗生素耐药性（AMR）的迅速发展已成为全球公共卫生的重大威胁，导致现有抗生素的效力下降。

2：海洋微生物在新型抗生素开发中的潜力：

海洋环境独特的生态系统孕育了丰富的微生物多样性，这些微生物是新型抗生素的重要来源。

（二）研究目的

1：探索和鉴定海洋微生物中的新型生物合成基因簇（BGCs）：

旨在发掘海洋微生物中未被发现的BGCs，以寻找潜在的新型抗生素和其他生物活性化合物。

二、海洋微生物资源

（一）多样性和丰富性

1：海洋环境的独特生态系统：

海洋涵盖了地球表面的70%以上，具有独特的环境条件，如高盐度、高压、低温等。

“Marine ecosystem remains a unique environment due to its extreme pressure, cold temperature, lack of sunlight, varying salinity, and oxygen concentration
🔤海洋生态系统因其极端的压力、寒冷的温度、缺乏阳光、不同的盐度和氧气浓度而成为一个独特的环境。🔤” (Kaari 等, 2022, p. 448) 海洋生态环境的特点

2：各种海洋微生物（细菌、放线菌、真菌等）：

海洋微生物种类繁多，尤其是细菌、放线菌和真菌，它们是次生代谢产物的丰富来源。

“Microorganisms in the marine ecosystem are widely distributed from surface to deep-sea waters, thermal vents, sediments, and also in a wide range of marine organisms like sponges, corals, algae, fishes, and larger mammals
🔤海洋生态系统中的微生物分布广泛，从表层水到深海水域、热喷口、沉积物，以及海绵、珊瑚、藻类、鱼类和大型哺乳动物等各种海洋生物中都有微生物的存在。🔤” (Kaari 等, 2022, p. 448)

 

（二）研究价值

1：潜在的新型抗生素和生物活性分子：

海洋微生物次生代谢产物具有广泛的生物活性，可用于开发新型抗生素、抗肿瘤药物和其他药用化合物。

三、生物合成基因簇（BGCs）的概述

（一）定义和组成

1：BGCs的基本结构和功能：

BGCs是编码次生代谢产物合成的基因群，通常包括基因编码合酶、调控因子和运输蛋白等。

  - **BGCs的分类**

    - **聚酮化合物合成基因簇（PKS）**：主要生成聚酮类化合物，具有抗生素和抗肿瘤活性。

    - **非核糖体肽合成酶基因簇（NRPS）**：主要生成非核糖体肽类化合物，广泛用于抗生素和免疫抑制剂。

    - **混合型BGCs**：包含PKS和NRPS的混合基因簇，生成复杂的次生代谢产物。

#### 4. 探索新型BGCs的方法

  - **样本采集和前处理**

    - **海洋样本的采集方法**：通过采集海水、海底沉积物和海洋生物进行样本收集。

    - **样本前处理和微生物分离**：样本处理后，通过培养基分离微生物，得到纯培养菌株。

  - **基因组测序**

    - **高通量测序技术**：使用Illumina、PacBio等高通量测序技术，对海洋微生物基因组进行全基因组测序。

    - **基因组组装和注释**：利用生物信息学工具对测序数据进行组装和注释，构建完整的基因组序列。

  - **BGCs的识别和分析**

    - **生物信息学工具（如AntiSMASH, PRISM等）**：使用AntiSMASH、PRISM等软件识别基因组中的BGCs。

    - **基因簇的预测和功能注释**：对识别出的BGCs进行功能预测和注释，推测其可能的次生代谢产物。

#### 5. 新型BGCs的功能验证

  - **异源表达**

    - **将BGCs转入模式生物进行表达**：通过将BGCs克隆到模式生物（如大肠杆菌、酵母）中，进行异源表达。

    - **功能分析和产物鉴定**：通过生化实验和化学分析鉴定表达产物，验证BGCs的功能。

  - **化学分析**

    - **高效液相色谱（HPLC）**：用于分离和纯化次生代谢产物。

    - **质谱分析（MS）**：用于确定产物的分子量和化学结构。

    - **核磁共振（NMR）**：用于详细解析产物的化学结构。

#### 6. 新型BGCs的生物活性研究

  - **抗菌活性**

    - **针对不同病原菌的体外抗菌实验**：测试产物对多种病原菌（如大肠杆菌、金黄色葡萄球菌）的抗菌效果。

  - **抗肿瘤活性**

    - **细胞毒性实验**：测试产物对多种肿瘤细胞系的细胞毒性，以评估其抗肿瘤潜力。

  - **其他生物活性**

    - **抗病毒、抗炎等**：评估产物的抗病毒和抗炎活性，探索其在其他医学领域的应用潜力。

#### 7. 案例研究

  - **具体案例分析**

    - **某种海洋微生物BGC的发现和验证过程**：详细介绍一个成功发现和验证新型BGC的具体案例，包括其采样、基因组测序、BGC识别、异源表达和生物活性研究过程。

    - **该BGC产物的生物活性和潜在应用**：介绍该BGC产物的具体生物活性，如抗菌、抗肿瘤活性，并讨论其潜在的临床应用前景。

#### 8. 挑战和未来展望

  - **当前面临的挑战**

    - **海洋微生物样本获取难度**：深海样本采集成本高，技术难度大。

    - **基因组数据解析复杂**：海洋微生物基因组通常较大且复杂，解析难度高。

    - **功能验证的瓶颈**：异源表达和功能验证过程耗时且成功率低。

  - **未来研究方向**

    - **更高效的BGCs识别技术**：开发更先进的生物信息学工具，提高BGCs识别效率和准确性。

    - **BGCs功能研究的创新方法**：探索新的功能验证方法，如基因编辑、合成生物学等。

    - **新型海洋微生物资源的发掘**：加强对未被充分研究的海洋生态系统的探索，发现更多潜在的有价值微生物资源。

#### 9. 结论

  - **研究总结**

    - **海洋微生物BGCs在新型抗生素开发中的重要性**：总结海洋微生物BGCs的发现和研究对于抗生素开发的重要贡献。

  - **未来展望**

    - **海洋微生物资源在生物医药领域的广阔前景**：展望海洋微生物在抗菌药物、抗肿瘤药物和其他生物活性化合物开发中的巨大潜力和前景。

data.title: antiSMASH 7.0: new and improved predictions for detection, regulation, chemical structures and visualisation
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            Microorganisms produce small bioactive compounds as part of their secondary or specialised metabolism. Often, such metabolites have antimicrobial, anticancer, antifungal, antiviral or other bio-activities and thus play an important role for applications in medicine and agriculture. In the past decade, genome mining has become a widely-used method to explore, access, and analyse the available biodiversity of these compounds. Since 2011, the ‘antibiotics and secondary metabolite analysis shell—antiSMASH’ (https://antismash.secondarymetabolites.org/) has supported researchers in their microbial genome mining tasks, both as a free to use web server and as a standalone tool under an OSI-approved open source licence. It is currently the most widely used tool for detecting and characterising biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) in archaea, bacteria, and fungi. Here, we present the updated version 7 of antiSMASH. antiSMASH 7 increases the number of supported cluster types from 71 to 81, as well as containing improvements in the areas of chemical structure prediction, enzymatic assembly-line visualisation and gene cluster regulation.

data.title: Phylogenetic analysis of condensation domains in NRPS sheds light on their functional evolution
data.abstractNote: Non-ribosomal peptide synthetases (NRPSs) are large multimodular enzymes that synthesize a wide range of biologically active natural peptide compounds, of which many are pharmacologically important. Peptide bond formation is catalyzed by the Condensation (C) domain. Various functional subtypes of the C domain exist: An LCL domain catalyzes a peptide bond between two L-amino acids, a DCL domain links an L-amino acid to a growing peptide ending with a D-amino acid, a Starter C domain (first denominated and classified as a separate subtype here) acylates the first amino acid with a β-hydroxy-carboxylic acid (typically a β-hydroxyl fatty acid), and Heterocyclization (Cyc) domains catalyze both peptide bond formation and subsequent cyclization of cysteine, serine or threonine residues. The homologous Epimerization (E) domain flips the chirality of the last amino acid in the growing peptide; Dual E/C domains catalyze both epimerization and condensation.

data.title: antiSMASH 6.0: improving cluster detection and comparison capabilities
data.abstractNote:
Abstract
            Many microorganisms produce natural products that form the basis of antimicrobials, antivirals, and other drugs. Genome mining is routinely used to complement screening-based workflows to discover novel natural products. Since 2011, the "antibiotics and secondary metabolite analysis shell—antiSMASH" (https://antismash.secondarymetabolites.org/) has supported researchers in their microbial genome mining tasks, both as a free-to-use web server and as a standalone tool under an OSI-approved open-source license. It is currently the most widely used tool for detecting and characterising biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) in bacteria and fungi. Here, we present the updated version 6 of antiSMASH. antiSMASH 6 increases the number of supported cluster types from 58 to 71, displays the modular structure of multi-modular BGCs, adds a new BGC comparison algorithm, allows for the integration of results from other prediction tools, and more effectively detects tailoring enzymes in RiPP clusters.

data.title: Isolation of Sesquiterpenoids and Steroids from the Soft Coral Sinularia brassica and Determination of Their Absolute Configuration
data.abstractNote: Two undescribed rearranged cadinane-type sesquiterpenoids (1–2), named sinulaketol A-B, together with one new chlorinated steroid (3), one new gorgosterol (4), one known sesquiterpene (5), one known dibromoditerpene (6) and two known polyhydroxylated steroids (7–8) were isolated from the soft coral Sinularia brassica. The structures of these compounds were established by extensive spectroscopic analysis, including HRESIMS, 1D, and 2D NMR spectroscopy. Their absolute configurations were also determined by the ECD calculations and DP4+ probability analysis. Antileishmanial activity of compounds 1–8 was evaluated in vitro against the amastigote forms of Leishmania donovani, in which compounds 3, 6, and 7 inhibited the growth of L. donovani by 58.7, 74.3, 54.7%, respectively, at a concentration of 50 μM. Antimicrobial effect of the isolated compounds were also evaluated against Candida albicans, Staphylococcus aureus, and Escherichia coli. Compound 6, a brominated diterpene, exhibited antimicrobial effect against S. aureus.

data.note:
“Nobilamides AH, Long-Acting Transient Receptor Potential Vanilloid-1 (TRPV1) Antagonists from Mollusk-Associated Bacteria

研究背景

关于一类新的化合物——nobilamides A-H，它们是从与软体动物共生的细菌中分离出来的。这些化合物因其能够抑制辣椒素（capsaicin）诱导的小鼠背根神经节（DRG）原代细胞培养中的钙吸收而被发现。这些化合物中的nobilamide B和A-3302-A被证明是小鼠和人类TRPV1通道的长效拮抗剂，能够在去除药物后活动超过1小时，推测是通过共价结合的方式。其他衍生物也显示出对TRPV1通道的抑制作用，尽管效力较低，但提供了支持所提议作用机制的结构-活性概况。尽管这些化合物的活性并不显著，但作者提出了一个新的作用机制和一个新的结合位点，这可能促进了用于疼痛治疗的相关类似物的开发。

研究方法包括：

1. **细胞培养和钙吸收测定**：使用小鼠背根神经节（DRG）原代细胞培养，通过测定辣椒素诱导的钙吸收来筛选和评估化合物的活性。

2. **纯化和结构鉴定**：利用HPLC和NMR等技术对从Streptomyces sp. CN48和CT3a菌株中分离出的化合物进行纯化和结构鉴定。

3. **分子生物学技术**：使用高分辨率电喷雾电离质谱（HRESIMS）和核磁共振（NMR）数据确定化合物的分子式和结构。

4. **TRPV1通道活性测试**：在稳定过表达人类TRPV1的BEAS-2B细胞系和转染了人类TRPV1的HEK-293细胞上测试化合物对TRPV1活性的影响。

5. **突变分析**：利用TRPV1的突变体进行突变分析，以确定化合物与TRPV1通道的结合位点。

6. **结构-活性关系研究**：通过比较不同化合物的效力，研究结构变化对活性的影响。

研究结论：

- Nobilamides A-H是一类新的长效TRPV1拮抗剂，它们可能通过共价修饰TRPV1通道的内细胞螺旋TM4和TM5以及孔环段的残基来发挥作用。

- 尽管这些化合物的效力不是特别高，但它们提供了新的TRPV1拮抗剂开发线索。

- Nobilamides在结构上的微小变化会导致活性的显著差异，这表明通过合成类似物有可能开发出更有效的TRPV1拮抗剂。

- 这些化合物的不可逆性可能成为治疗疼痛的一个优势，因为它们能够长期抑制TRPV1通道的活性。

这篇文章是关于肽内酯类抗生素TL-119和/或A-3302-B的修正结构研究。

研究背景

TL-119是一种从枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）分离出的肽类抗生素，对革兰氏阳性细菌具有活性。之前Nakagawa等人提出了TL-119的结构（结构I），但没有描述氨基酸残基的立体化学。结构I表明这种抗生素是一个含有酯键和α,δ-脱氢氨基酸2-氨基-2-丁烯酸（ΔAba）的肽内酯。同时，从枯草芽孢杆菌中也分离出了两种抗生素A-3302-A和A-3302-B，它们的结构包括组成氨基酸的立体化学已经被阐明，其中A-3302-B被假设与TL-119结构相似。

研究方法包括：

1. 化学合成：为了确认提出的结构，作者化学合成了TL-119和/或A-3302-B。

2. 物理化学性质分析：包括比旋光度测量、核磁共振（^1H-NMR）谱、质谱、红外（IR）谱、圆二色谱（CD）以及氨基酸分析。

3. 抗菌活性测试：通过常规的琼脂稀释法评估合成和天然化合物的抗菌活性，并以最小抑制浓度（MIC）表示。

4. 氨基酸残基的立体化学分析：使用改进的Manning-Moore方法分析天然TL-119和/或A-3302-B中氨基酸残基的构型。

研究结论：

1. 合成化合物与天然TL-119和A-3302-B在物理化学性质和生物活性方面存在差异。

2. 通过重新检查天然TL-119和/或A-3302-B中组成氨基酸残基的构型，发现天然TL-119和A-3302-B含有D-αThr而非原先认为的L-Thr。

3. 基于这些发现，作者提出了TL-119和/或A-3302-B的修正结构（结构II），该结构在分子的第4个位置含有D-α-Thr残基，取代了原先的L-Thr残基。

这项研究的意义在于通过化学合成和详细的物理化学及生物活性分析，对TL-119和A-3302-B的结构进行了修正，为理解这类抗生素的结构-活性关系提供了重要信息。

data.title: Structure and Absolute Configuration of Phenanthro-perylene Quinone Pigments from the Deep-Sea Crinoid Hypalocrinus naresianus
data.abstractNote: Two new water-soluble phenanthroperylene quinones, gymnochrome H (2) and monosulfated gymnochrome A (3), as well as the known compounds gymnochrome A (4) and monosulfated gymnochrome D (5) were isolated from the deep-sea crinoid Hypalocrinus naresianus, which had been collected in the deep sea of Japan. The structures of the compounds were elucidated by spectroscopic analysis including HRMS, 1D 1H and 13C NMR, and 2D NMR. The absolute configuration was determined by ECD spectroscopy, analysis of J-couplings and ROE contacts, and DFT calculations. The configuration of the axial chirality of all isolated phenanthroperylene quinones (2–5) was determined to be (P). For gymnochrome H (2) and monosulfated gymnochrome A (3), a (2′S,2″R) configuration was determined, whereas for monosulfated gymnochrome D (5) a (2′R,2″R), configuration was determined. Acetylated quinones are unusual among natural products from an echinoderm and gymnochrome H (2) together with the recently reported gymnochrome G (1) represent the first isolated acetylated phenanthroperylene quinones.

data.title: Bioactivity guided isolation of antipsychotic constituents from the leaves of Rauwolfia tetraphylla L.
data.abstractNote: This study was undertaken to ascertain the antipsychotic properties of Rauwolfia tetraphylla L. leaves and to isolate and characterize the antipsychotic constituents. Among the MeOH extract and some alkaloidal fractions at different pHs, the alkaloidal CHCl3 fraction at pH-9 (2C) showed the highest antipsychotic activity against dopaminergic (DA-D2) and serotonergic (5-HT2A) receptors in-vitro and amphetamine induced hyperactive mouse model in-vivo. The activity guided isolation of CHCl3 fraction (2C) afforded six indole alkaloids: 10-methoxytetrahydroalstonine (1), isoreserpiline (2), an isomeric mixture of 11-demethoxyreserpiline (3) and 10-demethoxyreserpiline (4), α-yohimbine (5) and reserpiline (6). Given orally, alkaloids 3–6 showed significant antipsychotic activity in a dose dependent manner. None of the extract, alkaloidal fractions or alkaloids showed any extra pyramidal symptoms at the tested doses. It was also observed that MeOH extract was behaving similar to other clinically used novel atypical antipsychotics in having 5-HT2A occupancy greater than the DA-D2 receptor at the tested doses. Further toxicity and safety evaluation studies of MeOH extracts of R. tetraphylla leaves at different doses (10, 100, 300 and 2000mg/kg) on female Swiss albino mice showed that MeOH extract is non toxic. The isolated alkaloids, 3–6 could serve as a promising lead structure for drug development of treating psychotic conditions in human.

data.title: Identification of PKS-NRPS Hybrid Metabolites in Marine-Derived Penicillium oxalicum
data.abstractNote: Filamentous fungi are abundant resources of bioactive natural products. Here, 151 marine-derived fungi were collected from the north Yellow Sea and identified by an internal transcribed spacer (ITS) sequence. The crude extracts of all strains were evaluated for their antimicrobial activities and analyzed by HPLC fingerprint. Based on these, strain Penicillium oxalicum MEFC104 was selected for further investigation. Two new polyketide–amino acid hybrid compounds with feature structures of tetramic acid, oxopyrrolidine A and B, were isolated. Their planner structures were assigned by HRESIMS and 1D/2D NMR experiments. The absolute configurations were determined by modified Mosher’s method, J-based configuration analysis, and ECD calculations. Furthermore, the biosynthetic pathway was identified by bioinformatic analysis and gene-deletion experiments. This study established a link between oxopyrrolidines and the corresponding biosynthesis genes in P. oxalicum.

data.title: Aromatic Polyketides from a Symbiotic Strain Aspergillus fumigatus D and Characterization of Their Biosynthetic Gene D8.t287
data.abstractNote: The chemical investigation of one symbiotic strain, Aspergillus fumigatus D, from the coastal plant Edgeworthia chrysantha Lindl led to the isolation of eight compounds (1–8), which were respectively identified as rubrofusarin B (1), alternariol 9-O-methyl ether (2), fonsecinone D (3), asperpyrone A (4), asperpyrone D (5), fonsecinone B (6), fonsecinone A (7), and aurasperone A (8) by a combination of spectroscopic methods (1D NMR and ESI-MS) as well as by comparison with the literature data. Plausible biosynthetic pathways for dimeric naphtho-γ-pyrones 3–8 were first proposed in this work. A non-reducing polyketide synthase (PKS) gene D8.t287 responsible for the biosynthesis of these aromatic polyketides 1–8 was identified and characterized by target gene knockout experiment and UPLC-MS analysis.
